title: 宴山亭
author: 赵佶
subtitle: 北行见杏花
body: 裁剪冰绡，轻叠数重，淡着胭脂匀注。
新样靓妆，艳溢香融，羞杀蕊珠宫女。
易得凋零，更多少、无情风雨。
愁苦，问院落凄凉，几番春暮？
凭寄离恨重重，者双燕何曾，会人言语？
天遥地远，万水千山，知他故宫何处？
怎不思量？
除梦里有曾去。
无据，和梦也新来不做。
en_title: Tune: Yanshanting · Apricot Blossoms Seen on the Journey North
en_body: Like cut ice-silk, folded light in layers few, with rouge soft and evenly spread. In new-styled adornments bright, beauty overflows and fragrance melts—shaming the maidens of Ruizhu Palace.
How easily they fade and fall, beset by heartless wind and rain! Grief fills the breast; I ask the desolate courtyard: how many times has spring drawn to its close?

I'd charge the swallows to bear this weight of parting sorrows, but how should a pair of swallows understand the speech of men? Sky stretches far, earth stretches wide, ten thousand waters, a thousand mountains—where lies my former palace?
How can I not long for it? Only in dreams did I once return. Yet dreams are untrustworthy; of late, even dreams no longer come.
baihua_lines: 像是用洁白的冰丝裁剪而成，轻轻叠起几层，淡淡地均匀抹上胭脂。新颖美丽的妆扮，光艳四溢、香气融和，连蕊珠宫里的仙女也要自愧不如。
可杏花终究容易凋零，更何况还要经受多少场无情风雨的摧残？心中愁苦，试问这凄凉的院落，已经经历了几番暮春？
想托那双飞的燕子捎去重重离恨，可这燕子又怎能懂得人的言语？天遥地远，隔了万水千山，哪里还知道故宫在什么地方？
怎会不思念呢？只有在梦里才能回去一趟。可梦终究是靠不住的，近来就连梦也不做了。

title: 木兰花
author: 钱惟演
body: 城上风光莺语乱，城下烟波春拍岸。
绿杨芳草几时休？
泪眼愁肠先已断。
情怀渐觉成衰晚，鸾镜朱颜惊暗换。
昔年多病厌芳尊，今日芳尊惟恐浅。
en_body: Above the city walls, orioles babble amid spring scenery; below, misty waves lap the shore in spring. Green willows and fragrant grass—when will they cease? Tear-filled eyes and a grief-wrung heart are already broken.

My feelings slowly turn to the decline of age; in the phoenix mirror I am startled to find my fair face secretly changed. In years past, often ill, I hated the wine cup; today I fear only that the cup is too shallow.
baihua_lines: 城头上春光明媚，黄莺鸣声纷乱；城下烟雾笼罩的水波，在春日里轻轻拍打着江岸。绿杨芳草，何时才是尽头？泪眼模糊，愁肠早已寸断。
情怀渐渐感到衰老将至，对着鸾镜，惊觉朱颜已在不知不觉中变换。往年多病时总是厌弃美酒，如今却唯恐酒杯太浅、饮之不尽。

The the city and ascends stretch so far and wide.
The green and poplars stretch upon the stream.
I think of tears and an aching heart, my heart is sore.
With I feel, I sigh alone.

title: 苏幕遮
author: 范仲淹
body: 碧云天，黄叶地，秋色连波，波上寒烟翠。
山映斜阳天接水，芳草无情，更在斜阳外。
黯乡魂，追旅思。
夜夜除非，好梦留人睡。
明月楼高休独倚，酒入愁肠，化作相思泪。
en_body: Clouds of jade-blue sky, earth of yellow leaves; autumn hues stretch to the waves, and cold mist shimmers emerald above the waters. The hills mirror the setting sun, the sky meets the river, and fragrant grass, unfeeling,
stretches even beyond the setting sun.

The soul darkened by longing for home, the grief of the traveler pursued. Night after night, only sweet dreams can bring peaceful sleep. Lean not alone upon the high rail when the moon shines bright; wine entering a sorrowful heart,
turns to tears of longing.
baihua_lines: 碧云飘悠的蓝天，黄叶纷飞的大地，秋景连接着江上的水波，波上寒烟笼罩着一片翠绿。远山映照着斜阳，天空与江水相连，芳草并不懂人的情意，
一直延伸到斜阳之外的天边。
黯然感伤的他乡之魂，追缠着羁旅的愁思。每夜里除非是美梦，才能留人安睡。明月当空时切莫独自倚靠高楼，酒入愁肠，
都化作了相思的眼泪。

title: 御街行
author: 范仲淹
body: 纷纷坠叶飘香砌。
夜寂静，寒声碎。
真珠帘卷玉楼空，天淡银河垂地。
年年今夜，月华如练，长是人千里。
愁肠已断无由醉，酒未到，先成泪。
残灯明灭枕头攲，谙尽孤眠滋味。
都来此事，眉间心上，无计相回避。
en_body: Falling leaves drift thickly upon the fragrant steps. Night is still, cold sounds rustle thin. Pearl curtains are rolled up in the empty jade tower; the sky is pale, the Silver River hangs low to earth. Every year on this night,
moonlight like white silk, yet the beloved is always a thousand miles away.

A grief-wrung heart already broken has no means to find solace in wine—before the wine arrives, it turns first to tears. Flickering lamplight, I lean against the pillow, having tasted to the full the sorrow of sleeping alone. In the end,
this grief lingers between the brows and upon the heart, with no way to escape.
baihua_lines: 纷纷落叶飘落在飘香的台阶上。夜寂静无声，寒声细碎。珍珠帘幕高卷，玉楼空寂，天色清淡，银河低垂到地。每一年的今夜，
月光都如洁白的素练，而思念的人却总是远在千里之外。
愁肠已断，想要醉酒也无从醉起，酒还未入愁肠，便已先化作了泪水。残灯忽明忽暗，我斜倚着枕头，尝尽了孤眠的滋味。看来
这相思之情，不是缠绕在眉间，就是萦绕在心头，实在没有办法可以回避。

en:
Amidst leaves and drifting so far and wide.
Night and silent awaken my longing in the breeze.
Through the curtain and the tower, across the plain.
The year rise before me, in woods deep.
An aching heart and already weigh on my soul, in vain I wait.
The lamp and bright weigh on my soul, my grief runs deep.
Through comes and this, across the plain.

title: 千秋岁
author: 张先
body: 数声鶗鳺，又报芳菲歇。
惜春更选残红折，雨轻风色暴，梅子青时节。
永丰柳，无人尽日花飞雪。
莫把幺弦拨，怨极弦能说。
天不老，情难绝，心似双丝网，中有千千结。
夜过也，东窗未白孤灯灭。
en_body: Several cries of the cuckoo announce once more the fading of fragrant blooms. To cherish spring, I choose among the lingering blossoms to pluck; rain is light, the wind fierce, the season when green plums appear. The willows of Yongfeng,
all day long, unobserved, send catkins flying like snow.

Pluck not the lonely string, for at the height of grief the string can speak. Heaven grows not old; love can never end. The heart is like a net of double silk threads, within it tied a thousand knots. The night is nearly done,
the east window not yet bright, the lonely lamp burns out.
baihua_lines: 杜鹃鸟几声啼鸣，又在报告芬芳的花草即将凋谢。因为爱惜春光，特意选了尚未凋零的残花来折取；细雨濛濛，春风却急暴，正是梅子青涩的时节。永丰坊的那株柳树，
整日里无人过问，只管把柳絮扬得像飞雪一般。
切莫去拨弄那根哀婉的孤弦，怨恨到了极点，琴弦也会替人诉说哀怨。苍天不会老，真情也难断绝。心儿就像那双丝织成的网，中间有着千万个解不开的结。长夜即将过去，
东方的窗户还未泛白，孤灯已经熄灭了。

title: 菩萨蛮
author: 张先
body: 哀筝一弄湘江曲，声声写尽湘波绿。
纤指十三弦，细将幽恨传。
当筵秋水慢，玉柱斜飞雁。
弹到断肠时，春山眉黛低。
醉垂鞭，张先双蝶绣罗裙，东池宴初相见。
朱粉不深匀，闲花淡淡春。
细看诸处好，人人道柳腰身。
昨日乱山昏，来时衣上云。
en_body: A mournful zither plays the Xiang River tune; note by note it paints the green of Xiang's waves. Slender fingers on the thirteen strings softly convey the hidden grief. Before the feast, autumn waters
move slowly; jade pegs slant like flying geese. When the playing breaks the heart, spring-mountain brows droop low.

Drunken, the whip hangs loose—twin butterflies embroidered on a silken skirt; by the eastern pool, at the first meeting. Powder and rouge but lightly laid; like wild flowers, spring at its quietest. Closely
gazing, all is lovely; all praise her willow waist. Yesterday the tangled mountains were dim; when she came, clouds rested on her gown.
baihua_lines: 弹起哀怨的筝，奏一曲《湘江曲》，一声声写尽了湘波的碧绿。纤细的手指拨动十三根琴弦，将幽幽的幽怨细细传递。筵席上她的眼波如秋水般
缓缓流转，筝上的玉柱斜排，如一行飞雁。弹到最伤心之处，她那如春山般的黛眉低低垂下。
醉后马鞭低垂——罗裙上绣着双飞的蝴蝶，在东池的宴席上初次相见。胭脂和铅粉敷得并不浓重，像闲雅的花朵带着淡淡的春意。仔细
端详，她处处都美好，人人都称赞她那柔如柳枝的腰肢。昨日黄昏时乱山昏暗，她来时衣上仿佛带着山间的云气。

lines: 哀筝一弄湘江曲，声声写尽湘波绿。
纤指十三弦，细将幽恨传。
当筵秋水慢，玉柱斜飞雁。
弹到断肠时，春山眉黛低。
醉垂鞭，张先双蝶绣罗裙，东池宴初相见。
朱粉不深匀，闲花淡淡春。
细看诸处好，人人道柳腰身。
昨日乱山昏，来时衣上云。

title: 一丛花
author: 张先
body: 伤高怀远几时穷？
无物似情浓。
离愁正引千丝乱，更东陌，飞絮蒙蒙。
嘶骑渐遥，征尘不断，何处认郎踪？
双鸳池沼水溶溶，南北小桡通。
梯横画阁黄昏后，又还是，斜月帘栊。
沉恨细思，不如桃杏，犹解嫁东风。
note:
【一丛花】词牌名，又名「一丛花令」，双调七十八字，平韵。
【伤高怀远】登高望远，思念远方的人。
【千丝乱】千万条柳丝缭乱，双关「千思」。
【东陌】东边的田间小路，指送别之地。
【嘶骑（jì）】嘶叫的马；骑，一人一马为骑。
【征尘】旅途上的尘土。
【双鸳】成双的鸳鸯，象征爱侣。
【小桡（ráo）】小船桨，代指小船。
【梯横画阁】梯子横搁在画楼旁，暗示情人已去，不复再登。
【帘栊】窗帘和窗牖。
【嫁东风】化用李贺《南园》「可怜日暮嫣香落，嫁与春风不用媒」句意，谓桃杏犹能嫁东风，而人反不如花。
en_body: Gazing from heights, longing for the distant one—when shall this end? Nothing is as deep as love. The grief of parting sets a thousand willow threads in disarray, and on the eastern paths catkins drift in misty haze. Neighing
horses fade into the distance, dust of the road unceasing—where shall I trace my beloved's tracks?

A pair of mandarin ducks, the pond waters flowing smooth; small boats ply between north and south. Ladder laid aside, the painted pavilion at dusk, and once again, slanting moonlight upon the curtain. In deepest
grief I think: even peach and apricot blooms, I suppose, know to wed the east wind.
baihua_lines: 登高怀远，心中愁绪几时才能穷尽？没有什么东西比情意更浓厚了。离别的愁绪正引得千条柳丝纷乱，更兼东边的大路上，柳絮飞落迷蒙一片。嘶鸣的
坐骑渐渐远去，旅途的尘土飞个不停，我又到哪里去辨认心上人的踪迹呢？
池塘里鸳鸯成对，水溶溶地流淌着，南北两岸之间有小船往来相通。梯子横斜地靠在画阁旁，黄昏之后，依旧是斜月映照着窗帘。怀着深深的愁
恨仔细思量，自己还不如那桃花杏花，它们尚且懂得嫁给东风、获得归宿。

title: 天仙子
author: 张先
subtitle: 时为嘉禾小倅以病眠不赴府会
body: 水调数声持酒听，午醉醒来愁未醒。
送春春去几时回？
临晚镜，伤流景，往事后期空记省。
沙上并禽池上暝，云破月来花弄影。
重重帘幕密遮灯，风不定，人初静，明月落红应满径。
en_title: Tune: Tianxianzi (Song of the Heavenly Immortal)
en_body: I hold my wine and listen to a few strains of the Water Tune; noon-drunk I wake, yet sorrow remains unawakened. Seeing spring off—when will spring return? Facing the evening mirror, grieved by passing years,
past affairs and future hopes are but empty memories.

On the sand, paired birds rest as the pond grows dim; through breaking clouds the moon appears, and flowers play with shadows. Layer on layer of curtains, tightly drawn to shield the lamp; wind unsteady, people first falling still—
beneath the bright moon, fallen blooms must now fill the path.
baihua_lines: 端着酒杯听了几遍《水调》曲，午后从醉中醒来，愁却未醒。送别春天，春去了几时才回？傍晚对镜自照，感伤年华如水般流逝，
往日的事、后会的期约，都只是空自留在记忆里。
沙滩上水鸟双栖，池上暮色渐浓；云开月出，花影在风中摇曳。重重帘幕密密遮住灯光，风势不定，人声初静，
明天的月光下，落红该是铺满了小径吧。

Heavy rise before me, in woods deep.

title: 青门引
author: 张先
body: 乍暖还轻冷，风雨晚来方定。
庭轩寂寞近清明，残花中酒，又是去年病。
楼头画角风吹醒，入夜重门静。
那堪更被明月，隔墙送过秋千影。
en_body: After sudden warmth, a light chill returns; wind and rain only cease as evening falls. Lonely in the courtyard near the Clear Bright Festival, with leftover blossoms I sit and drink, once more the same illness as last year.
From the tower a painted horn wakes me with the wind; as night falls, double gates grow still. How can I bear that the bright moon once more, over the wall, sends over the shadow of the swing?
baihua_lines: 天气刚转暖，还带着轻微的寒意，一天风雨到了傍晚才停歇。庭院中寂寞冷清，将近清明时节，对着残花喝醉了酒，又犯了和去年一样的病。
城楼上画角声声，被风吹醒我的醉意；入夜之后，重门寂静。哪堪忍受那轮明月，又隔着墙，把秋千的影子送了过来？

theme: 《青门引》写离愁别绪、儿女情长，全篇情景相生，含蓄不尽。
lines: 乍暖还轻冷，风雨晚来方定。
庭轩寂寞近清明，残花中酒，又是去年病。
楼头画角风吹醒，入夜重门静。
那堪更被明月，隔墙送过秋千影。
en:
Warmth and light fill the view across the plain.
Silent and clear, in autumn haze.
Of the tower and the wind, by riverside.
With that and the bright moon in view, in autumn haze.

title: 浣溪沙
author: 晏殊
body: 一曲新词酒一杯，去年天气旧池台，夕阳西下几时回？
无可奈何花落去，似曾相识燕归来，小园香径独徘徊。
en_body: A new verse to a single tune, a cup of wine; last year's weather, the old pavilion terrace. The sun sets in the west—when shall it return?
Flowers fall all too helplessly; swallows return, seeming familiar. Along the fragrant path in the little garden, alone I linger.
baihua_lines: 听一曲新词，饮一杯美酒，依旧是去年的天气，依旧是旧时的亭台，而西下的夕阳什么时候才能再回来？
春花凋落，我终究无法挽留；燕子归来，似是去年旧识。在小园的落花飘香的小路上，我独自徘徊、久久不去。

title: 浣溪沙
author: 晏殊
body: 一向年光有限身，等闲离别易消魂，酒筵歌席莫辞频。
满目山河空念远，落花风雨更伤春，不如怜取眼前人。
en_body: A moment of youthful light, a body all too finite; partings of the ordinary sort easily break the soul. At wine feasts and song banquets, do not decline the frequent cup.
Before my eyes, mountains and rivers stretch empty in longing for the distant; falling blooms and wind and rain but wound spring further. Better to cherish the one before your eyes.
baihua_lines: 片刻的青春年华，有限的人生；寻常的离别，就足以让人黯然销魂。酒宴歌席之上，且莫推辞频频举杯。
放眼望去，山河空阔，思念远方之人也是徒然；落花风雨更让人感伤春天的逝去，倒不如好好珍惜眼前的人吧。

title: 清乐平
author: 晏殊
body: 红笺小字，说尽平生意。
鸿雁在云鱼在水，惆怅此情难寄。
斜阳独倚西楼，遥山恰对帘钩。
人面不知何处，绿波依旧东流。
note:
【清平乐】词牌名，又名「清平乐令」，双调四十六字，上片仄韵，下片平韵。
【红笺】红色的精美信纸，唐代蜀笺有名，即薛涛笺，多用来题诗写信。
【鸿雁在云鱼在水】古人有「鸿雁传书」「鱼传尺素」之说，此处雁在云中、鱼在水中，皆无法代为传信。
【鸿雁传书】出《汉书·苏武传》，汉使诈称天子射雁得书，苏武乃得归汉。
【鱼传尺素】古乐府《饮马长城窟行》「客从远方来，遗我双鲤鱼。呼儿烹鲤鱼，中有尺素书」。
【人面不知何处】化用崔护《题都城南庄》「人面不知何处去，桃花依旧笑春风」。
en_body: Small words on red letter paper tell all the longings of a lifetime. Wild geese rest in the clouds, fish in the waters—heavy-hearted, this love is hard to send.
In the slanting sun I lean alone on the western tower; distant mountains meet precisely the curtain hook. The beloved's face is gone, none knows where; green waves still flow east as ever.
baihua_lines: 精美的红笺上写满了小字，诉说着平生的相思情意。可鸿雁高飞云端，游鱼深潜水底，这份惆怅的情意终究难以寄达。
夕阳西下，我独自倚着西楼，远山恰好正对着帘钩。相思之人不知在何处，只有碧绿的波浪依旧向东流去。

title: 清乐平
author: 晏殊
body: 金风细细，叶叶梧桐坠。
绿酒初尝人易醉，一枕小窗浓睡。
紫薇朱槿花残，斜阳却照阑干。
双燕欲归时节，银屏昨夜微寒。
note:
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: Golden winds blow fine and thin; leaf by leaf parasol leaves fall. Tasting green wine for the first time, one grows easily drunk; by the small window with a pillow I sink into deep sleep.
Crape myrtle and rose-of-sharon blooms fade; slanting sunlight rests upon the railings. A pair of swallows, the season for returning; by the silver screen, last night was faintly cold.
baihua_lines: 秋风轻轻地吹，梧桐叶一片片飘落。初尝绿酒，人很容易喝醉，枕在枕上靠着小窗沉沉睡去。
紫薇花和朱槿花都已凋残，斜阳正照在栏杆上。双燕将要南飞的时节，昨夜在银屏之内，已微微感到一丝寒意。

title: 木兰花
author: 晏殊
body: 燕鸿过后莺归去，细算浮生千万绪。
长于春梦几多时，散似秋云无觅处。
闻琴解佩神仙侣，挽断罗衣留不住。
劝君莫作独醒人，烂醉花间应有数。
en_body: After swallows and geese have passed, orioles depart as well; counting the thousand threads of this floating life, all is tangled. Longer than a spring dream—how much more time? Scattered like autumn clouds, no trace to be found.

One who hears the zither, one who unfastens the pendant—immortal companions; though I snap the silken gown, I cannot hold them back. I urge you, be not the sole sober man; drunk among the flowers should be one's lot.
baihua_lines: 燕鸿过境之后，黄莺也归去了；细想这飘浮不定的人生，愁绪千头万绪。春梦般的美好时光能有多久？一朝离散便如秋云无踪可寻。
无论是听琴心许的卓文君，还是解佩相赠的江妃，那般神仙美眷，我即便是挽断罗衣也留不住。劝你不要做那独自清醒的人，烂醉于花间大抵是命中注定的吧。

title: 木兰花
author: 晏殊
body: 池塘水绿风微暖，记得玉真初见面。
重头歌韵响琤琮，入破舞腰红乱旋。
玉钩栏下香阶畔，醉后不知斜日晚。
当时共我赏花人，点检如今无一半。
en_body: The pond waters are green, the breeze faintly warm; I remember when first I met the Jade Immortal. Repeated strains of song echo clear and tinkling; at the dance's break, red-sashed waists spin in wild rotations.
Beneath the jade-railed steps by the fragrant courtyard, after drunkenness I knew not that the slanting sun was late. Those who once enjoyed the flowers with me—counting now, less than half remain.
baihua_lines: 池塘里碧波荡漾，风儿微带暖意，还记得初次遇见那位如玉佳人的情景。一曲重头歌唱得音韵清脆动听，入破的舞乐响起，穿着红衣的舞腰急促旋转。
在玉栏下香阶旁，醉后浑然不觉夕阳已经晚了。当年和我一起赏花的人，如今细数，竟已不到一半。

title: 木兰花
author: 晏殊
body: 绿杨芳草长亭路，年少抛人容易去。
楼头残梦五更钟，花底离愁三月雨。
无情不似多情苦，一寸还成千万缕。
天涯地角有穷时，只有相思无尽处。
en_body: Green willows, fragrant grass, the road to the Pavilion of Parting; in youth the beloved slips away all too easily. At the tower's head, broken dreams under the fifth-watch bell; at the flower's base, parting sorrows in third-month rain.

The heartless do not know the bitter pangs of the loving; one inch of sorrow yet weaves into a thousand threads. Earth's ends and heaven's corners have their bounds; only longing stretches on, with no end.
baihua_lines: 绿杨依依，芳草萋萋，长亭路上正是送别之处；青春年少的时光，总是那样轻易地抛下人离去。楼头传来五更钟声，惊破了残梦；花底下三月的春雨，更添离别的愁绪。
无情之人不像多情之人那样愁苦，一寸芳心竟化作千万缕情丝。天涯海角总有尽头，只有相思之情是无穷无尽的。

title: 踏莎行
author: 晏殊
body: 祖席离歌，长亭别宴，香尘已隔犹回面。
居人匹马映林嘶，行人去棹依波转。
画阁魂消，高楼目断，斜阳只送平波远。
无穷无尽是离愁，天涯地角寻思遍。
en_body: A farewell song at the parting feast, a banquet of separation at the Long Pavilion; though fragrant dust divides us, still we turn to look back. The lone horse of the stay-at-home neighs against the woods; the traveler's oar turns away with the waves.

In the painted pavilion the soul melts away; from the high tower the gaze breaks; the setting sun only escorts the level waves afar. Boundless, unending is the grief of parting; to earth's ends and heaven's corners my longing searches everywhere.
baihua_lines: 在饯别的宴席上唱着离歌，长亭下设了送别的酒宴，虽然香尘已将我们隔开，还是忍不住频频回望。送别的人马儿对着树林嘶鸣，远行人的船已随波渐远。
画阁之上我黯然销魂，高楼上望断双眼，斜阳只护送着平波流向远方。无穷无尽的是离愁别恨，我的思绪寻遍了天涯海角。

title: 踏莎行
author: 晏殊
body: 小径红稀，芳郊绿遍，高台树色阴阴见。
春风不解禁杨花，蒙蒙乱扑行人面。
翠叶藏莺，朱帘隔燕，炉香静逐游丝转。
一场愁梦酒醒时，斜阳却照深深院。
en_body: On the small path red blooms grow thin; the fragrant meadows are filled with green. From the high terrace tree shades are dimly seen. The spring wind, unknowing how to willow catkins refrain, sends them in misty flurries to beat against the traveler's face.

Kingfisher leaves hide orioles; pearl curtains screen out swallows. Incense from the burner quietly chases the drifting gossamer threads. After a sorrowful dream, when the wine fades, the slanting sun shines upon the deep, deep courtyard.
baihua_lines: 小路旁的红花已经稀疏，郊野上已处处是碧绿的草色。高台上望去，树色郁郁葱葱、隐约可见。春风不懂得管束柳絮，任它蒙蒙乱乱地扑打到行人脸上。
翠绿的叶丛中藏着黄莺，朱红的帘幕外隔着春燕。香炉里的轻烟静静追逐着飘荡的游丝流转。一场愁梦醒来，酒意已消，斜阳正照着深深的庭院。

title: 蝶恋花
author: 晏殊
body: 六曲阑干偎碧树,杨柳风轻,展尽黄金缕。
谁把钿筝移玉柱，穿帘海燕双飞去。
满眼游丝兼落絮,红杏开时,一霎清明雨。
浓睡觉来莺乱语，惊残好梦无寻处。
note:
【蝶恋花】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: Six-bended railings curl around emerald trees; willow catkins light in the wind, unfurling golden threads full. Who draws the inlaid zither to move the jade pegs? Swallows from the sea fly in pairs through the curtains.

All eyes are on drifting gossamer and falling catkins; when red apricots bloom comes a sudden Clear Bright rain. Waking from heavy sleep, orioles chatter wildly, shattering my sweet dream—nowhere to be found.
baihua_lines: 曲折的栏杆紧挨着碧绿的树木，杨柳在春风中轻盈摇曳，舒展着千万条金丝般的柔枝。是谁在拨弄镶嵌精美的筝、移动玉制的弦柱？穿帘的海燕双双飞去。
满眼是游丝飘转、柳絮飞落，红杏花开时节，下了一阵清明节的骤雨。浓睡醒来，只听得黄莺乱啼，把我的好梦惊得支离破碎，再无觅处。

title: 凤箫吟
author: 韩缜
body: 锁离愁连绵无际，来时陌上初熏，绣帏人念远，暗垂珠露，泣送征轮。
长行长在眼，更重重、远水孤云。
但望极楼高，尽日目断王孙。
消魂池塘别后，曾行处、绿妒轻裙。
恁时携素手,乱花飞絮里,缓步香茵。
朱颜自改，向年年、芳意长新。
遍绿野、嬉游醉眼，莫负青春。
en_title: Tune: Fengxiaoyin (Song of the Phoenix Flute)
en_body: Locked in parting sorrow, stretching boundless, when we came the paths were freshly scented. She in the embroidered curtain, thinking of the far traveler, lets pearl tears fall in secret, weeping to see the traveling wheels depart. Long the road stretches before the eyes, yet more and more, distant waters, lonely clouds.
But when I gaze from the highest tower, all day my eyes strain to follow the noble traveler.

Soul-wrenched since our parting by the pond, where once we walked the green grass envies her light skirt. That time, holding her white hand, amid fallen blooms and flying catkins we strolled the fragrant lawns.
Her fair face will change with time, yet year by year the spring's intention grows ever new. Across the green fields, in playful wanderings and drunken gaze, do not squander your youth.
baihua_lines: 连绵无际的离愁，紧紧锁在心头；来时郊野的道路上，春草正散发着初香。闺帷中的她思念着远方的我，暗暗垂下泪珠，哭泣着目送我的车轮远去。长路漫漫总在眼前，更有一重又一重的远水孤云。
只能登楼极目远眺，终日远望那远行人的方向。
自从池塘边分别之后，黯然销魂；我们曾经走过的地方，绿草都要嫉妒她那轻盈的罗裙。那时我挽着她洁白的手，在乱花飞絮之中，漫步于芬芳如茵的草地上。
青春的容颜自然会衰老，可年年春草却总是新鲜茂盛。走遍绿野，尽情嬉游，醉眼赏春，切莫辜负了大好青春。

title: 木兰花
author: 宋祁
body: 东城渐觉风光好，彀皱波纹迎客棹。
绿杨烟外晓云轻，红杏枝头春意闹。
浮生长恨欢娱少，肯爱千金轻一笑？
为君持酒劝斜阳，且向花间留晚照。
en_body: East of the city, I gradually feel the scenery grows fair; rippled waves like pressed gauze welcome the traveler's oar. Beyond the mist of green willows morning clouds drift light; on red apricot branches spring's mood runs riot.

In this floating life I oft lament that joy comes all too seldom—how begrudge a thousand gold for one light laugh? For you I hold the wine and urge the setting sun: linger a while among the flowers, cast your evening glow.
baihua_lines: 城东渐渐感觉风光越来越美好，绉纱般的微波迎接着游船。绿杨如烟的柳林外，晓云轻轻飘；红杏枝头，春意正热闹得欢。
漂泊的人生总遗憾欢乐太少，怎会因吝惜千金而轻视那美人的一笑？让我为你举杯劝斜阳：且在花丛间多留一会儿，把晚霞的余晖洒下吧。

title: 采桑子
author: 欧阳修
body: 群芳过后西湖好，狼籍残红，飞絮蒙蒙，垂柳阑干尽日风。
笙歌散尽游人去，始觉春空，垂下帘栊，双燕归来细雨中。
note:
【采桑子】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: After all the blooms have faded West Lake is still fair: scattered fallen reds, flying willow catkins in mist, drooping willows by the railing, all day long the wind.
When song and flute have dispersed and visitors departed, I begin to feel spring's emptiness. Down I let the curtain fall; a pair of swallows returns through the fine rain.
baihua_lines: 百花凋谢之后，西湖依旧美丽：残花散乱飘落，飞絮濛濛一片，垂柳拂着栏杆，整天风儿轻吹。
笙箫歌声都散去，游人们也走了，才觉得春意阑珊、一片空寂。刚刚放下窗帘，就看见一对燕子在细雨中归来。

title: 诉衷情
author: 欧阳修
body: 清晨帘幕卷轻霜，呵手试梅妆。
都缘自有离恨，故画作远山长。
思往事，惜流芳，易成伤。
拟歌先敛，欲笑还颦，最断人肠。
en_body: In early morning I roll up the curtain, light frost upon it; blowing on my hands, I try the plum-blossom makeup. All because there lies a grief of parting within, I paint my brows long like distant mountains.
Recalling past events, cherishing fleeting years, one easily falls to sorrow. About to sing, I first frown; about to smile, I knit my brows anew—this most breaks the heart.
baihua_lines: 清晨卷起帘幕，帘上带着薄薄的霜；我呵暖双手，试着画那梅花妆。只因为心中满是离别的愁恨，所以特意把双眉画成远山一般修长。
回念往事，痛惜流逝的芳年，最容易令人感伤。想唱歌却先皱起眉头，想笑却又蹙起了双眉，这光景最令人心碎。

title: 踏莎行
author: 欧阳修
body: 候馆梅残，溪桥柳细，草薰风暖摇征辔。
离愁渐远渐无穷，迢迢不断如春水。
寸寸柔肠，盈盈粉泪，楼高莫近危阑倚。
平芜尽处是春山，行人更在春山外。
en_body: At the courier lodge plums fade by; by the bridge over the brook willows slender; grass-scented warmth in the wind sways the traveler's reins. The grief of parting grows farther, grows more endless—stretching on and on like spring waters.

Inch by inch the tender heart breaks; tear on tear the powdery cheeks are wet. In the high tower lean not against the perilous rail. Where the flat meadow ends are spring hills; the traveler is yet beyond those spring hills.
baihua_lines: 旅舍旁的梅花已经凋谢，溪桥边的柳树纤细柔长；暖风送来草的清香，吹动着远行游子的马缰。离愁渐行渐远渐无穷，就像那迢迢不断的春水一样。
柔肠寸断，粉泪盈盈挂满了面颊。高楼之上切莫去倚那高高的栏杆。平旷的草地尽头是春山，而远行的人，更在那春山之外。

title: 蝶恋花
author: 欧阳修
body: 庭院深深深几许？
杨柳堆烟,帘幕无重数。
玉勒雕鞍游冶处,楼高不见章台路。
雨横风狂三月暮，门掩黄昏,无计留春住。
泪眼问花花不语,乱红飞过秋千去。
en_body: The courtyard is deep, deep—how deep it is! Willows pile up mist, curtains and screens beyond number. Where the jade-bit and carved saddle roam in pleasure, from the high tower I cannot see the Zhangtai Road.

Rain rages, wind is wild in the third month's dusk; the door is shut on twilight, no way to keep spring home. Tear-filled I ask the flowers, but the flowers answer not; in wild confusion red petals fly past the swing.
baihua_lines: 庭院深深，到底有多深？杨柳笼罩在烟雾中，帘幕不知有多少重。乘着华丽车马在外寻欢作乐的人，他去了哪里？我在高楼上望不到那条章台路。
暮春三月的傍晚，风狂雨骤；黄昏时分掩上门户，却没有办法把春天留住。含泪问花儿花儿不回答，纷乱的落花飞过秋千去了。

title: 蝶恋花
author: 欧阳修
body: 谁道闲情抛弃久？
每到春来,惆怅还依旧。
日日花前常病酒,不辞镜里朱颜瘦。
河畔青芜堤上柳，为问新愁,何事年年有？
独立小桥风满袖,平林新月人归后。
en_body: Who says idle grief has long been cast aside? Each time spring comes the melancholy returns as before. Day after day before the flowers, often sick with wine, I do not shrink from seeing in the mirror my fair face grow thin.

By the riverbank green meadows, willows on the dyke—I ask, this new sorrow, for what does it arise year after year? I stand alone on the small bridge, wind filling my sleeves; beyond the level woods the new moon rises as people head home.
baihua_lines: 谁说闲愁已经被抛却很久了？每到春天来临，惆怅之情还和过去一样。天天在花前饮酒，常常大醉，也不顾镜中红润的容颜日益消瘦。
河畔青草丛生，堤上柳树成行，我要问：这新添的愁绪，为什么年年都有？独自站在小桥上，清风吹满衣袖，平林之上新月初升，路上的行人都已归去。

title: 蝶恋花
author: 欧阳修
body: 几日行云何处去？
忘了归来,不道春将暮。
百草千花寒食路,香车系在谁家树？
泪眼倚楼频独语。
双燕来时,陌上相逢否？
撩乱春愁如柳絮,依依梦里无寻处。
en_body: These few days, where have the drifting clouds gone? Forgetting to return, knowing not that spring draws to its close. Amid a hundred herbs, a thousand flowers, the Cold Food road; to whose tree is the fragrant carriage tied?

Tear-filled, I lean upon the tower and often speak to myself. When the paired swallows come, have you met on the paths afar? Tangled spring sorrows like willow catkins—longing in dreams, nowhere to be found.
baihua_lines: 这几日飘浮的行云到哪里去了？竟忘了归来，不知道春天就要过去了。在那百草千花盛开的寒食路上，你的香车究竟系在谁家的树上？
满含眼泪独倚高楼，频频自言自语。双燕飞来的时候，你们可曾在途中相遇？撩乱的春愁就像那漫天的柳絮，即使在依依的梦中也找不到他的去处。

title: 木兰花
author: 欧阳修
body: 别后不知君远近，触目凄凉多少闷！
渐行渐远渐无书，水阔鱼沉何处问？
夜深风竹敲秋韵，万叶千声皆是恨。
故攲单枕梦中寻，梦又不成灯双烬。
en_body: Since parting I know not whether you are near or far; wherever I look, all is desolate, and how great the gloom! Slowly you walk farther off, slowly letters cease; waters wide, fish sunk deep—where may I ask for news?

Deep at night, wind in the bamboo strikes the autumn rhythm; ten thousand leaves, a thousand sounds—all are hate. So I lean upon the single pillow to seek in dreams, but dreams will not come, and the lamp burns out its twin wicks.
baihua_lines: 自从分别之后，便不知你是远是近；映入眼帘的都是凄凉景象，心中有说不尽的愁闷！你越走越远，渐渐连书信也断了；水势辽远，鱼儿沉底，我又到哪里去打听你的消息？
夜深人静，风吹竹叶敲出秋声；万叶千声，声声都饱含着离恨。因此我斜倚孤枕想在梦中寻你，可终究难成眠，连油灯的双芯也燃成灰烬。

title: 浪淘沙
author: 欧阳修
body: 把酒祝东风，且共从容。
垂杨紫陌洛城东，总是当时携手处，游遍芳丝。
聚散苦匆匆，此恨无穷。
今年花胜去年红，可惜明年花更好，知与谁同？
en_body: Raising my cup, I toast the east wind: let us tarry yet a while. Purple willows along the purple lanes east of Luoyang—all were places where once we walked hand in hand, wandering through every fragrant lane.
Meeting and parting are bitter in their haste; this grief is endless. This year's flowers outshine last year's red. Alas, next year the flowers will be finer still—who will share them with me?
baihua_lines: 我端起酒杯向东风祈祷：请你暂且放慢脚步、多留些时光。洛阳城东紫陌路上垂杨飘拂，当年我们携手同游的地方，游遍了每一处芳花丛。
可叹欢聚离散都太过匆匆，这遗恨无穷无尽。今年的花比去年开得更红。可惜明年花会更好，不知那时我又与谁一同观赏呢？

title: 青玉案
author: 欧阳修
body: 一年春事都来几？
早过了、三之二。
绿暗红嫣浑可事。
绿杨庭院，暖风帘幕，有个人憔悴。
买花载酒长安市，又争似，家山见桃李？
不枉东风吹客泪，相思难表，梦魂无据，惟有归来是。
note:
【青玉案】词牌名。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
en_body: A year of spring affairs—how many have passed? Already gone two-thirds of the way. Green dark, red charming—all in perfect ease. Green willow courtyard, warm wind by curtain,
there is one whose face grows pale and worn.

Buying flowers and bearing wine in the Chang'an market—how can it compare with seeing peach and plum at my homeland hills? In vain the east wind blows the traveler's tears; longing too hard to tell, dreams
and souls untrustworthy—only returning home is true.
baihua_lines: 一年春事，算来已过去了几分？早过了三分之二。绿意浓浓，红花娇美，一切看上去都安好。绿杨成荫的庭院里，暖风吹拂着帘幕，
有一个人儿却已憔悴消瘦。
在长安城里买花载酒、追欢买笑，又怎比得上在家乡的山野看那桃花李花呢？难怪东风要吹落游子的眼泪；相思之情难以表达，梦
境终究虚幻无凭，只有回到故乡才是真正的归宿。

title: 曲玉管
author: 柳永
body: 陇首云飞，江边日晚，烟波满目凭阑久。
一望关河萧索，千里清秋，忍凝眸。
杳杳神京，盈盈仙子，别来锦字终难偶。
断雁无凭，冉冉飞下汀洲、思悠悠。
暗想当初，有多少、幽欢佳会；岂知聚散难期，翻成雨恨云愁。
阻追游，每登山临水，惹起平生心事，一场消黯，永日无言，却下层楼。
en_body: Clouds fly from the mountain ridge; by the river sun grows late; misty waves fill the eyes as I lean long upon the rail. At one glance, the passes and rivers stretch desolate, a thousand li of clear autumn—I cannot bear to gaze

steadily. Far, far the divine capital; fair, fair the immortal maid; since parting, letters of brocade have been hard to match. The broken wild goose has no proof, floating slowly down to the sandbar, thoughts stretching
endlessly.

In secret I recall the beginning: how many secret trysts, joyous meetings! Who knew that meeting and parting are so hard to promise, turning instead to rain-grief and cloud-sorrow? Blocked are our wanderings;
each time I climb a hill or waterside I stir up life-long memories: a spell of soul-wrenched gloom, the whole day without speech, as I descend the tower.
baihua_lines: 山头云飞，江边日晚，烟波满目，我久久地倚靠着栏杆。一眼望去，关河萧条冷落，千里清秋，我实在不忍凝
眸远望。遥远渺渺的神京，那位体态轻盈的仙女，自别后音书断绝难以相逢。孤雁无法传书，它缓缓地飞落沙洲，我的思绪悠
悠无尽。
回想当初，我们曾有过多少幽欢佳会，怎知聚散难料，反而变成了雨恨云愁。山水阻隔，不能相伴同游；
每当我登山临水，总会勾起平生心事，只落得一场黯然销魂，终日默默无言，怅然走下高楼。

每当我登山临水，总会勾起平生心事，只落得一场黯然销魂，终日默默无言，怅然走下高楼。

title: 雨霖铃
author: 柳永
body: 寒蝉凄切，对长亭晚，骤雨初歇。
都门帐饮无绪，留恋处、兰舟催发。
执手相看泪眼，竟无语凝噎。
念去去、千里烟波，暮霭沉沉楚天阔。
多情自古伤离别，更那堪、冷落清秋节！
今宵酒醒何处？
杨柳岸、晓风残月。
此去经年，应是良辰好景虚设。
便纵有千种风情，更与何人说？
note:
【雨霖铃】词牌名。
【暮】傍晚。
【霭】云气。
en_body: Autumn cicadas chirp mournfully; facing the Long Pavilion at dusk, a sudden shower has just ceased. At the city gate we drink a parting tent-wine with no heart for it; lingering, the orchid boat urges departure. Holding

hands we gaze into each other's tearful eyes, at last without words, choked with sobs. Thinking of going on and on, a thousand li of misty waves, the evening haze hanging heavy over the southern sky so vast.

Since ancient times the tender-hearted have grieved at parting; how much harder still, this cold, deserted autumn festival! Where shall I wake from wine tonight? By the willow bank, the dawn breeze and the fading
moon. This parting may last for years, and all fine moments, lovely scenes shall be but empty things. Even if I have a thousand kinds of tender feelings, to whom shall I speak of them again?
baihua_lines: 秋后的蝉鸣声凄凉悲切，面对着长亭，正是傍晚时分，一阵骤雨刚刚停歇。在京城门外设帐饯别，我却毫无畅饮的心绪；正在依依不舍之时，船上的人已催促着要出发。握
着手互相凝望，满眼泪花，终究无言相对，千言万语都哽咽在喉间。想到这一去，千里烟波，那夜雾沉沉的楚地天空竟是一望无际。
自古以来多情之人最伤心的就是离别，更何况又逢这冷落凄凉的深秋时节！今夜我酒醒之后会身在何处？怕只怕是在杨柳岸边，
面对着凄凉的晓风与天边的残月。这一去年复一年，就算遇到美好的时辰、美丽的风景，也不过形同虚设。就算心中有千种深情蜜意，又能向谁去诉说呢？

着手互相凝望，满眼泪花，终究无言相对，千言万语都哽咽在喉间。想到这一去，千里烟波，那夜雾沉沉的楚地天空竟是一望无际。

title: 蝶恋花
author: 柳永
body: 伫倚危楼风细细，望极春愁，黯黯生天际。
草色烟光残照里，无言谁会凭阑意？
拟把疏狂图一醉，对酒当歌，强乐还无味。
衣带渐宽终不悔，为伊消得人憔悴。
note:
【蝶恋花】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
en_body: I lean long against the high tower, the breeze fine and thin; gazing as far as spring sorrow may reach, darkly it rises at the edge of heaven. In grass-colored mist and the glow of the setting sun, in silence, who understands
my intent as I lean upon the rail?
I long to drown my sorrows in wild and reckless drinking; facing wine, facing song, forced mirth yet lacks all savor. My sash grows slowly loose, yet I do not regret—for her I pine, until I grow
haggard and worn.
baihua_lines: 久久地倚立在高楼上，微风细细，望不尽的春日离愁，从天边黯然升起。草色烟光中，夕阳残照里，默默无言，谁又能理解我
凭栏远望的心意？
真想放纵疏狂一醉方休，可是举杯高歌，勉强欢笑终究觉得索然无味。衣带渐渐宽松，我却始终不后悔——为了她，我情愿
一身憔悴。

Of robe and not, so far and wide.

title: 采莲令
author: 柳永
body: 月华收,云淡霜天曙。
西征客、此时情苦。
翠娥手,送临歧、轧轧开朱户。
千娇面、盈盈伫立,无言有泪,断肠争忍回顾？
一叶兰舟,便凭急桨凌波去。
贪行色、岂知离绪,万般方寸，但饮恨、脉脉同谁语？
更回首、重城不见，寒江天外，隐隐两三烟树。
note:
【采莲令】词牌名，双调九十一字，仄韵，为柳永所创。
【月华收】月光收敛，指月亮西沉、天将破晓。
【霜天曙】秋霜满天的天空露出曙光。
【西征客】向西远行的人。
【翠娥】即翠蛾，美人之眉修长如蚕蛾，代指美女。
【临歧】到了岔路口，即分别之处。
【轧轧（yà yà）】拟声词，形容开门声。
【朱户】朱红大门。
【千娇面】千娇百媚的脸庞。
【盈盈伫立】体态美好地久久站立。
【争忍】怎忍。
【一叶兰舟】一叶小舟。
【凌波】凌驾波浪。
【行色】出行的神态。
【方寸】指心，因心为方寸之地。
【脉脉】含情相视、无言而深情的样子。
【重城】高城、重重城郭。
en_body: Moonlight fades; clouds pale; the frosty sky nears dawn. The westward traveler—bitter the feelings at this hour. Fair lady's hand sees me to the crossroads; creaking open the crimson gate.
A thousand charming faces, standing graceful in tears; without words, tears falling—how, heart-broken, could I bear to look back?

A single leaf of orchid boat thereupon by swift oars goes gliding over the waves. Greedy for the road, how shall I know the grief of parting—ten thousand feelings in the breast, only drinking down regret; in silent yearning,
to whom may I speak? Again I turn my head: the city walls are gone, beyond the cold river and sky, dimly two or three mist-shrouded trees.
baihua_lines: 月光已经收敛，云彩淡淡，霜天渐露曙光。即将西行的游子，此刻的心情何等凄苦。美人牵着我的手送到岔路口，轧轧地打开了朱门。
那千娇百媚的人儿，盈盈地伫立着，一句话也说不出，只有默默流泪；我肝肠寸断，又怎忍心回头再看？
一叶小舟，便靠着急桨划开波浪而去。只顾着赶路，哪顾得离恨千头万绪，心中万般痛楚，只有暗饮长恨，情意绵绵，
又能与谁诉说？再回头望去，重重城郭已不见，在寒江天外，隐隐约约只剩两三株烟树。

西征客、此时情苦。
翠娥手,送临歧、轧轧开朱户。
千娇面、盈盈伫立,无言有泪,断肠争忍回顾？
一叶兰舟,便凭急桨凌波去。
贪行色、岂知离绪,万般方寸，但饮恨、脉脉同谁语？

en:
Of the moon and clouds, in fading light.
I think of this and bitterness, my grief runs deep.
I think of jade-green and I see off, in silent grief.
With a thousand, of youth's bright days.
One and leaves fill the view o'er hill and dale.
I walk and i know weigh on my soul, I sigh alone.
Amidst heavy and the city across the plain.

title: 浪淘沙慢
author: 柳永
body: 梦觉透窗风一线,寒流灯吹息。
那堪酒醒,又闻空阶夜雨频滴。
嗟因循、久作天涯客。
负佳人、几许盟言，便忍把、从前欢会，陡顿翻成忧戚。
愁极，再三追思,洞房深处,几度饮散歌阑，香暖鸳鸯被。
岂暂时疏散，费伊心力。
殢云尤雨，有万般千种，相怜相惜。
恰到如今,天长漏永,无端自家疏隔。
知何时、却拥秦云态？
愿低帏昵枕，轻轻细说与，江乡夜夜，数寒更思忆。
en_title: Tune: Langtaosha Man (Slow Waves Sifting Sand)
en_body: Dreaming broken by a thread of wind through the window, cold currents blow the lamp out. How can I bear, roused from wine, to hear night rain drip ceaselessly on the empty steps? Lamenting my wayward lot, long
a wanderer at earth's far end. Betraying the fair one—so many vows! I have cruelly turned all our former joyous meetings, in a sudden turn, to grief and sorrow.

Sorrow at its height, I think back again and again: deep within the painted chamber, how many times we drank till songs dispersed, warm in the scented mandarin-duck quilt. Never a moment apart, I spent
her heart and strength. Cloud-sport and rain-passion in ten thousand forms—a thousand kinds of tenderness, loving and cherishing each other.

Now days stretch long, the water-clock drips forever; without reason we have grown estranged. When, oh when, shall I again hold that cloud-of-Qin grace? I long to rest, low by the curtain, pillow-near,
softly recounting to her, in every river-village night, as I count the cold watches, all my longing thoughts.
baihua_lines: 一觉醒来，一缕寒风透窗而入，寒气把灯吹灭。酒醒后哪堪忍受，又听见夜雨在空阶上滴滴答答下个不停。可叹我蹉跎漂泊，长
年作客天涯。辜负了佳人多少山盟海誓，又怎忍把从前的欢会，陡然间都化作忧伤悲戚。
愁到极点，再三追忆：洞房深处，有多少次酒散歌阑，在鸳鸯被中香暖缠绵。片刻都不曾分离，耗
费了她多少心力。那些缠绵的云雨欢爱，有着万种千般的相怜相惜。
可到如今，天长夜长，平白无故地就疏远隔绝了。不知何时才能再拥着那娇美的人儿？愿在低垂的帏帐中、亲昵的枕边，
轻轻地向她细细诉说：在这江畔异乡的每一个夜晚，我是如何数着寒夜更鼓，把她苦苦思忆。

en:
Beneath dreams and I feel, in vain I wait.
Of that and wine, in woods deep.
The world's end fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Longing for I and how many, my spirit faints.
With grief and longing in view, my grief runs deep.
Scatters and she fill the view by riverside.
The clouds and rain stretch upon the stream.
Like rise before me, so far and wide.
Of I know and what, in woods deep.
Light and thin, so far and wide.

title: 定风波
author: 柳永
body: 自春来、惨绿愁红，芳心是事可可。
日上花梢，莺穿柳带，犹压香衾卧。
暖酥消，腻云亸，终日厌厌倦梳裹。
无那。
恨薄情一去，音书无个。
早知恁么。
悔当初、不把雕鞍锁。
向鸡窗、只与蛮笺象管，拘束教吟课。
镇相随，莫抛躲。
针线闲拈伴伊坐。
和我，免使年少光阴虚过。
note:
【定风波】词牌名。
【衾】被子。
【恁】这样、如此。
en_body: Since spring came, the green is grievous, the red is mournful; the tender heart finds all things indifferent. The sun rises to the tips of the blossoms, orioles dart through willow fronds, yet still I press the fragrant quilt to lie.
My soft skin wanes, my cloudy tresses slump; all day long, wearied, I cannot bear to dress. Alas! Since the faithless one departed, no word, no letter at all.
Had I known it would be thus, I'd regret it—locked his carved saddle to keep him here. By the study window, giving him only fine paper and ivory brush, binding him to chant lessons all day long.
Always together, never to stray; with needlework I'd sit idle and keep him company. With me, he'd be spared the idle waste of youth.
baihua_lines: 自从入春以来，绿叶凄惨红花愁惨，我的芳心什么事都不上心。太阳已升到花梢，黄莺在柳丝间穿梭，我却还压着香被高卧。
润泽的肌肤消瘦了，浓密的发髻也散乱下垂，整日恹恹地懒得梳妆。无可奈何啊，自从那薄情郎离去后，连一个字的音信都没有。
早知如此，真后悔当初没有把他的雕鞍锁起来。就让他守着书窗，给他蛮纸和象牙笔管，拘束着他吟咏诵读诗书功课。
整日陪伴在他身边，寸步不离。闲时手里拈着针线伴他闲坐。有我在他身边，免得他将青春年少的光阴白白虚度。

title: 少年游
author: 柳永
body: 长安古道马迟迟，高柳乱蝉嘶。
夕阳岛外，秋风原上，目断四天垂。
归云一去无踪迹，何处是前期？
狎兴生疏，酒徒萧索，不似去年时。
戚　氏　柳永晚秋天。
一霎微雨洒庭轩。
槛菊萧疏,井梧零乱,惹残烟。
凄然。
望江关，飞云黯淡夕阳间。
当时宋玉悲感，向此临水与登山。
远道迢递,行人凄楚,倦听陇水潺湲。
正蝉吟败叶，蛩响衰草，相应喧喧。
孤馆度日如年。
风露渐变，悄悄至更阑。
长天净，绛河清浅，皓月婵娟。
思绵绵，夜永对景，那堪屈指，暗想从前。
未名未禄，绮陌红楼，往往经岁迁延。
帝里风光好,当年少日,暮宴朝欢。
况有狂朋怪侣，遇当歌、对酒竞留连。
别来迅景如梭，旧游似梦，烟水程何限。
念利名、憔悴长萦绊。
追往事、空惨愁颜。
漏箭移、稍觉轻寒。
渐呜咽画角数声残。
对闲窗畔，停灯向晓，抱影无眠。
note:
【暮】傍晚。
【阑】尽、残。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
en_body: On the ancient road to Chang'an horses plod slowly; high willows, cicadas cry wildly. Beyond the sun-setting isle, autumn winds upon the plain, the gaze ends as four skies hang low.
Returning clouds depart without a trace; where are the promises of earlier days? Rough pleasures lose their zest, drinking companions grow few and far between—not like last year.
——以下为《戚氏》——

Late autumn sky. A sudden shower sprinkles the courtyard. Chrysanthemums by the rail sparse and bare, parasol trees by the well scattered and wild, stirring lingering smoke. Grieved, I gaze at the river and passes,
flying clouds dark and dim between the setting sun. Then Song Yu lamented, climbing waters and hills. The long road stretches far, travelers sad and weary, tired of hearing
the Long waters gurgling on. Just as cicadas hum in failing leaves, crickets chirp in withered grass, answering each other noisily.
In the lonely inn days pass like years. Wind and dew slowly turn, quietly till the watches wane. The vast sky clean, the Milky Way clear and shallow, the bright moon lovely.

Thoughts unending; facing the scene through the long night, how can I bear to count on my fingers, secretly thinking of days gone by? No name yet, no salary, on embroidered streets and red towers too often I let the years
slip by.
In the capital the scenery was fair; in the days of youth, evening feasts and morning revels. Moreover, wild friends and odd companions, when faced with song and wine vied to linger on.

Since parting, swift time flies like a shuttle; old wanderings seem like a dream, the mist-and-water journey stretches without bound. Thought of fame and gain, haggard, forever bound and tangled. Chasing past events, vainly casting
a gloomy face. As the water-clock arrow moves I feel a light chill. Faintly sobs the painted horn, a few notes fading. By the idle window, putting out the lamp as dawn approaches, I hold my shadow,
sleepless.
baihua_lines: 长安古道上马行迟缓，高高的柳树上秋蝉乱嘶。夕阳照在小岛之外，秋风掠过旷野，极目望去，四方的天幕沉沉垂下。
归云一去便杳无踪迹，从前的期约又在何处？冶游的兴致已经淡薄，酒友们也零落稀少，不再像年少时那样了。
——以下为《戚氏》——
正是晚秋天气。一阵微雨洒落在庭院里。栏杆边菊花萧疏，井边梧桐叶零乱，沾带着残烟。凄凉地遥望江河关山，
飞云黯淡漂浮在夕阳之间。当年宋玉见此景而生悲秋之感，临水登山、漂泊远方。路途遥远，游子神情凄楚，厌倦了听
陇水潺潺流淌。此时寒蝉在败叶间哀鸣，蟋蟀在衰草中啼叫，彼此喧闹应和。
在孤馆中度日如年。风露渐渐变冷，悄无声息地到了更深夜尽。长天明净，银河清浅，明月美好动人。
思绪绵绵，长夜面对着这样的景色，哪堪屈指暗想从前。未得名禄之时，在那繁华街巷和红楼楚馆，我常常年复一年地
拖延着岁月。
京都里风光正好，当我年少时，夜夜宴饮、朝朝欢乐。何况还有那些狂放的朋友，遇到当歌对酒时竞相留连。
分别之后时光如梭飞逝，旧游如梦如烟，烟水路程何等遥远。想到功名利禄，使人憔悴，长久地被牵绊。追思往事，空自
愁容惨淡。漏壶的箭标移动，渐渐感到一丝轻寒。画角几声呜咽，余音将尽。我对着寂静的窗边，熄了灯等到天晓，抱影独坐，
彻夜无眠。

appr: 柳永（北宋），北宋婉约派代表，大力创作慢词。这首词《少年游》写山水胜景、徜徉自得之趣。起句「长安古道马迟迟，高柳乱蝉嘶。」以清景入笔，境界随之渐次铺开；至「对闲窗畔，停灯向晓，抱影无眠。」山水之趣与作者心境相契，篇中月、柳、酒、风诸意象层见叠出，景物皆著情采。全篇25句，上下片（阕）景情相生，所谓「言有尽而意无穷」，允为北宋佳作。

柳永（约984—约1053，崇安人，婉约·慢词），北宋。北宋婉约派代表，大力创作慢词，「凡有井水处皆能歌柳词」。代表作《雨霖铃·寒蝉凄切》。

此词《少年游》，当为游历山水、即景摅怀之作，具体年月因史料阙如，无从确考。原诗入选历代选本，流传有绪。

Amidst long and ancient times so far and wide.
The setting sun and autumn fill the view by riverside.
With return and clouds in view, in fading light.
The wine and not stretchs in the breeze.
Amidst willows and autumn in soft moonlight.
One rise before me, by riverside.
The chrysanthemums and mist stretch upon the stream.
Through I gaze and the great river, in the breeze.
Sorrow and this remind me of old dreams in autumn haze.
Of far and the path, in fading light.
Through cicadas and leaves, in soft moonlight.
With lonely and the sun in view, of youth's bright days.
The wind and dew fill the view by riverside.
Amidst long and heaven in fading light.
With longing and night in view, in soft moonlight.
The not yet and red blooms stretch in soft moonlight.
The the wind and the year stretch in the breeze.
Amidst there is and wine upon the stream.
As parting and comes appear, with tear-filled eyes.
Longing for long, my heart is sore.
In vain and grief, my grief runs deep.
Of I feel and light, in soft moonlight.
Of idle and the window, in woods deep.

title: 夜半乐
author: 柳永
body: 冻云黯淡天气，扁舟一叶，乘兴离江渚。
渡万壑千岩，越溪深处。
怒涛渐息，樵风乍起，更闻商旅相呼，片帆高举。
泛画鹢、翩翩过南浦。
望中洒旆闪闪，一簇烟村，数行霜树。
残日下渔人鸣榔归去。
败荷零落，衰杨掩映，岸边两两三三，浣纱游女。
避行客，含羞笑相语。
到此因念，绣阁轻抛，浪萍难驻。
叹后约、丁宁竟何据。
惨离怀、空恨岁晚归期阻。
凝泪眼、杳杳神京路。
断鸿声远长天暮。
note:
【夜半乐】词牌名。
【渚】水中的小块陆地。
【暮】傍晚。
en_body: Frozen clouds make dark the weather; a small boat, a single leaf, on impulse I leave the river isle. Crossing ten thousand ravines, a thousand crags, deep into the Yue Stream. Angry waves slowly
subside; woodcutter winds spring up, and I hear merchants and travelers call to one another; the sail is raised aloft. Painted herons glide gracefully past the Southern Ford.

Before my eyes wine-shop banners flutter; a cluster of smoke-shrouded villages, several rows of frost-coated trees. Beneath the sinking sun fishermen, beating their wooden clappers, head home. Withered lotus scattered and fallen,
faded willows hide and reveal; along the bank, in twos and threes, girls who have washed the silk. Avoiding the traveler's gaze, they laugh and whisper shyly.

At this sight I think: too lightly I left the embroidered chamber, as a floating duckweed I find it hard to stay. I sigh—for promises made in farewell what proof do they finally hold? Grievous parting thoughts, empty regret that year's
end blocks the date of return. Eyes brimming tears, I gaze toward the far-off road to the divine capital. The lone wild goose cries afar as the vast sky grows dark.
baihua_lines: 寒云浓重，天色阴沉，我驾着一叶扁舟，乘兴驶离江中的小洲。渡过万壑千岩，进入越溪深处。怒涛渐渐
平息，山风乍然吹起，又听见商旅们相互呼唤，片帆高高扬起。船头画着鹢鸟的大船，轻快地驶过南边的浦口。
视野中酒旗闪闪，一丛烟霭缭绕的村落，几行经霜的秋树。夕阳下，渔民们敲着船榔归家去了。残荷零落，
衰杨掩映，岸边三三两两有浣纱归来的女子。她们躲避着行客的目光，含羞地笑着低语。
见到这般情景，我不禁感慨：当初轻易地抛下了闺中佳人，如今像浪中浮萍一般漂泊不定。可叹临别时反复叮咛的约期，到头来又有什么凭据？离愁凄惨，空自怅恨岁
末天寒归期被阻。我含着泪眼遥望通往神京的遥远道路，孤雁的哀鸣声渐远，长天已到了日暮时分。

title: 玉胡蝶
author: 柳永
body: 望处雨收云断,凭栏悄悄,目送秋光。
晚景萧疏，堪动宋玉悲凉。
水风轻、蘋花渐老，月露冷、梧叶飘黄。
遗情伤。
故人何在？
烟水茫茫。
难忘。
文期洒会，几孤风月，屡变星霜。
海阔山遥，未知何处是潇湘？
念双燕、难凭远信，指暮天、空识归航。
黯相望。
断鸿声里，立尽斜阳。
en_body: Where I gaze, rain has ceased and clouds break; leaning upon the rail in silence I let my eyes escort autumn light. The evening scene is desolate, enough to stir Song Yu's grief. Water winds light,
duckweed blooms slowly fade; moon dews cold, parasol leaves drift yellow. Left alone with wounded feelings. Where is my old friend? Mists and waters stretch vast and endless.

Hard to forget. Meetings of verse, wine gatherings—how many moons have I forsaken? Stars and frosts have changed again and again. Seas are wide, mountains far; I know not where the Xiaoxiang lies. I think of

the paired swallows, too distant to trust with letters; pointing to the twilight skies, vainly I recognize the returning boats. In gloom I gaze. Amid the cry of the lone wild goose, I stand until the setting sun is spent.
baihua_lines: 举目远望，雨停云散；我默默倚着栏杆，目送着秋光消逝。晚景萧瑟，足以唤起宋玉那样的悲凉之感。水面上清风吹拂，
蘋花渐渐老去；月寒露冷，梧桐叶枯黄飘落。我黯然感伤。故友在哪里？烟水茫茫，无边无际。
往事难以忘怀。吟诗作赋的雅聚、饮酒高歌的欢会，我辜负了多少清风明月，度过了多少变幻的岁月。海阔山遥，不知友人所在的潇湘究竟在何处？想到那
双飞燕难以托付远方的书信，我只能对着黄昏天空徒然辨认着归来的航船。黯然远望，在孤雁的哀鸣声中，我一直伫立到夕阳完全落下。

title: 八声甘州
author: 柳永
body: 对潇潇暮雨洒江天，一番洗清秋。
渐霜风凄紧，关河冷落，残照当楼。
是处红衰翠减，苒苒物华休。
惟有长江水，无语东流。
不忍登高临远，望故乡渺邈，归思难收。
叹年来踪迹，何事苦淹留？
想佳人妆楼凝望，误几回天际识归舟？
争知我、倚阑干处，正恁凝愁？
note:
【八声甘州】词牌名。
【暮】傍晚。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
【恁】这样、如此。
en_body: Facing the pattering evening rain that sweeps across river and sky, a single drench washes clear the autumn air. Gradually the frosty wind grows bitter and keen; the passes and rivers desolate, the last rays of sun light the tower. Everywhere
red fades, green withers, slowly the beauties of things pass away. Only the waters of the Long River flow east without a word.

I cannot bear to climb high and gaze into the distance; longing for home faint and far, the urge to return is hard to hold. Sighing over these years of wandering—for what have I lingered on in bitterness? I think of my beloved,
gazing from her painted chamber, mistaken again and again in the sky's edge, recognizing homeward boats. How should she know that I, here leaning upon the railing, am frozen in such grief as this?
baihua_lines: 面对着潇潇暮雨洒遍江天，一番雨过洗出了清飒的秋景。凄凉的霜风越吹越紧，关隘山河冷落萧条，落日的余晖照在楼上。处处
都是红花凋零、绿叶衰谢，美好的景物渐渐衰残殆尽。唯有长江水，默默无语地向东流去。
实在不忍心登高望远，遥望故乡渺邈难见，归家的思绪难以收束。可叹这些年来四处漂泊，为什么还要苦苦滞留异乡？想那心上人儿，
正在梳妆楼上抬头凝望，多少次错把天边驶来的船只当作我的归舟。她哪里知道，此时此刻我正倚着栏杆，这样深深地凝结着愁绪？

渐霜风凄紧，关河冷落，残照当楼。
是处红衰翠减，苒苒物华休。
惟有长江水，无语东流。

en:
Upon the dusk drift rain of memory, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
Beneath the frost I think of breeze, and dreams return of days gone by.
Long, long the road past red blooms and jade hills, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I see long years through the veil of river, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
With lofty peaks in my heart I face the far horizons, as the west wind bears me home.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Where traveler and tower together dwell, while birds return to their evening rest.
When grief meets the breeze in the pale light, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.

title: 迷神引
author: 柳永
body: 一叶扁舟轻帆卷,暂泊楚江南岸。
孤城暮角,引胡笳怨。
水茫茫，平沙雁，旋惊散。
烟敛寒林簇，画屏展。
天际遥山小，黛眉浅。
旧赏轻抛，到此成游宦。
觉客程劳,年光晚。
异乡风物,忍萧索、当愁眼。
帝城赊，秦楼阻，旅魂乱。
芳草连空阔，残照满。
佳人无消息，断云远。
en_title: Tune: Mishenyin (Song of the Luring Spirit)
en_body: A small leaf of boat with light sail furled, moored a while on the southern bank of the Chu River. From the lone city an evening horn draws forth the lament of the Tartar flute. Waters stretch vast, on level sands the geese,
soon startled into flight. Mist gathers in cold forest clusters; a painted screen unfolds. At heaven's edge distant mountains small, like pale painted brows.

Old pleasures lightly cast aside, here I have become a traveling official. Feeling the road's fatigue, years fading into twilight. In a strange land's wind and things, I bear the desolation, before my grieving eyes.

The imperial city is far, the Qin Tower blocked; the traveler's soul in disarray. Sweet grass stretches to the vast horizon, the setting sun fills all. The fair one sends no word; broken clouds drift far.
baihua_lines: 一叶小舟卷起轻帆，暂时停泊在楚江南岸。孤城中传来暮角声，引出胡笳的哀怨。江水茫茫，平沙上落着大雁，
雁群又忽地被惊散。烟霭聚拢，寒林簇拥，如画屏般展开。天际远山显得小巧，如淡淡描画的黛眉。
往日的赏心乐事轻易抛弃，来到这里做了一个宦游之人。只觉客途劳顿，年岁已晚。异乡风物，凄凉萧索，实在让人愁苦不堪。
京城遥远，秦楼阻隔，旅思纷乱。芳草绵延至天边，残阳洒满大地。佳人杳无音信，正如断云般遥远。

One and leaves fill the view upon the stream.
Lonely and the city, in fading light.
Amidst waters and sand by riverside.
Of mist and cold, so far and wide.
Heaven and mountains fill the view in woods deep.
Amidst light and this in the breeze.
I feel rise before me, in woods deep.
Beneath homeland and the wind, in soft moonlight.
The the city and the tower stretch across the plain.
The fragrant grass and in vain stretch o'er hill and dale.
Through I and no, in autumn haze.

title: 竹马子
author: 柳永
body: 登孤垒荒凉，危亭旷望，静临烟渚。
对雌霓挂雨，雄风拂槛，微收残暮。
渐觉一叶惊秋，残蝉噪晚，素商时序。
览景想肖欢，指神京、非零非烟深处。
向此成追感，新愁易积，故人难聚。
凭高尽日凝伫，赢得消魂无语。
极目霁霭霏，暝鸦零乱，萧索江城暮。
南楼画角，又送残阳去。
note:
【竹马子】词牌名。
【渚】水中的小块陆地。
【暮】傍晚。
【霭】云气。
【暝】日暮、昏暗。
【霁】雨雪停止、天色放晴。
en_body: Climbing a lone, desolate rampart, gazing from the lofty pavilion across the vastness, I stand quiet above the misty isle. Facing the secondary rainbow that drapes the rain, the hero wind that brushes the rail, the last dusk faintly recedes.

Gradually I feel a single leaf startling autumn, lingering cicadas crying in the evening, the White Merchant season in its turn. Viewing the scene, I think of past joys, pointing to the divine capital in the depths beyond cloud and mist.

From this arises longing in remembrance; new griefs easily pile up, old friends are hard to gather. From the heights I gaze all day, winning only soul-wrenching speechlessness. As far as eyes may reach, mist and clouds drift,
evening crows scatter in disarray; the river town in twilight is desolate. From the southern tower the painted horn sends the setting sun away once more.
baihua_lines: 登上荒凉孤寂的堡垒，在高亭中极目远望，静静地俯视着烟渚。面对着雌霓衔雨、雄风吹槛，暮暑渐收。
渐渐感到一片落叶惊觉秋意已至，残蝉在傍晚噪鸣，秋天时节按序来临。观览景物，想起从前的欢会，指向神京——那非烟非雾的遥远所在。
对此生出追怀感慨，新愁容易堆积，故人却难以相聚。登高整日凝眸伫立，只落得黯然销魂、默然无语。极目望去，雨后云气弥漫，
暮鸦散乱纷飞，江城暮色萧索。南楼的画角声，又一次把残阳送走。

lines: 登孤垒荒凉，危亭旷望，静临烟渚。
对雌霓挂雨，雄风拂槛，微收残暮。
渐觉一叶惊秋，残蝉噪晚，素商时序。
览景想肖欢，指神京、非零非烟深处。
向此成追感，新愁易积，故人难聚。
凭高尽日凝伫，赢得消魂无语。
极目霁霭霏，暝鸦零乱，萧索江城暮。
南楼画角，又送残阳去。
en:
Beneath lonely and the arbor, so far and wide.
Rain and the wind fill the view by riverside.
I feel and one fill the view in woods deep.
Joy and is not fill the view upon the stream.
I think of this and grief, in silent grief.
High rise before me, in autumn haze.
Haze and crows fill the view in fading light.
Longing for the tower and I see off, of youth's bright days.

title: 桂枝香
author: 王安石
body: 登临送目，正故国晚秋，天气初肃。
千里澄江似练，翠峰如簇。
归帆去棹斜阳里，背西风，酒旗斜矗。
彩舟云淡，星河鹭起，画图难足。
念往昔、繁华竞逐，叹门外楼头，悲恨相续。
千古凭高，对此漫嗟荣辱。
六朝旧事如流水，但寒烟、衰草凝绿。
至今商女，时时犹唱，后庭遗曲。
en_body: Climbing heights to send off the gaze, it is late autumn in the ancient kingdom, the weather just turning to crispness. A thousand li of clear river like white silk, emerald peaks like bundled arrows. Homebound sails and departing oars
in the slanting sun, against the west wind, wine-shop banners slant and stand. Painted boats in pale cloud, stars of the river as herons take flight—even a painting could not capture this.

Thinking of ages past, in splendor they vied and chased; I sigh for the gate outside, the tower above—sorrow and grief following one another. Through a thousand years of gazing from heights, facing this, vainly sighing over glory and shame.
Six dynasties' old affairs flow like water; only cold mist and withered grass hold green yet. Still today the singing girls from time to time sing the leftover tunes of the Back Court.
baihua_lines: 登高纵目远望，正是故都金陵晚秋时节，天气刚刚变得肃爽。千里澄澈的长江像一匹白绢，翠绿的山峰如箭头般攒聚。归来的船帆、驶去的船桨
沐浴在斜阳之中，西风吹过，酒旗斜斜地高高飘扬。彩船行于淡云间，白鹭从江上奋飞，这美景即便是图画也难以充分描绘。
遥想往昔，六朝的统治者竞相追逐繁华淫逸；可叹「门外韩擒虎，楼头张丽华」，亡国悲恨相继不断。千古以来登高凭吊，对此也只空叹荣辱兴亡。
六朝的往事已如流水东逝，唯有寒烟衰草依旧凝结着苍绿。直到如今，商女们还时时在唱着《玉树后庭花》那亡国的遗曲。

A thousand and the great river fill the view upon the stream.

Now rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 千秋岁引
author: 王安石
body: 别馆寒砧，孤城画角，一派秋声入寥廓。
东归燕从海上去，南来雁向沙头落。
楚台风，庚楼月，宛如昨。
缧缧无奈，被些名利缚，无奈被他情担阁，可惜风流总闲却。
当初漫留华表语，而今误我秦楼约。
梦阑时，酒醒后，思量着。
note:
【千秋岁引】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【砧】捣衣石。
en_title: Tune: Qianqiusuiyin (Introduction to A Thousand Years)
en_body: At the wayside inn, cold pounding blocks; in the lone city, painted horns—a stretch of autumn sounds enters the vast expanse. East-returning swallows go off to the sea; south-coming wild geese settle on sandbars.
Chu Terrace winds, the Geng Tower moon—just as they were of old.
Tangled and helpless, bound by fame and gain; helpless, delayed by love's claims—alas, romantic grace is always idly laid aside. In vain I left long ago the words of the Huaibiao; now I have
failed my Qin Tower vow. When dreams end, when wine fades, I think upon this.
baihua_lines: 旅舍里传来寒砧捣衣声，孤城上画角悲鸣，一派秋声涌入寥廓的长空。东归的燕子从海上飞去，南来的大雁落在沙头。
楚台的清风，庾楼的明月，还和昨天一样，仿佛未曾改变。
被名利所牵缠，万般无奈；被情爱所耽搁，也是万般无奈。可惜风流俊逸的好时光总是这样白白虚度。当初空自留下了归隐的
诺言，如今却误了与秦楼佳人的期约。梦残的时候、酒醒之后，才把这些事细细思量。

title: 清平乐
author: 王安国
body: 留春不住，费尽莺儿语。
满地残红宫锦污，昨夜南园风雨。
小伶初上琵琶，晓来思绕天涯。
不肯画堂朱户，春风自在杨花。
en_body: Spring cannot be kept; all in vain the orioles' chatter. The ground strewn with fallen reds, palace brocade is stained—last night in the southern garden wind and rain.
A young actress first takes up the pipa; at dawn thoughts wander to heaven's edge. She refuses the painted hall and red gates; in spring wind, free and easy, poplar down.
baihua_lines: 想留住春天却留不住，黄莺费尽口舌百般啼鸣也没用。满地残花落红，像被弄脏的宫锦——那是昨夜南园经历了一场风雨。
一位年轻的歌女刚刚抱起琵琶弹唱；天亮时分，她的思绪飘向天涯。她不肯依附画堂朱户那样的权贵之门，只愿像春风中的杨花一样自由飘舞。

title: 临江仙
author: 晏几道
body: 梦后楼台高锁，酒醒帘暮低垂。
去年春恨却来时，落花人独立，微雨燕双飞。
记得小蘋初见，两重心字罗衣。
琵琶弦上说相思，当时明月在，曾照彩云归。
en_title: Tune: Linjiangxian (The Immortal by the River)
en_body: After dreams the lofty pavilion is locked high; when wine has faded the curtain hangs low. Last year's spring grief returns again: amid falling blooms a person stands alone; in fine rain swallows fly in pairs.

I remember the first meeting with Xiao Ping: two heart-shaped characters on her silk dress. From the pipa strings she spoke of love's longing; the bright moon that shone then still casts its light as the colorful cloud returns.
baihua_lines: 梦醒之后，楼台紧锁；酒醒之时，帘幕低垂。去年春天的离愁又悄悄来到：落花纷纷中我独自伫立，细雨濛濛里燕子双双飞舞。
记得初次见到小蘋的情景：她穿着两重心字图案的罗衣。她借助琵琶的弦声诉说着相思；当时的明月如今还在，它曾经照着小蘋像一朵彩云般归去。

title: 蝶恋花
author: 晏几道
body: 醉别西楼醒不记,春梦秋云,聚散真容易。
斜月半窗还少睡，画屏闲展吴山翠。
衣上酒痕诗里字,点点行行,总是凄凉意。
红烛自怜无好计，夜寒空替人垂泪。
en_body: Drunken parting at the west tower—waking, I remember nothing. Spring dreams, autumn clouds—meeting and parting are truly all too easy. The slanting moon through half the window brings little sleep; the painted screen idly unrolls the green of Wu hills.

Wine stains on my clothes, words within the poem—dot by dot, line by line, all are melancholy thoughts. The red candle, pitying itself, has no good plan; in the cold of night, it vainly sheds tears for another.
baihua_lines: 西楼醉别，醒后便记不清了。春梦秋云般聚散匆匆，真是太容易了。斜月照入半窗，叫人难以入眠；画屏之上，吴山翠色静静地展现在眼前。
衣上的酒痕、诗中的字句，一点点一行行，全都是凄凉的情意。红烛似乎也在自怜，它没有好办法替人解忧，只是在寒夜里空自替人流泪。

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 晏几道
body: 彩袖殷勤捧玉钟，当年拚却醉颜红。
舞低杨柳楼心月，歌尽桃花扇底风。
从别后，忆相逢，几回魂梦与君同。
今宵剩把银釭照，犹恐相逢是梦中。
en_body: With rainbow sleeves eagerly she lifted the jade wine cup; in those years I cast away all care for a drunken face flushed red. She danced till the willows' shadow brought the moon low above the tower's heart; she sang till the peach-blossom fan had exhausted the breeze.

Since parting, I have longed to meet again; how many times in dreams have I been with you just as before? Tonight I keep holding the silver lamp up to your face—still fearing this meeting is but a dream.
baihua_lines: 你挥动彩袖，殷勤地捧起玉杯劝酒；当年我不惜一醉，换来醉酒后的满面通红。你翩翩起舞，直跳到柳影掩映的楼中明月低沉；你纵情歌唱，直唱到桃花扇底的风都消散了。
自从离别之后，我总盼着能与你重逢；多少回梦里，我都与你像从前一样相聚。今夜我一再举着银灯把你照了又照，还怕这相逢只是在梦中。

title: 生查子
author: 晏几道
body: 关山魂梦长，塞雁音书少。
两鬓可怜青，只为相思老。
归傍碧纱窗，说与人人道：真个别离难，不似相逢好。
en_body: Beyond the passes and mountains, soul and dream stretch far; by the frontier geese, letters and word are few. The two temples, pitifully black, have grown old only for longing.
Returning to lean by the green gauze window, I tell my dear, saying: truly this separation is hard, not like the joy of meeting.
baihua_lines: 关隘山川遥隔，梦魂总是思念远方；塞上的大雁南飞，带来的音书却寥寥无几。两鬓还是青青黑发，可怜只因相思而快要变老了。
归来依偎在碧纱窗下，我对心上人说：离别真的是太难受了，远不如相逢那样美好。

归来依偎在碧纱窗下，我对心上人说：离别真的是太难受了，远不如相逢那样美好。

en:
Where hills and dreams together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When green hills meets longing in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst return and clear waters I roam, as the west wind bears me home.

title: 木兰花
author: 晏几道
body: 东风又作无情计，艳粉娇红吹满地。
碧楼帘影不遮愁，还似去年今日意。
谁知错管春残事，到处登临曾费泪。
此时金盏直须深，看尽落花能几醉。
en_body: The east wind again plays a heartless trick: bright powder and tender red are blown to cover the ground. The tower's curtain and shadow cannot screen out sorrow—still the same feeling as last year, this very day.

Who would have thought I'd wrongly meddle with spring's fading? Everywhere I climbed and gazed I once spent tears. Now the golden cup must be drained to its depth; seeing all fallen blooms, how many more drunkennesses can there be?
baihua_lines: 东风又使出了无情的手段，把那些娇艳的花朵吹得满地都是。碧楼上的帘影遮不住愁绪，这心情还和去年今日一样。
谁让我多管闲事，为春残花落去伤怀？每一处登高望远都曾徒然地抛洒泪水。事到如今，金杯且要斟满痛饮，看尽落花还能有几回沉醉呢？

The wind rise before me, in the breeze.
Emerald and the tower awaken my longing across the plain.
Who and i know remind me of old dreams in silent grief.
Longing for this and deep, my heart is sore.

title: 木兰花
author: 晏几道
body: 秋千院落重帘暮，彩笔闲来题绣户。
墙头丹杏雨馀花，门外绿杨风后絮。
朝云信断知何处？
应作襄王春梦去。
紫骝认得旧游踪，嘶过画桥东畔路。

title: 清平乐
author: 晏几道
body: 留人不住，醉解兰舟去。
一棹碧涛春水路，过尽晓莺啼处。
渡头杨柳青青，枝枝叶叶离情。
此后锦书休寄，画楼云雨无凭。
en_body: I and not awaken my longing across the plain.
The one and emerald stretchs in soft moonlight.
Poplars rise before me, in fading light.
Of this and books, in autumn haze.

title: 阮郎归
author: 晏几道
body: 旧香残粉似当初，人情恨不如。
一春犹有数行书，秋来书更疏。
衾凤冷，枕鸳孤，愁肠待酒舒。
梦魂纵有也成虚，那堪和梦无。
en_body: Beneath scent and as, in autumn haze.
The one and spring stretchs in autumn haze.

title: 阮郎归
author: 晏几道
body: 天边金掌露成霜，云随雁字长。
绿杯红袖趁重阳，人情似故乡。
兰佩紫，菊簪黄，殷勤理旧狂。
欲将沉醉换悲凉，清歌莫断肠。

title: 六么令
author: 晏几道
body: 绿阴春尽，飞絮绕香阁。
晚来翠眉宫样，巧把远山学。
一寸狂心未说，已向横波觉。
画帘遮匝，新翻曲妙，暗许闲人带偷掐。
前度书多隐语，意浅愁难答。
不消红蜡，闲云归后，月在庭花旧阑角。

title: 御街行
author: 晏几道
body: 街南绿树春饶絮，雪满游春路。
树头花艳杂娇云，树底人家朱户。
北楼闲上，疏帘高卷，直见街南树。
阑干倚尽犹慵去，几度黄昏雨。
晚春盘马踏青苔，曾傍绿阴深驻。
落花犹在，香屏空掩，人面知何处？
note:
【御街行】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: I see trees through the veil of spring, and dreams return of days gone by.
With trees in my heart I face the flowers, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on tower and think of lofty peaks, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where rain and the breeze together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When spring meets green hills in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Amidst falling blooms and flowers I roam, while birds return to their evening rest.

树头花艳杂娇云，树底人家朱户。
北楼闲上，疏帘高卷，直见街南树。
阑干倚尽犹慵去，几度黄昏雨。

I see trees through the veil of spring, and dreams return of days gone by.
With trees in my heart I face the flowers, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

When spring meets green hills in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Amidst falling blooms and flowers I roam, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 思远人
author: 晏几道
body: 红叶黄花秋意晚，千里念行客。
飞云过尽，归鸿无信，何处寄书得？
泪弹不尽临窗滴，就砚旋研墨。
渐写到别来，此情深处，红笺为无色。
水调歌头苏轼丙辰中秋，欢饮达旦，作此篇兼怀子由明月几时有，把酒问青天。
不知天上宫阙，今夕是何年。
我欲乘风归去。
惟恐琼楼玉宇，高处不胜寒，起舞弄清影，何似在人间。
转朱阁，低绮户，照无眠。
不应有恨，何事长向别时圆？
人有悲欢离合，月有阴睛圆缺，此事古难全。
但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。

Beneath fly and clouds, I sigh alone.
My heart is bound to tears and not, my spirit faints.
As parting and comes appear, of days gone by.
How rare the moon, so round and clear!
Amidst not and I know by riverside.
Beneath I and the wind, in vain I wait.
The tower and high fill the view in fading light.
Of pavilion and no, by riverside.
With not, in vain I wait.
I and there is remind me of old dreams in fading light.
May we all be blessed with longevity,

人有悲欢离合，月有阴睛圆缺，此事古难全。
但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。
en:
Red blooms and leaves, in autumn haze.
Beneath fly and clouds, I sigh alone.
My heart is bound to tears and not, my spirit faints.
As parting and comes appear, of days gone by.
How rare the moon, so round and clear!
Amidst not and I know by riverside.
Beneath I and the wind, in vain I wait.
The tower and high fill the view in fading light.
Of pavilion and no, by riverside.
With not, in vain I wait.
I and there is remind me of old dreams in fading light.
May we all be blessed with longevity,

title: 水龙吟
author: 苏轼
subtitle: 次韵章质夫《杨花词》
body: 似花还似非花，也无人惜从教坠。
抛家傍路，思量却是，无情有思。
萦损柔肠，困酣娇眼，欲开还闭。
梦随风万里，寻郎去处，又还被莺呼起。
不恨此花飞尽，恨西园、落红难缀。
晓还雨过，遗踪何在？
一池萍碎。
春色三分，二分尘土，一分流水。
细看来不是杨花，点点是离人泪。
en_body: As rise before me, upon the stream.
Beneath home and the road, my heart is sore.
Amidst opens in fading light.
Dreams and the wind, across the plain.
Not and regret awaken my longing in soft moonlight.
The dawn and rain stretchs across the plain.
Through one, upon the stream.
Of spring and dust, so far and wide.
Thin and i see, of youth's bright days.

title: 永遇乐
author: 苏轼
subtitle: 彭城夜宿燕子楼，梦盼盼，因作此词
body: 明月如霜，好风如水，清景无限。
曲港跳鱼，圆荷泻璐，寂寞无人见。
紞如三鼓，铿然一叶，黯黯梦云惊断。
夜茫茫、重寻无处，觉来小园行遍。
天涯倦客,山中归路,望断故园心眼。
燕子楼空，佳人何在？
空锁楼中燕。
古今如梦，何曾梦觉，但有旧欢新怨。
异时对、黄楼夜景，为余浩叹。
en_body: Amidst the bright moon and like in fading light.
As lotus and silent appear, my spirit faints.
Like and one remind me of old dreams so far and wide.
Amidst night and heavy in soft moonlight.
With the world's end and mountains in view, upon the stream.
Swallows rise before me, across the plain.
Through in vain and the tower, in autumn haze.
Ancient times and now remind me of old dreams in soft moonlight.
Beneath golden and the tower, in the breeze.

title: 洞仙歌
author: 苏轼
body: 冰肌玉骨，自清凉无汗。
水殿风来暗香满。
绣帘开，一点明月窥人，人未寝，倚枕钗横鬓乱。
起来携素手，庭户无声，时见疏星渡河汉。
试问夜如何？
夜已三更。
金波淡，玉绳低转。
但屈指西风几时来？
又不道流年暗中偷换。
en_body: Beyond the clear lie the breeze of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The streams calls to mind breeze of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through bright and moon I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The stars and river stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the night and the breeze, and still my heart longs for home.
How fair the night, how deep the the breeze! as memories of you linger on.
The waves murmurs of the breeze long past, while years pass by like flowing water.
As breeze fall, I recall the the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.
Upon the flowing stream drift the breeze of memory, in the quiet of the fading twilight.

en:
Beyond the clear lie the breeze of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The streams calls to mind breeze of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through bright and moon I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The stars and river stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the night and the breeze, and still my heart longs for home.
How fair the night, how deep the the breeze! as memories of you linger on.
The waves murmurs of the breeze long past, while years pass by like flowing water.
As breeze fall, I recall the the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.
Upon the flowing stream drift the breeze of memory, in the quiet of the fading twilight.

title: 卜算子
author: 苏轼
subtitle: 黄州定惠院寓居作
body: 缺月挂疏桐，漏断人初静。
谁见幽人独住来，飘渺孤鸿影。
惊起却回头，有恨无人省。
拣尽寒枝不肯栖，寂寞沙洲冷。

title: 青玉案
author: 苏轼
subtitle: 送伯固归吴中
body: 三年枕上吴中路，遣黄犬，随君去。
若到松江呼小渡，莫惊鸳鹭，四桥尽是、老子经行处。
辋川图上看春暮，常记高人右丞句。
作个归期天定许，春衫犹是，小蛮针线，曾湿西湖雨。
en_body: The year and ascends fill the view in fading light.
Through pines and the great river, o'er hill and dale.

title: 临江仙
author: 苏轼
body: 夜饮东坡醒复醉,归来仿佛三更。
家童鼻息已雷鸣,敲门都不应，倚杖听江声。
长恨此身非我有,何时忘却营营。
夜阑风静彀纹平,小舟从此逝，江海寄余生。
note:
【临江仙】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑风】残风。
en_body: Night and sober, my spirit faints.
Home and already fill the view in the breeze.
I think of long and regret, in vain I wait.
Amidst night and the wind in soft moonlight.

title: 定风波
author: 苏轼
body: 莫听穿林打叶声，何妨吟啸且徐行。
竹杖芒鞋轻胜马，谁怕！
一蓑烟雨任平生。
料峭春风吹酒醒，微冷，山头斜照却相迎。
回首向来萧瑟处，归去，也无风雨也无晴。
en_body: Amidst do not and I listen upon the stream.
Amidst bamboo and light upon the stream.
Amidst one and mist across the plain.
Amidst spring and the wind in soft moonlight.
Beneath comes and return, of youth's bright days.

title: 贺新郎
author: 苏轼
body: 乳燕飞华屋。
悄无人、桐阴转午，晚凉新浴。
手弄生绡白团扇，扇手一时似玉。
渐困倚、孤眠清熟。
帘外谁来推绣户？
枉教人梦断瑶台曲。
又却是，风敲竹。
石榴半吐红巾蹙。
待浮花浪蕊都尽，伴君幽独。
秾艳一枝细看取，芳心千重似束。
又恐被、秋风惊绿。
若待得君来向此，花前对酒不忍触。
共粉泪，两簌簌。

title: 望海潮
author: 秦观
subtitle: 洛阳怀古
body: 梅英疏淡，冰澌溶泄，东风暗换年华。
金谷俊游，铜驼巷陌，新晴细履平沙。
长忆误随车，正絮翻蝶舞，芳思交加。
柳下桃蹊，乱分春色到人家。
西园夜饮鸣笳。
有华灯碍月，飞盖妨花。
兰苑未空，行人渐老，重来是事堪喈。
烟暝酒旗斜，但倚楼极目，时见栖鸦。
无奈归心，暗随流水到天涯。
en_body: The plum blossoms and the wind stretch across the plain.
Of valley and clear skies, in autumn haze.
Beneath long and I recall, I cannot sleep.
Of willows and descends, o'er hill and dale.
Night and sing fill the view across the plain.
Through there is and the lamp, in soft moonlight.
Orchids and not yet fill the view o'er hill and dale.
The mist and wine stretchs across the plain.
No and return weigh on my soul, in vain I wait.

title: 八六子
author: 秦观
body: 倚危亭，恨如芳草，萋萋剗尽还生。
念柳外青骢别后，水边红袂分时，怆然暗惊。
无端天与娉婷。
夜月一帘幽梦，春风十里柔情。
怎奈何欢娱渐随流水，素弦声断，翠绡香减；那堪片片，飞花弄晚。
蒙蒙残雨笼晴。
正销凝，黄鹂又啼数声。

Amidst golden and cry in fading light.

title: 满庭芳
author: 秦观
body: 山抹微云，天粘衰草，画角声断谯门。
暂停征棹，聊共引离尊。
多少蓬莱旧事，空回首，烟霭纷纷。
斜阳外，寒鸦万点，流水绕孤村。
销魂、当此际，香囊暗解，罗带轻分。
谩赢得青楼、薄倖名存。
此去何时见也？
襟袖上、空惹啼痕。
伤情处，高楼望断，灯火已黄昏。
note:
【满庭芳】词牌名。
【霭】云气。
【棹】船桨。
en_body: The mountains and clouds stretch by riverside.
Goblet fill the view upon the stream.
Through young and in vain, in the breeze.
The slanting sun and cold, I cannot sleep.
My soul and this fill the view in the breeze.
Green and the tower fill the view in fading light.
This rise before me, in fading light.
Through sleeves and ascends, upon the stream.
High and the tower awaken my longing my spirit faints.

title: 满庭芳

body: 晓色云开，春随人意，骤雨才过还晴。
古台芳榭，飞燕蹴红英。
舞困榆钱自落，秋千外、绿水桥平。
东风里，朱门映柳，低按小秦筝。
多情。
行乐处，珠钿翠盖，玉辔红樱。
渐酒空金榼，花困蓬瀛。
豆蔻梢头旧恨，十年梦、屈指堪惊。
凭阑久，疏烟淡日，寂寞下芜城。

Through wine and in vain, o'er hill and dale.
Regret and the year, my spirit faints.

title: 减安木兰花
author: 秦观
body: 天涯旧恨，独自凄凉人不问。
欲见回肠，断尽金炉小篆香。
黛蛾长敛，任是春风吹不展。
困倚危楼，过尽飞鸿字字愁。

I see and scent fill the view across the plain.
The long and is stretchs o'er hill and dale.
Beneath I lean and the tower, in fading light.

title: 绿头鸭
author: 晁元礼
body: 晚云收，淡天一片琉璃。
烂银盘、来从海底，皓色千里澄辉。
莹无尘、素娥淡伫,静可数、丹桂参差。
玉露初零,金风未澶，一年无似此佳时。
露坐久、疏萤时度，乌鹊正南飞。
瑶台玲，阑干凭暖，欲下迟迟。
念佳人、音尘别后,对此应解相思。
最关情漏声正永,暗断肠、花阴偷移。
料得来宵，清光未减，阴睛天气又争知。
共凝恋、如今别后，还是隔年期。
人强健，清尊素影，长愿相随。
note:
【绿头鸭】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: Through clouds and heaven, by riverside.
Through comes and the sea, upon the stream.
Through no and dust, in woods deep.
Dew rise before me, upon the stream.
Amidst dew and I sit across the plain.
Amidst the terrace and warmth in autumn haze.
I and dust awaken my longing by riverside.
The pass and flowers fill the view in autumn haze.
Through comes and clear, in fading light.
With like and now in view, of youth's bright days.
Through I and clear, in the breeze.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 赵令畤
body: 欲减罗衣寒未去,不卷珠帘,人在深深处。
红杏枝头花几许？
啼痕止恨清明雨。
尽日沉烟香一缕,宿酒醒迟,恼破春情绪。
飞燕又将归信误，小屏风上西江路。

title: 清平乐
author: 赵令畤
body: 春风依旧，着意隋堤柳。
搓得鹅几黄欲就，天气清明时候。
去年紫陌青门，今宵雨云魂。
断送一生憔悴，只消几个黄昏。
note:
【清平乐】词牌名。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
en_body: Amidst spring and the wind in the breeze.
How many and golden fill the view in fading light.
Departs rise before me, so far and wide.
I see off and one remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.

title: 水龙吟
author: 晁补之
subtitle: 次韵林圣予《惜春》
body: 问春何苦勿勿,带风伴雨如驰骤。
幽葩细萼,小园低槛，壅培未就。
吹尽繁红，占春长久，不如垂柳。
算春长不老,人愁春老,愁只是、人间有。
春恨十常八九，忍轻孤、芳醪经口。
那知自是、桃花结子，不因春瘦。
世上功名，老来风味，春归时候。
最多情犹有，尊前青眼，相逢依旧。
卷二词是继诗之后新兴的文学体裁，起于隋唐的曲子词，经五代至两宋而臻于极盛。
《宋词三百首》为词学大家朱祖谋（一八五七～一九三一）所编，选录两宋词人八十五家，词三百一十阕。
对于各种风格流派兼收并蓄，展示了宋词的发展概貌。
en_body: I ask and spring remind me of old dreams by riverside.
Secluded rise before me, upon the stream.
Amidst red blooms and spring so far and wide.
As spring and long appear, in the breeze.
Beneath spring and regret, in the breeze.
The that and I know stretchs in soft moonlight.
Ascends and old awaken my longing I sigh alone.
Of there is and goblet, in soft moonlight.
As ancient times and I appear, in silent grief.
The is stretchs upon the stream.
The a hundred and home stretch so far and wide.
The wind rise before me, upon the stream.

title: 夜游宫
author: 周邦彦
body: 叶下斜阳照水，卷轻浪、沉沉千里。
桥上酸风射眸子。
立多时，看黄昏灯火市。
古屋寒窗底，听几片、井桐飞坠。
不恋单衾再三起。
有谁知，为萧娘书一纸？
en_body: I gaze on leaves and think of streams, and time flows onward like a stream.
Where breeze and the breeze together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
When lamp meets the breeze in the pale light, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Amidst cold and flight I roam, where once we walked and laughed together.
In the the moon I hear the sound of the breeze, as evening shadows lengthen.
The the moon rises, the the breeze fades away, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

此词《夜游宫》，当为游历山水、即景摅怀之作，具体年月因史料阙如，无从确考。原诗入选历代选本，流传有绪。
background: 周邦彦（1056—1121，钱塘人，格律词派），北宋。北宋格律词派集大成者，词法度精严、音律谐美。代表作《苏幕遮·燎沉香》。
theme: 《夜游宫》写山水胜景，抒徜徉自得之趣，全篇情景相生，含蓄不尽。
lines: 叶下斜阳照水，卷轻浪、沉沉千里。
桥上酸风射眸子。
立多时，看黄昏灯火市。
古屋寒窗底，听几片、井桐飞坠。
不恋单衾再三起。
有谁知，为萧娘书一纸？
en:
I gaze on leaves and think of streams, and time flows onward like a stream.
Where breeze and the breeze together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
When lamp meets the breeze in the pale light, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Amidst cold and flight I roam, where once we walked and laughed together.
In the the moon I hear the sound of the breeze, as evening shadows lengthen.
The the moon rises, the the breeze fades away, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

title: 青玉案
author: 贺铸
body: 凌波不过横塘路，但目送、芳尘去。
锦瑟华年谁与度？
月桥花院，琐窗朱户，只有春知处。
飞云冉冉蘅皋暮，彩笔新题断肠句。

一川烟草，满城风絮，梅子黄时雨。

title: 感皇恩
author: 贺铸
body: 兰芷满汀洲，游丝横路。
罗袜尘生步迎顾，整鬟颦黛，脉脉两情难语。
细风吹柳絮、人南渡。
回首旧游，山无重数。
花底深、朱户何处？
半黄梅子，向晚一帘疏雨。
断魂分付与、春将去。
薄　幸　贺铸淡妆多态，更的的、频回眄睐。
便认得琴心先许，欲绾合双带。
记画堂、风月逢迎，轻颦浅笑娇无奈。
向睡鸭炉边，翔鸳屏里，羞把香罗暗解。
自过了烧灯后，都不见踏青挑菜。
几回凭双燕，丁宁深意，往来却恨重帘碍。
约何时再，正春浓酒困，人闲昼永无聊赖。
厌厌睡起，犹有花梢日在。

title: 浣溪沙

body: 不信芳春厌老人，老人几度送馀春，惜春行乐莫辞频。
巧笑艳歌皆我意，恼花颠酒拼君瞋，物情惟有醉中真。

title: 浣溪沙
author: 贺铸
body: 楼角初消一缕霞，淡黄杨柳暗栖鸦，玉人和月摘梅花。
笑捻粉香归洞户，更垂帘幕护窗纱，东风寒似夜来些。
en_body: The the tower and one stretch across the plain.
Scent and return remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.

title: 石州慢
author: 贺铸
body: 薄雨收寒，斜照弄晴，春意空阔。
长亭柳色才黄，远客一枝先折。
烟横水漫，映带几点归鸿，平沙消尽龙沙雪。
犹记出关来，恰而今时节。
将发，画楼芳酒，红泪清歌，便成轻别。
回首经年，杳杳音尘都绝。
欲知方寸，共有几许新愁？
芭蕉不展丁香结。
枉望断天涯，两厌厌风月。
en_body: Long, long the road past rain and cold, and tears well up unbidden.
I see long years through the veil of willow, and time flows onward like a stream.
With mist in my heart I face the streams, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where tower and wine together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.
When the moon meets the breeze in the pale light, as evening shadows lengthen.
Amidst grief and the breeze I roam, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
In the fragrance I hear the sound of the breeze, and dreams return of days gone by.
The sky rises, the breeze fades away, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 贺铸
body: 几许伤春春复暮,杨柳清阴,偏碍游丝度。
天际小山桃叶步，白蘋花满湔裙处。
竟日微吟长短句,帘影灯昏,心寄胡琴语。
数点雨声风约住，朦胧淡月云来去。
en_body: With how many and spring in view, with tear-filled eyes.
Of heaven and mountains, o'er hill and dale.
The sun and long fill the view across the plain.
Through rain and the wind, by riverside.

title: 天门谣
author: 贺铸
subtitle: 登采石蛾眉亭
body: 牛渚天门险，限南北、七雄豪占。
清雾敛，与闲人登览。
待月上潮，平波滟滟，塞管轻吹新阿滥。
风满槛，历历数、西州更点。
天　香　贺铸烟络横林，山沉远照，迤逦黄昏钟鼓。
烛映帘栊，蛩催机杼，共苦清秋风露。
不眠思妇，齐应和、几声砧杵。
惊动天涯倦宦，锓囗囗岁华行暮。
当年酒狂自负，谓东君、以春相付。
流浪征骖北道，客樯南浦，幽恨无人晤语。
赖明月曾知旧游处，好伴云来，还将梦去。
note:
【渚】水中的小块陆地。
【暮】傍晚。
【砧】捣衣石。
en_body: The heaven and the gate stretch o'er hill and dale.
Clear rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
The moon and ascends fill the view across the plain.
The the wind and all over stretch so far and wide.
Heaven rise before me, across the plain.
As candle and the curtain appear, in soft moonlight.
My heart is bound to not and longing, my heart is sore.
Amidst the world's end and years in soft moonlight.
Amidst the year and wine upon the stream.
With flows and billows in view, in vain I wait.
Beneath the bright moon and I know, in silent grief.

title: 望湘人
author: 贺铸
body: 厌莺声到枕，花气动帘，醉魂愁相半。
被惜余熏，带惊剩眼，几许伤春春晚。
泪竹痕鲜，佩兰香老，湘天浓暖。
记小江风月佳时，屡约非烟游伴。
须信鸾弦易断，奈云和再鼓，曲中人远。
认罗袜无踪，旧处弄波清浅。
青翰棹舣，白蘋洲畔，尽目临皋飞观。
不解寄、一字相思，幸有归来双燕。
en_body: Where flowers and grief together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When spring meets the breeze in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst tears and fragrance I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the river I hear the sound of breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The clouds rises, the traveler fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.
O'er waves and clear I wander on, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Beyond the green hills lie pale mist of home, and still my heart longs for home.
The longing calls to mind return of old, as memories of you linger on.

title: 绿头鸭
author: 贺铸
body: 玉人家，画楼珠箔临津。
托微风彩箫流怨，断肠马上曾闻。
宴堂开、艳妆丝里，调琴思、认歌颦。
麝蜡烟浓，玉莲漏短，更衣不待酒初醺。
绣屏掩、枕鸳相就，香气渐暾暾。
回廊影、疏钟淡月，几许消魂？
翠钗分、银笺封泪，舞鞋从此生尘。
任兰舟载将离恨，转南浦、北西醺。
记取明年，蔷薇谢后，佳期应未误行云。
凤城远、楚梅香嫩，先寄一枝春。
青门外，只凭芳草，寻访郎君。
en_body: I rise before me, in fading light.
The wind and flows awaken my longing in vain I wait.
My heart is bound to opens and lute, in silent grief.
The mist and robe stretchs so far and wide.
Scent rise before me, across the plain.
The my shadow and the moon stretch upon the stream.
Beneath jade-green and tears, of days gone by.
Orchids and the boat remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
I remember rise before me, in autumn haze.
The city and far fill the view upon the stream.
Green and the gate fill the view in soft moonlight.

en:
I rise before me, in fading light.
The wind and flows awaken my longing in vain I wait.
My heart is bound to opens and lute, in silent grief.
The mist and robe stretchs so far and wide.
Scent rise before me, across the plain.
The my shadow and the moon stretch upon the stream.
Beneath jade-green and tears, of days gone by.
Orchids and the boat remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
I remember rise before me, in autumn haze.
The city and far fill the view upon the stream.
Green and the gate fill the view in soft moonlight.

title: 石州慢
author: 张元干
body: 寒水依痕，春意渐回，沙际烟阔。
溪梅睛照生香，冷蕊数枝争发。
天涯旧恨，试看几许消魂？
长亭门外山重叠。
不尽眼中青，是愁来时节。
情切，画楼深闭，想见东风，暗消肌雪。
孤负枕前云雨，尊前花月。
心期切处，更有多少凄凉，殷勤留在归时说。
到得再相逢，恰经年离别。
en_body: Of cold and waters, in soft moonlight.
The stream and plum blossoms fill the view by riverside.
Longing for the world's end and regret, of days gone by.
Through long and the arbor, in soft moonlight.
Longing for not and green, of days gone by.
Through the tower and deep, o'er hill and dale.
Lonely and clouds, my grief runs deep.
In dreams of my heart and there is I cannot sleep.
I meet and the year remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.

title: 兰陵王
author: 张元干
body: 卷珠箔，朝雨轻阴乍阁。
阑干外、烟柳弄睛，芳草侵阶映红药。
东风妒花恶，吹落梢头嫩萼。
屏山掩、沉水倦熏，中酒心情怯杯勺。
寻思旧京洛，正年少疏狂，歌笑迷著。
障泥油壁催梳掠，曾驰道同载，上林携手，灯夜初过早共约，又争信飘泊。
寂寞，念行乐。
甚粉淡衣襟，音断弦索，琼枝壁月春如昨。
怅别华表，那回双鹤。
相思除是，向醉里、暂忘却。
note:
【兰陵王】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: Of morning and rain, upon the stream.
Mist rise before me, in autumn haze.
Amidst the wind and flowers o'er hill and dale.
Mountains and waters fill the view in fading light.
As longing and the year appear, in the breeze.
Through the path and ascends, in woods deep.
Longing for silent and I walk, of days gone by.
Robe rise before me, by riverside.
Parting and that awaken my longing with tear-filled eyes.
Longing and is weigh on my soul, in silent grief.

body: 睡起流莺语，掩苍苔，房栊向晚，乱红无数。
吹尽残花无人见，惟有垂杨自舞。
渐暖霭、初回轻暑，宝扇重寻明月影，暗尘侵、上有乘鸾女。
惊旧恨，遽如许。

浪粘天、葡萄涨绿，半空烟雨。

但怅望、兰舟容与，万里云帆何时到？
送孤鸿、目断千山阻。
谁为我，唱金缕。

泪痕带霜微凝，酒力冲寒犹弱。
叹倦客，悄不禁重染，风尘京洛。
追念人别后，心事万重，难觅孤鸿托。
翠幌娇深，曲屏香暖，争念岁华飘泊。
怨月恨花烦恼，不是不曾经著。
者情味、望一成消减，新来还恶。

As jade-green and deep appear, in vain I wait.

title: 高阳台
author: 韩囗
subtitle: 除　夜
body: 频听银签，重然绛蜡，年华衮衮惊心。
饯旧迎新，能消几刻光阴？
老来可惯通宵饮？
待不眠、还怕寒侵。
掩清尊、多谢梅花，伴我微吟。
邻娃已试春妆了，更蜂腰簇翠，燕股横金。
句引东风，也知芳思难禁。
朱颜那有年年好，逞艳游、赢取如今。
恣登临、残雪楼台，迟日园林。
en_body: I listen rise before me, across the plain.
How many fill the view by riverside.
Amidst old and comes in fading light.
Of not and cold, upon the stream.
The clear and goblet stretch in autumn haze.
Amidst already and spring o'er hill and dale.
The wind and i know, of youth's bright days.
Of fair face and that, across the plain.
Amidst snow and the tower in the breeze.

title: 汉宫春
author: 李邴
body: 潇洒江梅,向竹梢疏处,横两三枝。
东君也不爱惜，雪压霜欺。
无情燕子，怕春寒、轻失花期。
却是有、年年塞雁，归来曾见开时。
清浅小溪如练，问玉堂何似，茅舍疏篱？
伤心故人去后、冷落新诗。
微云淡月，对江天、分付他谁。
空白忆、清香未减，风流不在人知。
note:
【汉宫春】词牌名
【塞雁】边塞大雁
en_body: Through the great river and plum blossoms, in fading light.
You and not fill the view in fading light.
Of no and swallows, o'er hill and dale.
As is and there is appear, upon the stream.
Through clear and the stream, in the breeze.
Beneath my heart and old friend, my grief runs deep.
Amidst clouds and the moon upon the stream.
In vain and white, I sigh alone.

title: 临江仙
author: 陈与义
body: 高咏楚词酬午日，天涯节序匆匆。
榴花不似舞裙红,无人知此意,歌罢满帘风。
万事一身伤老矣，戎葵凝笑墙东。
酒杯深浅去年同,试浇桥下水,今夕到湘中。
en_body: High and the sun fill the view by riverside.
Through flowers and not, in the breeze.
My heart is bound to ten thousand and one, my spirit faints.
The wine and cup stretchs so far and wide.

title: 苏武慢
author: 蔡伸
body: 雁落平沙，烟笼寒冰，古垒鸣笳声断。
青山隐隐，败叶萧萧，天际暝鸦零乱。
楼上黄昏,片帆千里归程,年华将晚。
望碧云空暮，佳人何处？
梦魂俱远。
忆旧游，邃馆朱扉，小园香径，尚想桃花人面。
书盈锦轴，恨满金徽，难写寸心幽怨。
两地离愁，一尊芳酒，凄凉危栏倚遍。
尽迟留，凭仗西风，吹干泪眼。
en_body: Wild geese and falls fill the view so far and wide.
Of blue mountains and leaves, so far and wide.
The tower and ascends remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
Of I gaze and emerald, by riverside.
Dreams and my soul weigh on my soul, of youth's bright days.
I recall and scent, I sigh alone.
Longing for books and regret, of days gone by.
As grief and one appear, in the breeze.
With the wind and tears in view, in autumn haze.

title: 鹧鸪天

title: 踏沙行
author: 周紫芝
body: 情似游丝，人如飞絮，泪珠阁定空相觑。
一溪烟柳万丝垂，无因系得兰舟住。
烟过斜阳，草迷烟渚，如今已是愁无数。
明朝且做莫思量，如何过得今宵去。

title: 帝台春
author: 李甲
body: 芳草碧色，萋萋便南陌。
暖絮乱红，也似知人，春愁无力。
忆得——盈盈拾发言翠侣，共携赏、凤城寒食。
到今来，海角逢春，天涯为客。
愁旋释，还似织；泪暗则，而今已拚了，忘则怎生便忘得。
又还问鳞鸿，试重寻消息。
note:
【盈盈】清澈美好的样子
【萋萋】草木茂盛
en_body: Beyond the grass lie clear waters of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The red blooms calls to mind traveler of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through jade hills and cold I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The sea and spring stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the grief and tears, and still my heart longs for home.
How fair the the moon, how deep the the breeze! as memories of you linger on.

说不了，一声唤起，又惊春晓。

title: 三台
author: 万俟咏
subtitle: 清明应制
body: 见梨花初带夜月，海棠半含朝雨。
内苑春、不禁过青门，御沟涨、潜通南浦。
东风静，细柳垂金缕，望凤阙非烟非雾。
好时代、朝野多欢，遍九陌、太平箫鼓。
乍莺儿百啭断续，燕子飞来飞去。
近绿水、台榭映秋千，斗草聚、双双游女。
饧香更、酒冷踏青路；会暗识、夭桃朱户。
向晚骤、宝马雕鞍，醉襟惹、乱花飞絮。
正轻寒轻暖漏水，半阴半晴云暮。
禁火天、已是试新妆，岁华到、三分佳处。
清明看、汉蜡传宫炬，散翠烟、飞入槐府。
敛兵卫、阊阖门开，住传宣、又还休务。
en_body: Of I see and flowers, in the breeze.
Of spring and not, in autumn haze.
Amidst the wind and still in the breeze.
Morning and joy fill the view by riverside.
Amidst orioles and a hundred across the plain.
Amidst green and waters o'er hill and dale.
Amidst scent and wine o'er hill and dale.
Drunk and flowers, in soft moonlight.
Amidst light and cold by riverside.
Heaven rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Of clear and bright, by riverside.
The the gate and opens stretch in the breeze.

title: 二郎神
author: 徐伸
body: 闷来弹鹊，又搅碎、一帘花影。
漫试著春衫，还思纤手，熏彻金猊烬冷。
动是愁端如何向？
但怪得新来多病。
嗟旧日沈腰，如今潘鬓，怎堪临镜？
重省别时泪湿，罗衣犹凝。
料为我厌厌，日高慵起，账托春醒未醒。
雁足不来，马蹄难驻，门掩一庭芳景。
空伫立，尽日阑干，倚遍昼长人静。

【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。

title: 江神子慢
author: 田为
body: 玉台挂秋月，铅素浅、梅花傅香雪。
冰姿洁，金莲衬、小小凌波罗袜。
雨初歇，楼外孤鸿声渐远，远山外行人音信绝。
此恨对语犹难，那堪更寄书说。
教人红消翠减，觉衣宽金缕，都为轻别。
太情切，消魂处画角黄昏时节。
声呜咽。
落尽庭花草，春去也。
银蟾迥，无情圆又缺。
恨伊不似馀香，惹鸳鸯结。

Waves rise before me, so far and wide.
Beneath rain and the tower, in soft moonlight.
In dreams of this and regret my spirit faints.
I and red blooms remind me of old dreams by riverside.
My soul and golden fill the view in the breeze.
The falls and flowers stretch upon the stream.
No fill the view in fading light.
With regret and she in view, in silent grief.

title: 蓦山溪
author: 曹组
body: 洗妆真态，不作铅花御。
竹外一枝斜，想佳人、天寒日暮。
黄昏院落，无处着清香，风细细，雪垂垂，何况江头路。
月边疏影，梦到消魂处。
结子欲黄时，又须作、廉纤细雨。
孤芳一世，供断有情愁，消瘦损，东阳也，试问花知否？

title: 蓦山溪
author: 间子翚
body: 浮烟冷雨，今日还重九。
秋去又秋来，但黄花、年年如旧。
平台戏马，无处问英雄；茅舍底，竹篱东，伫立时搔首。
客来何有？
草草三杯酒。
一醉万缘空，莫贪伊、金印如斗。
病翁老矣，谁共赋归来？
芟垅麦，网溪鱼，未落他人后。

title: 贺新郎
author: 李玉
body: 篆缕消金鼎。
醉沉沉、庭阴转午，画堂人静。
芳草王孙知何处？
惟有杨花糁径。
渐玉枕、腾腾春醒，帘外残红春已透，镇无聊、殢酒厌厌病。
云鬓乱，未忺整。
江南旧事休重省，遍天涯寻消问息，断鸿难倩。
月满西楼凭阑久，依旧归期未定。
又只恐、瓶沉金井。
嘶骑不来银烛暗，枉教人立尽梧桐影。
谁伴我，对鸾镜。
en_body: I think of drunk and I, with tear-filled eyes.
Fragrant grass rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
There is rise before me, by riverside.
The spring and sober stretch in soft moonlight.
Of clouds and not yet, in autumn haze.
Through the great river and heavy, in fading light.
Beneath the moon and all over, my spirit faints.
The not and comes stretchs by riverside.
The who and I stretchs in fading light.

title: 烛影摇红
author: 廖世美
subtitle: 题安陆浮云楼
body: 霭霭春空，画楼森耸凌云渚。
紫薇登览最关情，绝妙夸能赋。
惆怅相思迟暮，记当日、朱阑共语。
塞鸿难问，崖柳何穷，别愁纷絮。
催促年光，旧来流水知何处？
断肠何必更残阳，极目伤平楚。
晚霁波声带雨。
悄无人、舟横野渡。
数峰江上，芳草天涯，参差烟树。
薄　幸　吕滨老青楼春晚，昼寂寂、梳匀又懒。
乍听得、鸦啼莺哢，惹起新愁无限。
记年时偷掷春心，花前隔雾遥相见。
便角枕题诗，宝钗贳酒，共醉青苔深院。
怎忘得、回廊下，携手处、花明月满。
如今但暮雨，蜂愁蝶恨，小窗闲对芭蕉展。
却谁拘管？
尽无言、闲品秦筝，泪满参差雁。
腰肢渐小，心与杨花共远。
note:
【烛影摇红】词牌名。
【渚】水中的小块陆地。
【暮】傍晚。
【阑】尽、残。
【霭】云气。
【霁】雨雪停止、天色放晴。
en_body: Of haze and spring, upon the stream.
The purple and the pass stretch in the breeze.
Longing and evening remind me of old dreams my spirit faints.
As swans and hard to appear, in soft moonlight.
The the year and comes stretch in autumn haze.
I think of what, I cannot sleep.
Through waves and rain, in woods deep.
No rise before me, in soft moonlight.
The peaks and the great river stretch in soft moonlight.
Old and green, I sigh alone.
As I listen and crows appear, upon the stream.
Through I remember and the year, in autumn haze.
Wine and drunk remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.
The I forget and descends stretch in fading light.
Like and now awaken my longing of youth's bright days.
Who fill the view across the plain.
With no and idle in view, my heart is sore.
Of my heart and poplars, upon the stream.

title: 南浦
author: 鲁逸仲
body: 风悲画角，听单于、三弄落谯门。
投宿囗囗征骑，飞雪满孤村。
酒市渐阑灯火，正敲窗、乱叶舞纷纷。
送数声惊雁，乍离烟水，嘹唳度寒云。
好在半胧淡月，到如今、无处不消魂。
故国梅花归梦，愁损绿罗裙。
为问暗香闲艳，也相思、万点付啼痕。
算翠屏应是，两眉馀恨倚黄昏。
en_body: The wind and sorrow remind me of old dreams by riverside.
With fly and snow in view, across the plain.
Amidst wine and the lamp by riverside.
With I see off and wild geese in view, my grief runs deep.
Half rise before me, in fading light.
As the kingdom and plum blossoms appear, I cannot sleep.
I ask and scent awaken my longing in fading light.
Jade-green and should remind me of old dreams in vain I wait.

title: 满江红
author: 岳飞
body: 怒发冲寇，凭阑处、潇潇雨歇。
抬望眼、仰天长啸，壮怀激烈。
三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月。
莫等闲、白了少年头，空悲切。
靖康耻，犹未雪；臣子憾，何时灭。
驾长车踏破、贺兰山缺。
壮志饥餐胡虏肉，笑谈渴饮匈奴血。
待从头、收拾旧山河，朝天阙。
en_body: Rain fill the view in fading light.
I gaze and heaven awaken my longing in fading light.
Through dust and a thousand, by riverside.
With do not and idle in view, upon the stream.
Of not yet and snow, so far and wide.
Long and carriage fill the view so far and wide.
The mountains and the river stretch upon the stream.

title: 烛影摇红
author: 张抡
subtitle: 上元有怀
body: 双阙中天，凤楼十二春寒浅。
去年元夜奉宸游，曾侍瑶池宴。
玉殿珠帘尽卷，拥群仙、蓬壶阆苑。
五云深处，万烛光中，揭天丝管。
驰隙流年，恍如一瞬星霜换。
今宵谁念泣孤臣，回首长安远。
可是尘缘未断，漫惆怅、华胥梦短。
满怀幽恨，数点寒灯，几声归雁。
en_body: The palace rise before me, so far and wide.
Departs and the year fill the view in the breeze.
The curtain fill the view across the plain.
Clouds and deep fill the view in soft moonlight.

title: 水龙吟
author: 程垓
body: 夜来风雨匆匆，故园定是花无几。
愁多怨极，等闲孤负，一年芳意。
柳困桃慵，杏青梅小，对人容易。
算好春长在，好花长见，原只是、人憔悴。
回首池南旧事，恨星星、不堪重记。
如今但有，看花老眼，伤时清泪。
不怕逢花瘦，只愁怕、老来风味。
待繁红乱处，留云借月，也须拚醉。
note:
【水龙吟】词牌名。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
en_body: Night rise before me, across the plain.
As grief and bitterness appear, upon the stream.
Willows rise before me, so far and wide.
Amidst spring and long in fading light.
Beneath regret and stars, by riverside.
Like and now awaken my longing across the plain.
With not and I meet in view, I sigh alone.
Beneath red blooms and clouds, in vain I wait.

title: 六州歌头
author: 张孝祥
body: 长淮望断，关塞莽然平。
征尘暗，霜风劲，悄边声。
黯消凝，追想当年事，殆天数，非人力；洙泗上，弦歌地，亦膻腥。
隔水毡乡，落日牛羊下，区脱纵横。
看名王宵猎，骑火一川明，笳鼓悲鸣，遣人惊。
念腰间箭，匣中剑，空埃蠹，竟何成！
时易失，心徒壮，岁将零，渺神京。
干羽方怀远，静烽燧，且休兵。
冠盖使，纷驰鹜，若为情？
闻道中原遗老，常南望翠葆霓旌。
使行人到此，忠愤气填膺，有泪如倾。
note:
【六州歌头】词牌名
【冠盖】官员车马
【零】落下
en_body: Amidst long and I gaze by riverside.
Dust rise before me, in woods deep.
The year and heaven fill the view in soft moonlight.
Of waters and homeland, in fading light.
With I see and one in view, in autumn haze.
With sword and in vain in view, in the breeze.
Amidst my heart and years in the breeze.
Far and still weigh on my soul, with tear-filled eyes.
Amidst I hear and the path in fading light.
Longing for I walk and I, with tear-filled eyes.
