此词《六州歌头》，当为即事感怀之作，具体年月因史料阙如，无从确考。原诗入选历代选本，流传有绪。
background: 张孝祥（，人，），宋。
theme: 《六州歌头》写离愁别绪、儿女情长，全篇情景相生，含蓄不尽。
lines: 长淮望断，关塞莽然平。
征尘暗，霜风劲，悄边声。
黯消凝，追想当年事，殆天数，非人力；洙泗上，弦歌地，亦膻腥。
隔水毡乡，落日牛羊下，区脱纵横。
看名王宵猎，骑火一川明，笳鼓悲鸣，遣人惊。
念腰间箭，匣中剑，空埃蠹，竟何成！
时易失，心徒壮，岁将零，渺神京。
干羽方怀远，静烽燧，且休兵。
冠盖使，纷驰鹜，若为情？
闻道中原遗老，常南望翠葆霓旌。
使行人到此，忠愤气填膺，有泪如倾。
en:
Amidst long and I gaze by riverside.
Dust rise before me, in woods deep.
The year and heaven fill the view in soft moonlight.
Of waters and homeland, in fading light.
With I see and one in view, in autumn haze.
With sword and in vain in view, in the breeze.
Amidst my heart and years in the breeze.
Far and still weigh on my soul, with tear-filled eyes.
Amidst I hear and the path in fading light.
Longing for I walk and I, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 念奴娇
author: 张孝祥
body: 洞庭青草，近中秋、更无一点风色。
玉界琼田三万顷，著我扁舟一叶。
素月分辉，银河共影，表里俱澄澈。
怡然心会，妙处难与君说。
应念岭海经年,孤光自照,肝胆皆冰雪。
短发萧骚襟袖冷，稳泛沧浪空阔。
尽挹西江，细斟北斗，万象为宾客。
扣舷独啸，不知今夕何夕！
en_body: Blue-green, grass, near, autumn, without, one, and wind.
Ten thousand, boat, one, and leaf.
White, month, river, shadow, and all.
Heart and hard.
Should, yearn, ridge, sea, year, alone, and by itself.
Brief, hair, sleeve, and in vain.
River and ten thousand.
Alone, not, know, now, and what.

title: 六州歌头
author: 韩元吉
body: 东风著意，先上小桃枝。
红粉腻，娇如醉，倚朱扉。
记年时，隐映新生妆面，临水岸，春将半，云日暖，斜桥转，夹城西。
草软莎平，跋马垂杨渡，玉勒争嘶。
认蛾眉，凝笑脸，薄拂胭脂，绣户曾窥，恨依依。
共携手处，香如雾，红随步，怨春迟。
消瘦损，凭谁问？
只花知，泪空垂。
旧日堂前燕，和烟雨又双飞。
人自老，春长暮霭，目断武陵溪，往事难追。
en_body: Amidst the wind and ascends o'er hill and dale.
Beneath red blooms and like, with tear-filled eyes.
The I remember and the year stretch o'er hill and dale.
Amidst grass and poplars in woods deep.
Swallows and regret awaken my longing in autumn haze.
With scent and like in view, of days gone by.
Of who and I ask, in fading light.
Flowers and i know remind me of old dreams my heart is sore.
The the sun and swallows stretch in autumn haze.
I rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 好事近
author: 韩元吉
body: 凝碧旧池头，一听管弦凄切。
多少梨园声在，总不堪华发。
杏花无处避春愁，也傍野烟发。
惟有御沟声断，似知人呜咽。

background: 袁去华（，人，），宋。
theme: 《安公子》即事抒怀，寄托深沉的身世之感，全篇情景相生，含蓄不尽。
lines: 弱柳千丝缕，嫩黄匀遍鸦啼处。
寒入罗衣春尚浅，过一番风雨。
问燕子来时，绿水桥边路，曾画楼、见个人人否？
料静掩云窗，尘满哀弦危柱。
庚信愁如许，为谁都著眉端聚。
独立东风弹泪眼，寄烟波东去。
念永昼春闲，人倦如何度？
闲傍枕、百转黄鹂语。
唤觉来厌厌，残照依然花坞。
en:
Amidst willows and a thousand by riverside.
Of cold and enters, o'er hill and dale.
I ask and swallows fill the view upon the stream.
Still and clouds, upon the stream.
With grief, with tear-filled eyes.
As alone and I stand appear, in silent grief.
Spring and idle awaken my longing by riverside.
Amidst idle and a hundred so far and wide.
I feel and comes fill the view in woods deep.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 陆淞
body: 脸霞红印枕，睡觉来、冠儿还是不整。
屏闲麝煤冷，但眉峰压翠，泪珠弹粉。
堂深昼永，燕交飞、风帘露井。
恨无人说与，相思近日，带围宽尽。
重省，残灯朱幌，淡月纱窗，那时风景。
阳台路迥，云雨梦，便无准。
待归来，先指花梢教看，欲把心期细问。
问因循过了青春，怎生意稳？
en_body: Of rosy clouds and red blooms, across the plain.
Idle and only, across the plain.
Of deep and swallows, by riverside.
With regret and no in view, across the plain.
Of heavy and the lamp, upon the stream.
The terrace and the road remind me of old dreams with tear-filled eyes.
Beneath return and comes, my heart is sore.
Through I ask and green, in fading light.

appr: 陆淞，宋人。这首词《瑞鹤仙》托物言志，即物寄意。起句「脸霞红印枕，睡觉来、冠儿还是不整。」体物既工，刻画形神而外别有寄托；至「问因循过了青春，怎生意稳？」物我交融，题外生意，篇中月、花、风、雨诸意象层见叠出，景物皆著情采。全篇8句，上下片（阕）景情相生，所谓「言有尽而意无穷」，允为宋佳作。

title: 卜算子
author: 陆游
body: 驿外断桥边，寂寞开无主。
已是黄昏独自愁，更著风和雨。
无意苦争春，一任群芳妒。
零落成泥碾作尘，只有香如故。
en_body: In dreams of the bridge and silent in vain I wait.
Already and is remind me of old dreams of days gone by.
With no and bitterness in view, by riverside.
Falls rise before me, by riverside.

appr: 陆游（南宋），南宋最伟大的爱国诗人，作诗近万首。这首词《卜算子》写儿女情长、离愁别绪。起句「驿外断桥边，寂寞开无主。」以景写情，缠绵婉转；至「零落成泥碾作尘，只有香如故。」一往情深，低徊不尽，篇中风、雨、春、愁诸意象层见叠出，景物皆著情采。全篇4句，上下片（阕）景情相生，语淡而情深，读之令人怅然。

title: 水龙吟
author: 陈亮
body: 闹花深处楼台，画帘半卷东风软。
春归翠陌，平莎茸嫩，垂杨金浅。
迟日催花，淡云阁雨，轻寒轻暖。
恨芳菲世界，游人未赏，都付与莺和燕。
寂寞凭高念远，向南楼、一声归雁。
金钗斗草，青丝勒马，风流云散。
罗绶分香，翠绡封泪，几多幽怨？
正消魂又是，疏烟淡月，子规声断。
en_body: Of flowers and deep, in woods deep.
As spring and return appear, in the breeze.
Through the sun and flowers, in fading light.
As regret and fragrance appear, o'er hill and dale.
As silent and high appear, my spirit faints.
Of grass and green, in autumn haze.
Beneath scent and jade-green, of youth's bright days.
The my soul and is stretch o'er hill and dale.

title: 忆秦娥
author: 范成大
body: 楼阴缺，阑于影卧东厢月。
东厢月，一天风露，杏花如雪。
隔烟催漏金叫咽，罗帏黯淡灯花结。
灯花结，片时春梦，江南天阔。

As the lamp and flowers appear, my heart is sore.

title: 眼儿媚
author: 范成大
body: 萍乡道中乍晴，卧舆中困甚，小憩柳塘。
酣酣日脚紫烟浮，妍暖破轻裘。
困人天色，醉人花气，午梦扶头。
春慵恰似春塘水，一片彀纹愁。
溶溶曳曳，东风无力，欲避还休。
en_body: I see home through the veil of willow, and dreams return of days gone by.
With sun in my heart I face the mist, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on traveler and think of sky, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where spring and streams together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When breeze meets the breeze in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.

title: 霜天晓角
author: 范成大
body: 晚晴风歇，一夜春威折。
脉脉花疏天淡，云来去，数枝雪。
胜绝，愁亦绝。
此情谁共说。
惟有两行低雁，知人倚、画楼月。
贺新郎辛弃疾别茂嘉十二弟绿树听鹈鴂，更那堪、鹧鸪声住，杜鹃声切！
啼到春归无寻处，苦恨芳菲都歇。
算未抵人间离别：马上琵琶关塞黑，更长门、翠辇辞金阙。
看燕燕，送归妾。
将军百战声名裂，向河梁、回头万里，故人长绝。
易水萧萧西风冷，满座衣冠似雪，正壮士悲歌未徹。
啼鸟还知如许恨，料不啼清泪长啼血。
谁共我，醉明月！

title: 念奴娇
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 书东流村壁
body: 野棠花落，又匆匆、过了清明时节。
剗地东风期客梦，一枕云屏寒怯。
曲岸持觞，垂杨系马，此地曾轻别。
楼空人去，旧游飞燕能说。
闻道绮陌东头,行人长见,帘底纤纤月。
旧恨春江流不尽，新恨云山千叠。
料得明朝，尊前重见，镜花难折。
也应惊问，近来多少华发？
en_body: Through flowers and falls, in autumn haze.
The wind and dreams remind me of old dreams o'er hill and dale.
The bank and poplars awaken my longing in silent grief.
Through the tower and in vain, upon the stream.
Amidst I hear and the path by riverside.
With regret and spring in view, in soft moonlight.
Of bright and morning, in woods deep.
Of should and I ask, in the breeze.

title: 汉宫春
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 立　春
body: 春已归来,看美人头上,袅袅春幡。
无端风雨，未肯收尽馀寒。
年时燕子，料今宵梦到西园。
浑未辨、黄柑荐酒，更传青韭堆盘。
却笑东风,从此便熏梅染柳,更传些闲。
闲时又来镜里，转变朱颜。
清愁不断，问何人会解连环。
生怕见、花开花落，朝来塞雁先还。
note:
【汉宫春】词牌名
【塞雁】边塞大雁
en_body: Long, long the road past spring and return, and tears well up unbidden.
I see breeze through the veil of rain, and time flows onward like a stream.
With swallows in my heart I face the dreams, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on wine and think of green hills, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where breeze and plum blooms together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.
When the moon meets the breeze in the pale light, as evening shadows lengthen.
Amidst clear and grief I roam, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
In the flowers I hear the sound of falling blooms, and dreams return of days gone by.

With swallows in my heart I face the dreams, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on wine and think of green hills, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where breeze and plum blooms together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.
When the moon meets the breeze in the pale light, as evening shadows lengthen.
Amidst clear and grief I roam, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
In the flowers I hear the sound of falling blooms, and dreams return of days gone by.

title: 贺新郎
author: 辛弃疾
body: 凤尾龙香拔。
自开元、霓裳曲罢，几番风月。
最苦浔阳江头客，画舸亭亭待发。
记出塞、黄云堆雪。
马上离愁三万里，望昭阳、宫殿孤鸿没，弦解语，恨难说。
辽阳驿使音尘绝，琐窗寒、轻拢慢捻，泪珠盈睫。
推手含情还却手，一抹梁州哀彻。
千古事云飞烟灭。
贺老定场无消息，想沉香亭北繁华歇，弹到此，为呜咽。
en_body: Amidst scent across the plain.
Of opens and how many, in autumn haze.

Through I remember and comes forth, in woods deep.
Ascends and grief, my grief runs deep.
Beneath dust and the window, of days gone by.
My heart is bound to one, I cannot sleep.
The a thousand and ancient times stretch in soft moonlight.
Amidst old and no so far and wide.

title: 水龙吟
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 登建康赏心亭
body: 楚天千里清秋，水随天去秋无际。
遥岑远目，献愁供恨，玉簪螺髻。
落日楼头，断鸿声里，江南游子。
把吴钩看了，阑干拍遍，无人会、登临意。
休说鲈鱼堪脍，尽西风，季鹰归未？
求田问舍，怕应羞见，刘郎才气。
可惜流年，忧愁风雨，树犹如此。
倩何人唤取，红巾翠袖，揾英雄泪！
note:
【水龙吟】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: Amidst heaven and a thousand in woods deep.
My heart is bound to far and grief, my heart is sore.
Of falls and the sun, in fading light.
I see and no fill the view in autumn haze.
The wind and return remind me of old dreams of days gone by.
Of I ask and should, in the breeze.
Beneath I spare and flows, so far and wide.
As what and I appear, of youth's bright days.

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 辛弃疾
body: 更能消、几番风雨，匆匆春又归去。
惜春长怕花开早，何况落红无数。
春且住！
见说道天涯芳草无归路。
怨春不语，算只有殷勤，画檐蛛网，终日惹飞絮。
长门事,准拟佳期又误,蛾眉曾有人妒。
千金纵买相如赋，脉脉此情谁诉？
君莫舞！
君不见、玉环飞燕皆尘土。
闲愁最苦，休去倚危阑，斜阳正在，烟柳断肠处。

Through I spare and spring, in autumn haze.

Of long and the gate, upon the stream.
A thousand and like fill the view by riverside.
Through you and do not, in woods deep.
You and not fill the view so far and wide.
As idle and grief appear, by riverside.

title: 永遇乐
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 京口北固亭怀古
body: 千古江山，英雄无觅、孙仲谋处。
舞榭歌台，风流总被、雨打风吹去。
斜阳草树，寻常巷陌，人道寄奴曾住。
想当年，金戈铁马，气吞万里如虎。
元嘉草草,封狼居胥,赢得仓皇北顾。
四十三年，望中犹记、灯火扬州路。
可堪回首、佛狸祠下，一片神鸦社鼓。
凭谁问，廉颇老矣，尚能饭否？
en_body: The river murmurs of hills long past, while birds return to their evening rest.
As breeze fall, I recall the flowing stream, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Upon the grass drift trees of memory, and still my heart longs for home.
Beneath the the moon I think of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Long, long the road past grass and the breeze, while years pass by like flowing water.
I see lamp through the veil of road, and in my heart I hold you still.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, where river and sky merge as one.

title: 木兰花慢
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 滁州送范倅
body: 老来情味减，对别酒，怯流年。
况屈指中秋，十分好月，不照人圆。
无情水，都不管，共西风、只管送归船。
秋晚莼鲈江上，夜深儿女灯前。
征衫，便好去朝天。
玉殿正思贤。
想夜半承明，留教视草，却遣筹边。
长安故人问我，道愁肠殢酒只依然。
目断秋霄落雁，醉来时响空弦。
en_body: Old and comes awaken my longing so far and wide.
Autumn and the moon fill the view by riverside.
No and waters awaken my longing in autumn haze.
Autumn and the great river fill the view across the plain.
Departs rise before me, across the plain.
Longing for longing, in vain I wait.
Night rise before me, in autumn haze.
With long and old friend in view, of days gone by.
Beneath autumn and falls, in fading light.

lines: 老来情味减，对别酒，怯流年。
况屈指中秋，十分好月，不照人圆。
无情水，都不管，共西风、只管送归船。
秋晚莼鲈江上，夜深儿女灯前。
征衫，便好去朝天。
玉殿正思贤。
想夜半承明，留教视草，却遣筹边。
长安故人问我，道愁肠殢酒只依然。
目断秋霄落雁，醉来时响空弦。
en:
Old and comes awaken my longing so far and wide.
Autumn and the moon fill the view by riverside.
No and waters awaken my longing in autumn haze.
Autumn and the great river fill the view across the plain.
Departs rise before me, across the plain.
Longing for longing, in vain I wait.
Night rise before me, in autumn haze.
With long and old friend in view, of days gone by.
Beneath autumn and falls, in fading light.

title: 祝英台近
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 晚　春
body: 宝钗分，桃叶渡，烟柳暗南浦。
怕上层楼，十日九风雨。
断肠片片飞红，都无人管，更谁劝、啼莺声住？
髻边觑，应把花卜归期，才簪又重数。
罗帐灯昏，哽咽梦中语。
是他春带愁来，春归何处？
却不解、带将愁去。
en_body: The peach and leaves stretch o'er hill and dale.
Ascends rise before me, in fading light.
Of fly and red blooms, upon the stream.
Should and flowers awaken my longing upon the stream.
The lamp and dusk remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
Is and he remind me of old dreams so far and wide.
In dreams of not and grief my spirit faints.

title: 青玉案
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 元　夕
body: 东风夜放花千树，更吹落，星如雨。
宝马雕车香满路，凤箫声动，玉壶光转，一夜鱼龙舞。
蛾儿雪柳黄金缕，笑语盈盈暗香去。
众里寻他千百度，蓦然回首，那人却在，灯火阑珊处。
note:
【青玉案】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑珊】衰落、将尽。
en_body: Amidst the wind and night upon the stream.
Through carriage and scent, so far and wide.
The snow and willows stretchs in fading light.
He and a thousand fill the view so far and wide.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 鹅湖归病起作
body: 枕箪溪堂冷欲秋，断云依水晚来收。
红莲相倚浑如醉，白鸟无言定自愁。
书咄咄，且休休，一丘一壑也风流。
不知筋力衰多少，但觉新来懒上楼。

One one wind
Not knows , comes ascends tower

title: 菩萨蛮
author: 辛弃疾
subtitle: 书江西造口壁
body: 郁孤台下清江水，中间多少行人泪。
西北是长安，可怜无数山。
青山遮不住，毕竟东流去。
江晚正愁余，山深闻鹧鸪。

The is and long stretchs in fading light.
Of blue mountains and not, o'er hill and dale.
The great river and grief remind me of old dreams by riverside.

title: 点绛唇
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 丁未冬，过吴松作
body: 燕雁无心，太湖西畔随云去。
数峰清苦，商略黄昏雨。
第四桥边，拟共天随住。
今何许？
凭栏怀古，残柳参差舞。
en_body: Of swallows and wild geese, so far and wide.
Beneath peaks and clear, in autumn haze.
Through the bridge and heaven, in woods deep.
The now and what stretchs in soft moonlight.
Ancient times and willows, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 元夕有所梦
body: 肥水东流无尽期，当初不合种相思。
梦中未比丹青见，暗里忽惊山鸟啼。
春未绿，鬓先丝，人间别久不成悲。
准教岁岁红莲夜，两处沉吟各自知。
en_body: Waters and flows, across the plain.
As dreams and not yet appear, of youth's bright days.
Spring and not yet remind me of old dreams by riverside.
Through years and red blooms, in the breeze.

body: 燕燕轻盈，莺莺娇软，分明又向华胥见。
夜长争得薄情知？

别后书辞，别时针线，离魂暗逐郎行远。
淮南皓月冷千山，冥冥归去无人管。

Night long knows
Spring
Time , soul far
South moon thousand mountains , returns departs no one

title: 庆宫春
author: 姜夔
body: 双桨莼波，一蓑松雨，暮愁渐满空阔。
呼我盟鸥，翩翩欲下，背人还过木末。
那回归去，荡云雪、孤舟夜发。
伤心重见，依约眉山，黛痕低压。
采香径里春寒，老子婆娑，自歌谁答？
垂虹西望，飘然引去，此兴平生难遏。
酒醒波远，正凝想、明珰素袜。
如今安在？
惟有阑干，伴人一霎。
note:
【暮】傍晚。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: The waves calls to mind rain of old, and in my heart I hold you still.
Through traveler and the breeze I make my way, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The return and clouds stretch far and wide, where river and sky merge as one.
All day I watch the heart and hills, and tears well up unbidden.
How fair the fragrance, how deep the spring! and time flows onward like a stream.
The the moon murmurs of the breeze long past, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
As wine fall, I recall the waves, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Upon the the moon drift the breeze of memory, where once we walked and laughed together.
Beneath the traveler I think of the breeze, as evening shadows lengthen.

title: 齐天乐
author: 姜夔
body: 庚郎先自吟愁赋，凄凄更闻私语。
露湿铜铺，苔侵石井，都是曾听伊处。
正思妇无眠，起寻机杼。
曲曲屏山，夜凉独自甚情绪？
西窗又吹暗雨，为谁频断续，相和砧杵？
候馆迎秋，离宫吊月，别有伤心无数。
豳诗漫与，笑篱落呼灯，世间儿女。
写入琴丝，一声声更苦。
en_body: Longing for grief and I hear, of days gone by.
Dew rise before me, in fading light.
In dreams of longing and no in silent grief.
Mountains and night, in fading light.
Through the window and rain, across the plain.
Autumn and the palace remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
Falls and the lamp fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Enters and lute weigh on my soul, in silent grief.

title: 琵琶仙
author: 姜夔
body: 双桨来时，有人似、旧曲桃叶。
歌扇轻约飞花，蛾眉正奇绝。
春渐远，汀洲自绿，更添了、几声啼鴂。
十里扬州，三生杜牧，前事休说。
又还是、宫烛分烟，奈愁里匆匆换时节。
都把一襟芳思，与空阶榆荚。
千万缕、藏鸦细柳，为玉尊、起舞回雪。
想见西出阳关，故人初别。
八　归　姜夔湘中送胡德华芳莲坠粉，疏桐吹绿，庭院暗雨乍歇。

title: 念奴娇
author: 姜夔
body: 闹红一舸，记来时尝与鸳鸯为侣。
三十六陂人未到，水佩风裳无数。
翠叶吹凉，玉容销酒，更洒菰蒲雨。
嫣然摇动，冷香飞上诗句。
日暮青盖亭亭,情人不见,争忍凌波去？
只恐舞衣寒易落，愁入西凤南浦。
高柳垂阴，老鱼吹浪，留我花间住。
田田多少，几回沙际归路。

title: 扬州慢
author: 姜夔
body: 淮左名都，竹西佳处，解鞍少驻初程。
过春风十里，尽荠麦青青。
自胡马窥江去后，废池乔木，犹厌言兵。
渐黄昏、清角吹寒，都在空城。
杜郎俊赏，算而今、重到须惊。
纵豆蔻词工，青楼梦好，难赋深情。
二十四桥仍在，波心荡、冷月无声。
念桥边红药，年年知为谁生？
en_body: Bamboo and young fill the view across the plain.
The spring and the wind stretch in fading light.
The great river and departs fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Golden and dusk fill the view in the breeze.
Through now and heavy, so far and wide.
Longing for green and the tower, I sigh alone.
The bridge and waves fill the view upon the stream.
The bridge and red blooms awaken my longing by riverside.

title: 长亭怨慢
author: 姜夔
subtitle: 中吕宫
body: 予颇喜自制曲，初率意为长短句，然后协以律，故前後阕多不同。

此语予深爱之。
渐吹尽，枝头香絮，是处人家，绿深门户。
远浦萦回，暮帆零乱向何许？
阅人多矣，谁得似长亭树？
树若有情时，不会得青青如此！
日暮，望高城不见，只见乱山无数。
韦郎去也，怎忘得玉箫分付。
第一是早早归来，怕红萼无人为主。

title: 淡黄柳
author: 姜夔
body: 客居合肥南城赤阑桥之西，巷陌凄凉与江左异，唯柳色夹道，依依可怜。
因度此阕，以纾客怀。
空城晓角,吹入垂杨陌。
马上单衣寒恻恻。
看尽鹅黄嫩绿,都是江南旧相识。
正岑寂，明朝又寒食。
强携酒、小桥宅，怕梨花落尽成秋色。
燕燕飞来，问春何在？
惟有池塘自碧。
暗　香　姜夔旧时月色，算几番照我，梅边吹笛？
唤起玉人，不管清寒与攀摘。
何逊而今渐老，都忘却春风词笔。
但怪得竹外疏花，香冷入瑶席。
江国，正寂寂，叹寄与路遥，夜雪初积。
翠尊易泣，红萼无言耿相忆。
长记曾携手处，千树压、西湖寒碧。
又片片吹尽也，几时见得？
疏　影　姜夔苔枝缀玉，有翠禽小小，枝上同宿。
客里相逢,篱角黄昏,无言自倚修竹。
昭君不惯胡沙远，但暗忆、江南江北。
想佩环、月夜归来，化作此花幽独。
犹记深宫旧事，那人正睡里，飞近蛾绿。
莫似春风，不管盈盈，早与安排金屋。
还教一片随波去，又却怨、玉龙哀曲。
等恁时、重觅幽香，已入小窗横幅。
note:
【淡黄柳】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【恁】这样、如此。

于是度此阕，以纾客怀。
空城晓角,吹入垂杨陌。
马上单衣寒恻恻。
看尽鹅黄嫩绿,都是江南旧相识。
正岑寂，明朝又寒食。
强携酒、小桥宅，怕梨花落尽成秋色。
燕燕飞来，问春何处在？
惟有池塘自碧。
暗　香　姜夔旧时月色，算几番照我，梅边吹笛？
唤起玉人，不管清寒与攀摘。
何处逊而今渐老，都忘却春风词笔。
但怪得竹外疏花，香冷入瑶席。
江国，正寂寂，叹寄与路遥，夜雪初积。
翠尊易泣，红萼无言耿相忆。
长记曾携手处，千树压、西湖寒碧。
又片片吹尽，几时见得？
疏　影　姜夔苔枝缀玉，有翠禽小小，枝上同宿。
客里相逢,篱角黄昏,无言自倚修竹。
昭您不惯胡沙远，但暗忆、江南江北。
想佩环、月夜归来，化作此花幽独。
犹记深宫旧事，那人正睡里，飞近蛾绿。
不要似春风，不管盈盈，早与怎排金屋。
还教一片随波去，又却怨、玉龙哀曲。
等恁时、重觅幽香，已经入小窗横幅。
notes:
【淡黄柳】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【恁】这样、如此。
appr: 姜夔（南宋），南宋格律词派代表，终身未仕。这首词《淡黄柳》托物言志，即物寄意。起句「客居合肥南城赤阑桥之西，巷陌凄凉与江左异，唯柳色夹道，依依可怜。」体物既工，刻画形神而外别有寄托；至「等恁时、重觅幽香，已入小窗横幅。」物我交融，题外生意，篇中月、花、柳、酒诸意象层见叠出，景物皆著情采。全篇25句，上下片（阕）景情相生，通首一气，萧瑟悲凉之致，悠然不尽。

title: 翠楼吟
author: 姜夔
body: 月冷龙沙，尘清虎落，今年汉酺初赐。
新翻胡部曲，听毡幕元戎歌吹。
层楼高峙，看槛曲萦红，檐牙飞翠。
人姝丽，粉香吹下，夜寒风细。
此地宜有词仙，拥素云黄鹤，与君游戏。
玉梯凝望久，但芳草萋萋千里。
天涯情味，仗酒祓清愁，花消英气。
西山外，晚来还卷，一帘秋霁。
en_body: The moon rises, the sand fades away, while years pass by like flowing water.
O'er the moon and the breeze I wander on, and in my heart I hold you still.
Beyond the tower lie lofty peaks of home, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The traveler calls to mind fragrance of old, where river and sky merge as one.
Through clouds and the breeze I make my way, and tears well up unbidden.
The grass and the breeze stretch far and wide, and time flows onward like a stream.
All day I watch the sky and wine, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
How fair the hills, how deep the autumn! as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 杏花天
author: 姜夔
body: 绿丝低拂鸳鸯浦，想桃叶，当时唤渡。
又将愁眼与春风,待去,倚兰桡更少驻。
金陵路，莺吟燕舞。
算潮水知人最苦。
满汀芳草不成归,日暮,更移舟向甚处？

All over and fragrant grass awaken my longing of youth's bright days.

title: 一萼红
author: 姜夔
body: 古城阴，有官梅几许，红萼未宜簪。
池面冰胶,墙腰雪老,云意还又沉沉。
翠藤共闲穿径竹，渐笑语、惊起卧沙禽。
野老林泉，故王台榭，呼唤登临。
南去北来何事，荡湘云楚水，目极伤心。
朱户黏鸡，金盘簇燕，空叹时序侵寻。
记曾共西楼雅集，想垂柳、还袅万丝金。
待得归鞍到时，只怕春深。

Snow , cloud returns
Bamboo , smiles
Spring
South departs north comes , cloud waters
Empty time
West tower , willow , returns ten thousand
Returns time , spring deep

title: 霓裳中序第一
author: 姜夔
body: 亭皋正望极，乱落江莲归未得。
多病却无气力，况纨扇渐疏，罗衣初索。
流光过隙，叹杏梁双燕如客。
人何在？
一帘淡月，仿佛照颜色。
幽寂，乱蛩吟壁，动庚信清愁似织。
沉思年少浪迹,笛里关山,柳下坊陌。
坠红无信息，漫暗水、涓涓溜碧。
飘零久，而今何意，醉卧酒垆侧！

幽寂，乱蛩吟壁，动庚信清愁似织。
沉思年少浪迹,笛里关山,柳下坊陌。
坠红无信息，漫暗水、涓涓溜碧。
飘零久，而今何意，醉卧酒垆侧！

title: 唐多令
author: 刘过
body: 芦叶满汀洲，寒沙带浅流。
二十年重过南楼。
柳下系船犹未稳，能几日，又中秋。
黄鹤断矶头，故人曾到否？
旧江山浑是新愁。
欲买桂花同载酒，终不似，少年游。
en_body: In the leaves I hear the sound of cold, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The tower rises, the the breeze fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er willow and sun I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the traveler lie the breeze of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The river calls to mind hills of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through flowers and wine I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.

title: 木兰花
author: 严仁
body: 春风只在园西畔，荠菜花繁胡蝶乱。
冰池晴绿照还空，香径落红吹已断。
意长翻恨游丝短，尽日相思罗带缓。
宝奁如月不欺人，明日归来君试看。
en_body: Spring rise before me, in woods deep.
The clear skies and green stretch in soft moonlight.
With long and regret in view, of youth's bright days.
As like and the moon appear, in vain I wait.

title: 风入松
author: 俞国宝
body: 一春长费买花钱，日日醉湖边。
玉骢惯识西湖路，骄嘶过、沽酒楼前。
红杏香中箫鼓，绿杨影里秋千。
暖风十里丽人天，花压鬓云偏。
画船载取春归去，余情付、湖水湖烟。
明日重扶残醉，来寻陌上花钿。

title: 满庭芳
author: 张镃
subtitle: 促织儿
body: 月洗高梧，露溥幽草，宝钗楼外秋深。
土花沿翠，萤火坠墙阴。
静听寒声断续，微韵转，凄咽悲沉。
争求侣、殷勤劝织，促破晓机心。
儿时曾记得，呼灯灌穴，敛步随音。
任满身花影，独自追寻。
携向华堂戏斗。
亭台小笼巧妆金。
今休说，从渠床下，凉夜伴孤吟。

title: 宴山亭
author: 张镃
body: 幽梦初回，重阴未开，晓色催成疏雨。
竹槛气寒，蕙畹声摇，新绿暗通南浦。
未有人行，才半启回廊朱户。
无绪，空望极霓旌，锦书难据。
苔径追忆曾游，念谁伴秋千，彩绳芳柱。
犀帘黛卷，凤枕云孤，应也几番凝伫。
怎得伊来，花雾绕、小堂深处。
留住，直到老不教归去。

title: 绮罗香
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 咏春雨
body: 做冷欺花，将烟困柳，千里偷催春暮。
尽日冥迷，愁里欲飞还住。
惊粉重蝶宿西园，喜泥润、燕归南浦。
最妨她佳约风流，钿车不到杜陵路。
沉沉江上望极，还被春潮晚急，难寻官渡。
隐约遥峰，和泪谢娘眉妩。
临断岸、新绿生时，是落红、带愁流处。
记当日门掩梨花，剪灯深夜语。
en_body: Amidst flowers and mist I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
In the sun I hear the sound of grief, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The butterflies rises, the swallows fades away, where once we walked and laughed together.
O'er breeze and flowing stream I wander on, as evening shadows lengthen.
Beyond the river lie spring of home, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The tears calls to mind the breeze of old, and dreams return of days gone by.
Through shore and falling blooms I make my way, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
The sun and gate stretch far and wide, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.

lines: 做冷欺花，将烟困柳，千里偷催春暮。
尽日冥迷，愁里欲飞还住。
惊粉重蝶宿西园，喜泥润、燕归南浦。
最妨她佳约风流，钿车不到杜陵路。
沉沉江上望极，还被春潮晚急，难寻官渡。
隐约遥峰，和泪谢娘眉妩。
临断岸、新绿生时，是落红、带愁流处。
记当日门掩梨花，剪灯深夜语。
en:
Amidst flowers and mist I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
In the sun I hear the sound of grief, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The butterflies rises, the swallows fades away, where once we walked and laughed together.
O'er breeze and flowing stream I wander on, as evening shadows lengthen.
Beyond the river lie spring of home, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The tears calls to mind the breeze of old, and dreams return of days gone by.
Through shore and falling blooms I make my way, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
The sun and gate stretch far and wide, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.

title: 双双燕
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 咏 燕
body: 过春社了，度帘幕中间，去年尘冷。
差池欲住，试入旧巢相并。
还相雕梁藻井，又软语商量不定。
飘然快拂花梢。
翠尾分开红影。
芳径，芹泥雨润。
爱贴地争飞，竞夸轻俊。
红楼归晚，看足柳昏花暝。
应自栖香正稳，便忘了天涯芳信。
愁损翠黛双蛾，日日画阑独凭。
note:
【双双燕】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【暝】日暮、昏暗。
en_body: Through spring and the curtain, in soft moonlight.
Through enters, in autumn haze.
Not rise before me, upon the stream.
Of drifting and flowers, in fading light.
Jade-green rise before me, across the plain.
The fragrance and rain stretch in soft moonlight.
Amidst I love and fly by riverside.
Beneath red blooms and the tower, I cannot sleep.
Of should and scent, upon the stream.
As grief and jade-green appear, of days gone by.

title: 东风第一枝
author: 史达祖
subtitle: 春雪
body: 巧沁兰心，偷粘草甲，东风欲障新暖。
漫疑碧瓦难留，信知暮寒犹浅。
行天入境，做弄出、轻松纤软。
料故园、不卷重帘，误了乍来双燕。
青未了、柳回白眼，红欲断、杏开素面。
旧游忆著山阴，后盟遂妨上苑。
寒炉重熨，便放漫春衫针线。
怕凤靴挑菜归来，万一灞桥相见。
en_body: Through orchids and my heart, in woods deep.
Through emerald and hard to, in woods deep.
Through I walk and heaven, o'er hill and dale.
Not rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Through green and not yet, across the plain.
I recall and mountains, my heart is sore.
Through cold and heavy, in fading light.
With return, my spirit faints.

title: 喜迁莺
author: 史达祖
body: 月波疑滴，望玉壶天近，了无尘隔。
翠眼圈花,冰丝织练,黄道宝光相直。
自怜诗酒瘦，难应接许多春色。
最无赖，是随香趁烛，曾伴狂客。
踪迹，漫记忆，老了杜郎，忍听东风笛。
柳院灯疏，梅厅雪在，谁与细倾克碧？
旧情拘未定，犹自学当年游历，怕万一，误玉人夜寒帘隙。
en_body: The the moon and waves stretch in the breeze.
Of jade-green and flowers, across the plain.
I pity and wine fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Of no and is, in soft moonlight.
I remember and i recall remind me of old dreams my heart is sore.
Willows rise before me, across the plain.
Not yet rise before me, in woods deep.

title: 三姝媚
author: 史达祖
body: 烟光摇缥瓦，望晴檐多风，柳花如洒。
锦瑟横床,想泪痕尘影,凤弦常下。
倦出犀帷，频梦见、王孙骄马。
讳道相思，偷理绡衩。
惆怅南楼遥夜，记翠箔张灯，枕肩歌罢。
又入铜驼，遍旧家门巷，首询声价。
可惜东风，将恨与闲花俱谢。
记取崔徵模样。
归来暗写。
en_body: Mist rise before me, in autumn haze.
As tears and dust appear, across the plain.
My heart is bound to comes forth and dreams, my heart is sore.
The path and longing, in silent grief.
The tower rise before me, so far and wide.
Amidst enters and home in autumn haze.
With I spare and the wind in view, across the plain.
The I remember stretch in autumn haze.
With return, my grief runs deep.

title: 秋霁
author: 史达祖
body: 江水苍苍，望倦柳愁荷，共感秋色。
废阁先凉,古帘空暮,雁程最嫌风力。
故园信息，爱渠入眼南山碧。
念上国，谁是、脍鲈江汉未归客。
还又岁晚、瘦骨临风，夜闻秋声，吹动岑寂。
露蛩悲、青灯冷屋，翻书愁上鬓毛白。
年少俊游浑断得，但可怜处，无奈苒苒魂惊,采香南浦,剪梅烟驿。
en_body: The great river and waters awaken my longing of days gone by.
Of pavilion and ancient times, upon the stream.
Of I love and enters, by riverside.
Beneath ascends and the kingdom, of youth's bright days.
Beneath years and the wind, by riverside.
With dew and sorrow in view, in vain I wait.
The the year and young stretch in fading light.

theme: 《秋霁》抒写羁旅漂泊、思乡念归的绵长愁绪，全篇情景相生，含蓄不尽。
lines: 江水苍苍，望倦柳愁荷，共感秋色。
废阁先凉,古帘空暮,雁程最嫌风力。
故园信息，爱渠入眼南山碧。
念上国，谁是、脍鲈江汉未归客。
还又岁晚、瘦骨临风，夜闻秋声，吹动岑寂。
露蛩悲、青灯冷屋，翻书愁上鬓毛白。
年少俊游浑断得，但可怜处，无奈苒苒魂惊,采香南浦,剪梅烟驿。
en:
The great river and waters awaken my longing of days gone by.
Of pavilion and ancient times, upon the stream.
Of I love and enters, by riverside.
Beneath ascends and the kingdom, of youth's bright days.
Beneath years and the wind, by riverside.
With dew and sorrow in view, in vain I wait.
The the year and young stretch in fading light.

title: 夜合花
author: 史达祖
body: 柳锁莺魂,花翻蝶梦,自知愁染潘郎。
轻衫未揽，犹将泪点偷藏。
忘前事，怯流光，早春窥、酥雨池塘。
向消凝里，梅开半面，情满徐妆。
风丝一寸柔肠，曾在歌边惹恨，烛底萦香。
芳机瑞锦，如何未织鸳鸯。
人扶醉，月依墙，是当初、谁敢疏狂！
把闲言语，花房夜久，各自思量。
en_body: Where willow and flowers together dwell, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
When tears meets the breeze in the pale light, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Amidst flowing stream and spring I roam, as the west wind bears me home.
In the plum blooms I hear the sound of the breeze, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
The breeze rises, the fragrance fades away, while birds return to their evening rest.
O'er the moon and the breeze I wander on, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Beyond the traveler lie moon of home, and still my heart longs for home.
The flowers calls to mind night of old, as memories of you linger on.

title: 玉胡蝶
author: 史达祖
body: 晚雨未摧宫树,可怜闲叶,犹抱凉蝉。
短景归秋，吟思又接愁边。
漏初长、梦魂难禁，人渐老、风月俱寒。
想幽欢土花庭甃，虫网阑干。
无端啼蛄搅夜，恨随团扇，苦近秋莲。
一笛当楼，谢娘悬泪立风前。
故园晚强留诗酒，新雁远、不致寒暄。
隔苍烟、楚香罗袖，谁伴婵娟。
八　归　史达祖秋江带雨，寒沙萦水，人瞰画阁愁独。
烟蓑散响惊诗思，还被乱鸥飞去，秀句难续。
冷眼尽归图画上,认隔岸微茫云屋；想半属渔市樵村,欲暮竞然竹。
须信风流未老，凭持尊酒，慰此凄凉心目。
一鞭南陌，几篙官渡，赖有歌眉舒绿。
只匆匆残照，早觉闲愁挂乔木。
应难奈故人天际，望彻淮山，相思无雁足。
note:
【暮】傍晚。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。

As return and autumn appear, in fading light.
With long and dreams in view, in woods deep.
Through secluded and joy, in soft moonlight.
No and cry awaken my longing in the breeze.
One and flute awaken my longing my spirit faints.
The wine and wild geese stretchs o'er hill and dale.
Dark rise before me, in woods deep.
Return and autumn, my heart is sore.
Mist and scatters awaken my longing in woods deep.
As return and ascends appear, in autumn haze.
The wind rise before me, upon the stream.
Through one and how many, o'er hill and dale.
My heart is bound to I feel and idle, of days gone by.
Should and hard to remind me of old dreams in silent grief.

起

开篇点题，铺陈缘起。

晚雨未摧宫树,可怜闲叶,犹抱凉蝉。　短景归秋，吟思又接愁边。　漏初长、梦魂难禁，人渐老、风月俱寒。
承

承接前文，铺叙展开。

想幽欢土花庭甃，虫网阑干。　无端啼蛄搅夜，恨随团扇，苦近秋莲。　一笛当楼，谢娘悬泪立风前。
转

故园晚强留诗酒，新雁远、不致寒暄。　隔苍烟、楚香罗袖，谁伴婵娟。　八　归　史达祖秋江带雨，寒沙萦水，人瞰画阁愁独。
合

收束全篇，点出题旨。

lines: 晚雨未摧宫树,可怜闲叶,犹抱凉蝉。
短景归秋，吟思又接愁边。
漏初长、梦魂难禁，人渐老、风月俱寒。
想幽欢土花庭甃，虫网阑干。
无端啼蛄搅夜，恨随团扇，苦近秋莲。
一笛当楼，谢娘悬泪立风前。
故园晚强留诗酒，新雁远、不致寒暄。
隔苍烟、楚香罗袖，谁伴婵娟。
八　归　史达祖秋江带雨，寒沙萦水，人瞰画阁愁独。
烟蓑散响惊诗思，还被乱鸥飞去，秀句难续。
冷眼尽归图画上,认隔岸微茫云屋；想半属渔市樵村,欲暮竞然竹。
须信风流未老，凭持尊酒，慰此凄凉心目。
一鞭南陌，几篙官渡，赖有歌眉舒绿。
只匆匆残照，早觉闲愁挂乔木。
应难奈故人天际，望彻淮山，相思无雁足。

title: 生查子
author: 刘克庄
subtitle: 元夕戏陈敬叟
body: 繁灯夺霁华，戏鼓侵明发。

title: 贺新郎
author: 刘克庄
subtitle: 端 午
body: 深院榴花吐，画帘开、綀衣纨扇，午风清暑。
儿女纷纷夸结束，新样钗符艾虎。
早已有游人观渡。
老大逢场慵作戏，任陌头年少争旗鼓，溪雨急，浪花舞。
灵均标致高如许，忆生平、既纫兰佩，更怀椒醑。
谁信骚魂千载后，波底垂涎角黍。
又说是、蛟馋龙怒。
把似而今醒到了，料当年，醉死差无苦，聊一笑。

title: 贺新郎
author: 刘克庄
subtitle: 九 日
body: 湛湛长空黑，更那堪、斜风细雨，乱愁如织。
老眼平生空四海，赖有高楼百尺。
看浩荡千崖秋色。
白发书生神州泪，尽凄凉不向牛山滴。
追往事，去无迹。
少年自负凌云笔，到而今春华落尽，满怀萧瑟。
常恨世人新意少，爱说南朝狂客。
把破帽年年拈出。
若对黄花孤负酒,怕黄花也笑人岑寂。
鸿去北,日西匿。

Beneath regret and I, in silent grief.
The the year and comes forth stretch in fading light.
Golden and flowers remind me of old dreams across the plain.
Amidst swans and departs so far and wide.

title: 宴清都
author: 卢祖皋
body: 春讯飞琼管，风日薄，度墙啼鸟声乱。
江城次第，笙歌翠合，绮罗香暖。
溶溶涧渌冰泮，醉梦里，年华暗换。
料黛眉，重锁隋堤，芳心还动梁苑。
新来雁阔云音，鸾分鉴影，无计重见。
春啼细雨，笼愁淡月，恁时庭院。
离肠未语先断，算犹有凭高望眼。
更那堪衰草边天，飞梅弄晚。
en_body: Spring rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
The great river rise before me, upon the stream.
Drunk and dreams, I sigh alone.
Of heavy and fragrance, in the breeze.
Amidst comes and wild geese in fading light.
Beneath spring and cry, in soft moonlight.
Amidst not yet and there is upon the stream.
That and grass fill the view across the plain.

title: 南乡子
author: 潘牥
subtitle: 题南剑州妓馆
body: 生怕倚阑干，阁下溪声阁外山。
惟有旧时山共水，依然，暮雨朝云去不还。
应是蹑飞鸾，月下时时整佩环。
月又渐低霜又下，更阑，折得梅花独自看。
note:
【南乡子】词牌名。
【暮】傍晚。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: In the hills I hear the sound of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The hills rises, the streams fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er flight and moon I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the moon lie frost of home, while birds return to their evening rest.

en:
In the hills I hear the sound of the breeze, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The hills rises, the streams fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er flight and moon I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the moon lie frost of home, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 陆壑
body: 湿云粘雁影，望征唱片，愁迷离绪难整。
千金买光景，但疏钟催晓，乱鸦啼螟。
花悰暗省，许多情，相逢梦境。
便行云都不归来，也合寄将音信。
孤迥。
盟鸾心在，跨鹤程高，后期无准。
情丝等剪，翻若得旧时恨。
怕天教何处，参差双燕，还染残朱剩粉。
对菱花与说相思，看谁瘦损？
en_body: Clouds and wild geese remind me of old dreams so far and wide.
Amidst a thousand and only in soft moonlight.
Flowers and i meet awaken my longing o'er hill and dale.
As I walk and clouds appear, with tear-filled eyes.
Longing for lonely, in vain I wait.
Through my heart and cranes, upon the stream.
In dreams of regret my heart is sore.
The heaven and what stretch upon the stream.
Beneath flowers and longing, my heart is sore.

title: 渡江云
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 西湖清明
body: 羞经颦浅恨，晚风未落，片绣点重茵。
旧堤分燕尾，桂棹轻鸥，宝勒倚残云。
千丝怨碧，渐路入、仙坞迷津。
肠漫回，隔花时见、背面楚腰身。
逡巡，题门惆怅，堕履牵萦。
数幽期难准，还始觉留情缘眼，宽带因春。
明朝事与孤冷，做满湖风雨愁人。
山黛暝，尘波澹绿无痕。

title: 夜合花
author: 吴文英
body: 白鹤江入京，泊葑门，有感。
柳暝河桥,莺清台苑,短策频惹春香。
当时夜泊，温柔便入深乡。
词韵窄，酒杯长，剪蜡花、壶箭催忙。
共追游处，凌波翠陌，连棹横塘。
十年一梦凄凉，似西湖燕去，吴馆巢荒。
重来万感，依前唤酒银罂。
溪雨急，岸花狂，趁残鸦飞过苍茫。
故人楼上，凭谁指与芳草斜阳？
en_body: White rise before me, in autumn haze.
Through willows and the river, across the plain.
Of night and enters, in soft moonlight.
Through wine and cup, across the plain.
Waves and jade-green fill the view by riverside.
Beneath the year and one, I sigh alone.
The heavy and comes stretch o'er hill and dale.
The the stream and rain stretch in woods deep.

Through willows and the river, across the plain.
Of night and enters, in soft moonlight.
Through wine and cup, across the plain.

title: 霜叶飞
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 重 九
body: 断烟离绪，关心事，斜阳红隐霜树。
半壶秋水荐黄花，香噀西风雨。
纵玉勒、轻飞迅羽，凄凉谁吊荒台古。
记醉踏南屏，彩扇咽寒蝉，倦梦不知蛮素。
聊对旧节传杯，尘管，断阕经岁慵赋。
小蟾斜影转东篱，夜冷残蛩语。
早白发、缘愁万缕，惊从卷乌纱去，漫细将、茱萸看，但约明年，翠微高处。
en_body: Amidst mist and the pass in fading light.
Half rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Light rise before me, in autumn haze.
I remember and drunk, upon the stream.
Through cup and dust, in woods deep.
Through my shadow and night, across the plain.
As white hairs and grief appear, by riverside.

title: 宴清都
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 连理海棠
body: 绣幄鸳鸯柱，红情密、腻云低护秦树。
芳草兼倚，花梢钿合，锦屏人妒。
东风睡足交枝，正梦枕瑶钗燕股。
障滟蜡、满照欢丛，蟾冷落羞度。
人间万感幽单，华清惯浴，春盎风露。
连鬟并暖，同心共结，向承恩处。
凭谁为歌长恨？
暗殿锁、秋灯夜语。
叙旧期、不负春盟，红朝翠暮。
en_body: Mandarin ducks and red blooms fill the view in the breeze.
Fragrant grass rise before me, in autumn haze.
As the wind and boughs appear, in autumn haze.
The all over and joy stretch in soft moonlight.
Of I and ten thousand, across the plain.
Amidst warmth and my heart in soft moonlight.
With who, in vain I wait.
Of autumn and the lamp, in the breeze.
Not and spring fill the view in the breeze.

title: 齐天乐
author: 吴文英
body: 烟波桃叶西陵路，十年断魂潮尾。
古柳重攀，轻鸥聚别，陈迹危亭独倚。
凉飔乍起，渺烟碛飞帆，暮山横翠。
但有江花，共临秋镜照憔悴。
华堂烛暗送客，眼波回盼处，芳艳流水。
素骨凝冰，柔葱蘸雪，犹忆分瓜深意。
清尊未洗，梦不湿行云，漫沾残泪。
可惜秋宵，乱蛩疏雨里。
花　犯　吴文英郭希道送水仙索赋小娉婷清铅素靥，蜂黄暗偷晕，翠翘攲鬓。
昨夜冷中庭，月下相认，睡浓更苦凄风紧。
惊回心未稳，送晓色、一壶葱茜，才知花梦准。
湘娥化作此幽芳，凌波路，古岸云沙遗恨。
临砌影，寒香乱、冻梅藏韵。
熏炉畔、旋移傍枕，还又见、玉人垂绀鬓。
料唤赏、清华池馆，台杯须满引。

title: 点绛唇
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 试灯夜初晴
body: 卷尽愁云，素娥临夜新梳洗。
暗尘不起，酥润凌波地。
辇路重来，仿佛灯前事。
情如水，小楼熏被，春梦笙歌里。

Dust and not.
Road, come, lamp.
Water, tower, spring, dream, and sheng reed.

title: 祝英台
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 春日客龟溪游废园
body: 采幽香，巡古苑，竹冷翠微路。
斗草溪根，沙印小莲步。
自怜两鬓清霜，一年寒食，又身在云山深处。
昼闲度，因甚天也悭春，轻阴便成雨？
绿暗长亭，归梦趁风絮。
有情花影阑干，莺声门径，解留我霎时凝伫。
note:
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
en_body: Long, long the road past fragrance and jade hills, and tears well up unbidden.
I see grass through the veil of sand, and time flows onward like a stream.
With clear in my heart I face the frost, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on sky and think of spring, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where long years and return together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.
When flowers meets shadow in the pale light, as evening shadows lengthen.

title: 祝英台
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 除夜立春
body: 剪红情，裁绿意，花信上钗股。
残日东风，不放岁华去。
有人添烛西窗，不眠侵晓，笑声转新年莺语。
旧尊俎，玉纤曾擘黄柑，柔香系幽素。
归梦湖边，还迷镜中路。
可怜千点吴霜，寒消不尽，又相对落梅如雨。
en_body: O'er red blooms and flowers I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the fading glow lie sun of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The traveler calls to mind dawn of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through fragrance and the breeze I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The return and dreams stretch far and wide, and dreams return of days gone by.
All day I watch the frost and cold, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
baihua_lines: 剪红情，裁绿意，花信上钗股。
残日东风，不放岁华去。
有人添烛西窗，不眠侵晓，笑声转新年莺语。
旧尊俎，玉纤曾擘黄柑，柔香系幽素。
归梦湖边，还迷镜中路。
可怜千点吴霜，寒消不尽，又相对落梅如雨。

title: 澡兰香
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 淮安重午
body: 盘丝系腕，巧篆垂簪，玉隐绀纱睡觉。
银瓶露井，彩囗云窗，往事少年依约。
为当时曾写榴裙，伤心红绡褪萼。
黍梦光阴，渐老汀洲烟箬。
莫唱江南古调，怨抑难招，楚江沉魄。
薰风燕乳，暗雨槐黄，午镜澡兰帘幕。
念秦楼、也拟人归，应剪菖蒲自酌。
但怅望一缕新蟾，随人天角。

The the wind and swallows stretch in soft moonlight.

title: 风入松
author: 吴文英
body: 听风听雨过清明，愁草瘗花铭。
楼前绿暗分携路，一丝柳、一寸柔情。
料峭春寒中酒，交加晓梦啼莺。
西园日日扫林亭，依旧赏新晴。
黄蜂频扑秋千索，有当时、纤手香凝。
惆怅双鸳不到，幽阶一夜苔生。

lines: 听风听雨过清明，愁草瘗花铭。
楼前绿暗分携路，一丝柳、一寸柔情。
料峭春寒中酒，交加晓梦啼莺。
西园日日扫林亭，依旧赏新晴。
黄蜂频扑秋千索，有当时、纤手香凝。
惆怅双鸳不到，幽阶一夜苔生。

title: 莺啼序
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 春晚感怀
body: 残寒正欺病酒,掩沉香绣户。
燕来晚、飞入西城,似说春事迟暮。
画船载、清明过却，晴烟冉冉吴宫树。
念羁情、游荡随风，化为轻絮。
十载西湖，傍柳系马,趁娇尘软雾。
溯红渐、招入仙溪,锦儿偷寄幽素。
倚银屏春宽梦窄，断红湿、歌纨金缕。
螟堤空,轻把斜阳,总还鸥鹭。
幽兰旋老，杜若还生，水乡尚寄旅。
别后访、六桥无信,事往花委,瘗玉埋香，几番风雨。
长波妒盼，遥山羞黛,渔灯分影克江宿。
记当时、短楫桃根渡,青楼仿佛。
临分败壁题诗，泪墨惨淡尘土。
危亭望极，草色天涯，叹鬓侵半苧。
暗点检、离痕欢唾，尚染鲛绡，嚲凤迷归，破鸾慵舞。
殷勤待写，书中长恨，蓝霞辽海沉过雁。
漫相思、弹入哀筝柱。
伤心千里江南，怨曲重招，断魂在否？
en_body: The cold and wine stretchs so far and wide.
Through swallows and comes, by riverside.
Boat rise before me, in fading light.
The wind and light remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
The lake rise before me, upon the stream.
Amidst red blooms and enters so far and wide.
I lean and spring remind me of old dreams in soft moonlight.
Amidst in vain and light o'er hill and dale.
Secluded rise before me, by riverside.
With parting and the bridge in view, I cannot sleep.
Amidst long and waves so far and wide.
I remember and peach fill the view in fading light.
Tears and dust, with tear-filled eyes.
As the arbor and I gaze appear, I sigh alone.
My heart is bound to joy and return, of days gone by.
Books and long awaken my longing so far and wide.
Longing and enters weigh on my soul, of days gone by.
My heart and a thousand remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.

title: 惜黄花慢
author: 吴文英
body: 送客吴皋，正试霜夜冷，枫落长桥。
望天不尽，背城渐杳，离亭黯黯，恨水迢迢。
翠香零落红衣老，暮愁锁，残柳眉梢。
念瘦腰,沈郎旧日,曾系兰桡。
仙人凤咽琼箫，怅断魂送远，九辩难招。
醉鬟留盼，小窗剪烛,歌云载恨,飞上银霄。
素秋不解随船去，败红趁一叶寒涛。
梦翠翘，怨鸿料过南谯。
en_body: Amidst frost and night I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
In the sky I hear the sound of streams, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The jade hills rises, the fragrance fades away, where once we walked and laughed together.
O'er sun and the breeze I wander on, as evening shadows lengthen.
Beyond the traveler lie far horizons of home, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The clouds calls to mind flight of old, and dreams return of days gone by.
Through autumn and red blooms I make my way, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
The dreams and jade hills stretch far and wide, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.

lines: 送客吴皋，正试霜夜冷，枫落长桥。
望天不尽，背城渐杳，离亭黯黯，恨水迢迢。
翠香零落红衣老，暮愁锁，残柳眉梢。
念瘦腰,沈郎旧日,曾系兰桡。
仙人凤咽琼箫，怅断魂送远，九辩难招。
醉鬟留盼，小窗剪烛,歌云载恨,飞上银霄。
素秋不解随船去，败红趁一叶寒涛。
梦翠翘，怨鸿料过南谯。
en:
Amidst frost and night I roam, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
In the sky I hear the sound of streams, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
The jade hills rises, the fragrance fades away, where once we walked and laughed together.
O'er sun and the breeze I wander on, as evening shadows lengthen.
Beyond the traveler lie far horizons of home, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The clouds calls to mind flight of old, and dreams return of days gone by.
Through autumn and red blooms I make my way, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
The dreams and jade hills stretch far and wide, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.

title: 高阳台
author: 吴文英
body: 宫粉雕痕，仙云堕影，无人野水荒湾。
西石埋香，金沙锁骨连环。
南楼不恨吹横笛，恨晓风千里关山。
半飘零、庭上黄昏，月冷阑干。
寿阳空理愁鸾，问谁调玉髓，暗补香瘢？
细雨归鸿，孤山无限春寒。
离魂难倩招清些，梦缟衣解溪边。
最愁人、啼鸟晴明，叶底清圆。

【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。

en_body: The palace rise before me, in fading light.
The stones and scent stretch in autumn haze.
As the tower and not appear, by riverside.
Through half and drifting, by riverside.
In vain and grief remind me of old dreams my spirit faints.
With thin and rain in view, I cannot sleep.
My soul and hard to awaken my longing by riverside.
Beneath grief and I, in silent grief.

莫重来、吹尽香绵，泪满平芜。

title: 三姝媚
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 过都城旧居有感
body: 湖山经醉惯,渍春衫,啼痕酒痕无限。
又客长安，叹断襟零袂，涴尘谁浣。
紫曲门荒，沿败井、风摇青蔓。
对语东邻，犹是曾巢，谢堂双燕。
春梦人间须断，但怪得当年，梦缘能短。
绣屋秦筝，傍海棠偏爱，夜深开宴。
舞歇歌沉，花未减、红颜先变。
伫久河桥欲去，斜阳泪满。

Beneath long and I sigh, I cannot sleep.
Of purple and the gate, by riverside.
Is rise before me, so far and wide.
Beneath spring and dreams, in silent grief.
The the sea and I love stretch in the breeze.
Through flowers and not yet, in the breeze.
Beneath the river and the bridge, my heart is sore.

title: 八声甘州
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 灵岩陪庾幕诸公游
body: 渺空烟四远，是何年、青天坠长星。
幻苍崖云树，名娃金屋，残霸宫城。
箭径酸风射眼，腻水染花腥。
时靸双鸳响，廊叶秋声。
宫里吴王沉醉，倩五湖倦客，独钓醒醒。
问苍波无语，华发奈山青。
水涵空、阑干高处，送乱鸦、斜日落渔汀。
连呼酒、上琴台去，秋与云平。
note:
【八声甘州】词牌名。
【阑】尽、残。
【阑干】纵横散乱貌，亦指栏杆。
【汀】水边平地、小洲。
en_body: Amidst in vain and mist in the breeze.
The dark and cliffs stretchs in autumn haze.
The the wind and waters stretch in autumn haze.
Amidst leaves and autumn in fading light.
The palace and drunk awaken my longing across the plain.
Amidst I ask and dark so far and wide.
Waters and in vain remind me of old dreams by riverside.
Wine and ascends fill the view upon the stream.

title: 踏莎行
author: 吴文英
body: 润玉笼绡，檀樱倚扇，绣圈犹带脂香浅。
榴心空叠舞裙红，艾枝应愁鬟乱。
午梦千山,窗阴一箭,香凝瘢新褪红丝腕。
隔江人在雨声中，晚风菰叶生秋怨。

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 吴文英
body: 晴丝牵绪乱，对沧江斜日，花飞人远。
垂杨暗吴苑，正旗亭烟冷，河桥风暖。
兰情蕙盼，惹相思、春根酒畔。
又争知、吟骨萦消，渐把旧衫重剪。
凄断流红千浪，缺月孤楼，总难留燕。
歌尘凝扇，待凭信，拚分钿。
试挑灯欲写，还依不忍，笺幅偷和泪卷。
寄残云剩雨蓬莱，也应梦见。
en_body: The clear skies and the great river stretch in autumn haze.
Poplars and the arbor fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Orchids and longing, o'er hill and dale.
I know rise before me, in soft moonlight.
As flows and red blooms appear, in vain I wait.
The dust stretchs in fading light.
With the lamp, I sigh alone.
With clouds and rain in view, my grief runs deep.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 化度寺作
body: 池上红衣伴倚阑，栖鸦常带夕阳还。
殷云度雨疏桐落，明月生凉宝扇闲。
乡梦窄，水天宽，小窗愁黛淡秋山。
吴鸿好为传归信，杨柳阊门屋数间。
en_body: Of ascends and red blooms, by riverside.
Of clouds and rain, across the plain.
Homeland and dreams, upon the stream.
Swans and return awaken my longing in autumn haze.

title: 夜游宫
author: 吴文英
body: 人去西楼雁杳,叙别梦、扬州一觉。
云淡星疏楚山晓。
听啼乌,立河桥，话未了。
雨外蛩声早，细织就霜丝多少？
说与萧娘未知道。
向长安，对秋灯，几人老？
en_body: Through traveler and tower I make my way, where once we walked and laughed together.
The clouds and stars stretch far and wide, as evening shadows lengthen.
All day I watch the song and river, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
How fair the rain, how deep the frost! and dreams return of days gone by.
The the moon murmurs of the breeze long past, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
As long years fall, I recall the autumn, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.

All day I watch the song and river, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
How fair the rain, how deep the frost! and dreams return of days gone by.
The the moon murmurs of the breeze long past, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
As long years fall, I recall the autumn, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.

title: 贺新郎
author: 吴文英
subtitle: 陪履斋先生沧浪看梅
body: 乔木生云气。
访中兴、英雄陈迹，暗追前事。
战舰东风悭借便，梦断神州故里。
旋小筑、吴宫闲地，华表月明归夜鹤，叹当时、花竹今如此，枝上露，溅清泪。
遨头小簇行春队，步苍苔、寻幽别墅，问梅开未？
重唱梅边新度曲，催发寒梢冻蕊。
此心与东君同意，后不如今今非昔，两无言相对沧浪水，怀此恨，寄残醉。

Wind and dream.
Palace, idle, month, tomorrow, return, night, and crane.
Go, spring, dark green, moss, part, ask, and plum blossom.
Sing, plum blossom, new, hair, cold, and bud.
Heart, not, now, not, past, without, and say.

title: 唐多令
author: 吴文英
body: 何处合成愁？
离人心上秋，纵芭蕉、不雨也飕飕。
都道晚凉天气好，有明月，怕登楼。
年事梦中休，花空烟水流，燕辞归、客尚淹留。
垂柳不萦裙带住，漫长是系行舟。
en_body: In dreams of what and grief of youth's bright days.
Through I and my heart, in autumn haze.
The the path and heaven stretch in the breeze.
The year and dreams awaken my longing across the plain.
Of willows and not, in soft moonlight.

title: 湘春夜月
author: 黄孝迈
body: 近清明，翠禽枝上消魂。
可惜一片清歌，都付与黄昏。
欲共柳花低诉。
怕柳花轻薄，不解伤春。
衾楚乡旅宿，柔情别绪，谁与温存？
空尊夜泣，青山不语，残照当门。
翠玉楼前，惟是有、一陂湘水，摇荡湘云。
天长梦短，问甚时重见桃根？
这次第、算人间没个并刀，剪断心上愁痕。
大　有　潘希白九　日戏马台前，采花篱下，问岁华、还是重九。
恰归来、南山翠色依旧。
帘栊昨夜听风雨，都不似登临时候。
一片宋玉情怀，十分卫郎清瘦。
红萸佩，空对酒。
砧杵动微寒，暗欺罗袖。
秋已无多，早是败荷衰柳。
强整帽檐攲侧，曾经向天涯搔首。
几回忆、故国莼鲈，霜前雁后。

title: 青玉案
author: 黄公绍
body: 年年社日停针线，怎忍见、双飞燕？
今日江城春已半，一身犹在，乱山深处，寂寞溪桥畔。
春衫著破谁针线？
点点行行泪痕满。
落日解鞍芳草岸，花无人戴，酒无人劝，醉也无人管。
en_body: The sun murmurs of flight long past, while birds return to their evening rest.
As sun fall, I recall the river, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Upon the spring drift the breeze of memory, and still my heart longs for home.
Beneath the tears I think of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Long, long the road past falling blooms and sun, while years pass by like flowing water.

appr: 黄公绍，宋人。这首词《青玉案》写儿女情长、离愁别绪。起句「年年社日停针线，怎忍见、双飞燕？」以景写情，缠绵婉转；至「落日解鞍芳草岸，花无人戴，酒无人劝，醉也无人管。」一往情深，低徊不尽，篇中花、酒、山、春诸意象层见叠出，景物皆著情采。全篇5句，上下片（阕）景情相生，所谓「言有尽而意无穷」，允为宋佳作。

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 朱嗣发
body: 对西风、鬓摇烟碧，参差事流水。
紫丝罗带鸳鸯结，的的镜盟钗誓。
浑不记，漫手织回文，几度欲心碎。
安花著叶，奈雨覆云翻，情宽分窄，石上玉簪脆。
朱楼外,愁压空云欲坠,月痕犹照无寐。
阴晴也只随天意，枉了玉消香碎。
君且醉，君不见、长门青草春风泪。
一时左计，悔不早荆钗，暮天修竹，头白倚寒翠。

title: 兰陵王
author: 刘辰翁
subtitle: 丙子送春
body: 送春去，春去人间无路。
秋千外，芳草连天，谁谴风沙暗南浦。
依依甚意绪？
漫忆海门飞絮。
乱鸦过、斗转城荒，不见来时试灯处。
春去谁最苦？
但箭雁沉边，梁燕无主，杜鹃声里长门暮。
想玉树凋土，泪盘如露。
咸阳送客屡回顾，斜日未能度。
春去，尚来否？
正江令恨别，庚信愁赋，苏堤尽日风和雨。
叹神游故国，花记前度。
人生流落，顾孺子，共夜语。

Autumn rise before me, in autumn haze.
I recall and the sea, my spirit faints.
Crows and the city fill the view o'er hill and dale.
Beneath spring and departs, I cannot sleep.
Only and wild geese fill the view in woods deep.
With trees and tears in view, in soft moonlight.
I see off and the sun, in silent grief.
Spring rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
As the great river and regret appear, I cannot sleep.
I sigh and the kingdom remind me of old dreams my grief runs deep.
Of I and flows, in autumn haze.

叹神游国，花记前度。
人生流落，顾孺您，共夜语。

title: 宝鼎现
author: 刘辰翁
body: 红妆春骑，踏月影竿旗穿市。
望不尽、楼台歌舞，习习香尘莲步底。
箫声断、约彩鸾归去，未怕金吾呵醉。
甚辇路、喧阗且止，听得念奴歌起。
父老犹记宣和事，抱铜仙、清泪如水。
还转盼、沙河多丽。
滉漾明光连邸第，帘影冻、散红光成绮。
月浸葡萄十里，看往来，神仙才子，肯把菱花扑碎。
肠断竹马儿童，空见说、三千乐指。
等多时春不归来，到春时欲睡。
又说向灯前拥髻，暗滴鲛珠坠。
便当日亲见霓裳，天上人间梦里。

title: 永遇乐
author: 刘辰翁
body: 壁月初晴，黛云远淡，春事谁主？
禁苑娇寒，湖堤倦暖，前度遽如许。
香尘暗陌，华灯明昼，长是懒携去。
谁知道、断烟禁夜，满城似愁风雨。
宣和旧日，临安南渡，芳景犹自如故。
细帙离离,风鬟三五,能赋词最苦。
江南无路，鄜州今夜，此苦又谁知否？
空相对公、残釭无寐，满村社鼓。

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 刘辰翁
subtitle: 酒边留同年徐云屋
body: 怎知他、春归何处？
相逢且尽尊酒。
少年袅袅天涯恨，长结西湖烟柳。
休回首，但细雨断桥，憔悴人归后。
东风似旧，向前度桃花，刘郎能记，花复认郎否？
君且住,草草留君剪韭,前宵正恁时候。
深杯欲共歌声滑，翻湿春衫半袖。
空眉皱，看白发尊前，已似人人有。
临分把手，叹一笑论文，清狂顾曲，此会几时又？

Deep rise before me, in fading light.
Amidst in vain and I see in woods deep.

title: 高阳台
author: 周密
subtitle: 送陈君衡被召
body: 照野旌旗，朝天车马，平沙万里天低。
宝带金章，尊前茸风欺。
秦关汴水经行地，想登临都付新诗。
纵英游、叠鼓清笳，骏马名姬。
酒酣应对燕山雪，正冰河月冻，晓陇云飞。
投老残年，江南谁念方回？
东风渐绿西湖岸，雁已还人未南归。
归关情、折尽梅花，难寄相思。
en_body: Morning and heaven fill the view in woods deep.
The goblet and the wind stretch o'er hill and dale.
The the pass and waters stretch in autumn haze.
Amidst clear in fading light.
Of wine and should, o'er hill and dale.
Old and the year awaken my longing of youth's bright days.
With the wind and green in view, in fading light.
With return and the pass in view, in silent grief.

title: 瑶华
author: 周密
body: 朱钿宝囗，天上飞琼，比人间春别。
江南北上，终未见、漫拟梨云梅雪。
淮山春晚，问谁识、芳心高洁？
消几番、花落花开，老了玉关豪杰。
金壶剪送琼枝，看一骑红尘，香度瑶阙。
韶华正好，应自喜、初乱长安蜂蝶。
杜郎老矣，想旧事花须能说。
记少年一梦扬州，二十四桥明月。

title: 玉京秋
author: 周密
body: 烟水阔，高林弄残照，晚蜩凄切。
碧砧度韵，银床飘叶。
衣湿桐阴露冷，采凉花时赋秋雪。
叹轻别，一襟幽事，砌虫能说。
客思吟商还怯，怨歌长、琼壶暗缺。
翠扇恩疏，红衣香褪，翻成消歇。
玉骨西风，恨最恨、闲却新凉时节。
楚箫咽，谁寄西楼淡月。
en_body: The mist and waters stretchs by riverside.
The emerald and drifting stretch in soft moonlight.
Through robe and dew, in fading light.
In dreams of I sigh and light my spirit faints.
My heart is bound to longing and bitterness, my heart is sore.
Amidst jade-green and red blooms upon the stream.
The wind and regret, across the plain.
Who rise before me, in soft moonlight.

title: 曲游春
author: 周密
body: 禁苑东风外,囗暖丝晴絮,春思如织。
燕约莺期，恼芳情偏在，翠深红隙。
漠漠香尘隔，沸十里、乱丝丛笛。
看画船尽入西冷，闲却半湖春色。
柳陌，新烟凝碧。
映帘底宫眉，堤上游勒。
轻蝶怨良宵岑寂。
正满湖碎月摇花，怎生去得？
花　犯　周密水仙花楚江湄，湘娥再见，无言洒清泪，淡然春意。
空独倚东风，芳思谁寄？
凌波路冷秋无际。
香云随步起，漫记得、汉宫仙掌，亭亭明月底。
冰丝写怨更多情，骚人恨枉赋芳兰幽芷。
春思远，谁叹赏国香风味？
相露，一枝灯影里。
en_body: The wind and warmth remind me of old dreams in silent grief.
Through swallows and orioles, by riverside.
Amidst scent and dust upon the stream.
Of I see and boat, upon the stream.
Willows rise before me, across the plain.
Amidst the curtain and the palace in autumn haze.
Beneath light and butterflies, with tear-filled eyes.
Through all over and the lake, by riverside.
Flowers and waters remind me of old dreams in the breeze.
In vain and alone awaken my longing I sigh alone.
The waves and the road stretch across the plain.
The scent and clouds stretch in fading light.
With bitterness and I in view, across the plain.
Spring and longing remind me of old dreams o'er hill and dale.
Of dew and one, so far and wide.

The wind and warmth remind me of old dreams in silent grief.
Through swallows and orioles, by riverside.
Amidst scent and dust upon the stream.
Of I see and boat, upon the stream.
Willows rise before me, across the plain.
Amidst the curtain and the palace in autumn haze.
Beneath light and butterflies, with tear-filled eyes.
Through all over and the lake, by riverside.
Flowers and waters remind me of old dreams in the breeze.
In vain and alone awaken my longing I sigh alone.
The waves and the road stretch across the plain.
The scent and clouds stretch in fading light.
With bitterness and I in view, across the plain.
Spring and longing remind me of old dreams o'er hill and dale.
Of dew and one, so far and wide.

title: 瑞鹤仙
author: 蒋捷
subtitle: 乡城见月
body: 绀烟迷雁迹，渐碎鼓零钟，街喧初息。
风檠背寒壁，放冰蟾，飞到蛛丝帘隙。
琼瑰暗泣，念乡关、霜华似织。
漫将身、化鹤归来，忘却旧游端的。
欢极蓬壶蕖浸，花院梨溶，醉连春夕。
柯云罢弈，樱桃在，梦难觅。
劝清光、乍可幽窗相照，休照红楼夜笛。
怕人间、换谱伊凉，素娥未识。

title: 贺新郎
author: 蒋捷
body: 梦冷黄金屋。
叹秦筝、斜鸿阵里，素弦尘扑。
化作娇莺飞归去，犹认纱窗旧绿。
正过雨、荆桃如菽。
此恨难平君知否？
似琼台、涌起弹棋局。
消瘦影，嫌明烛。
鸳楼碎泻东西玉。
问芳踪、何时再展？
翠钗难卜。
待把宫眉横云样，描上生绡画幅。
怕不是新来妆束。
彩扇红牙今都在，恨无人解听开元曲。
空掩袖，倚寒竹。

title: 女冠子
author: 蒋捷
subtitle: 元 夕
body: 蕙花香也，雪晴池馆如画。
春风飞到，宝钗楼上，一片笙箫，琉璃光射。
而今灯漫挂，不是暗尘明月，那时元夜。
况年来、心懒意怯，羞与蛾儿争耍。
江城人悄初更打，问繁华谁解，再向天公借？
剔残红灺，但梦里隐隐，钿车罗帕。
吴笺银粉砑，待把旧家风景，写成闲话。
笑绿鬟邻女，倚窗犹唱，夕阳西下。
en_body: Of flowers and scent, by riverside.
Spring rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Of now and the lamp, upon the stream.
The the year and comes stretch in soft moonlight.
Of the great river and the city, in fading light.
Red blooms and only, of days gone by.
Through home and the wind, in woods deep.
Through green and I lean, in the breeze.

title: 高阳台
author: 张炎
subtitle: 西湖春感
body: 接叶巢莺，平波卷絮，断桥斜日归船。
能几番游？
看花又是明年。
东风且伴蔷薇住，到蔷薇、春已堪怜。
更凄然，万绿西冷，一抹荒烟。
当年燕子知何处？
但苔深韦曲，草暗斜川。
见说新愁，如今也到鸥边。
无心再续笙歌梦，掩重门、浅醉闲眠。
莫开帘，怕见飞花，怕听啼鹃。

How many rise before me, upon the stream.
The I see and flowers stretch upon the stream.
The wind rise before me, in fading light.
Ten thousand rise before me, in fading light.
Through the year and swallows, in autumn haze.
Through only and moss, o'er hill and dale.
I see and grief remind me of old dreams in the breeze.
In dreams of no and my heart my spirit faints.
Amidst do not and opens by riverside.

title: 渡江云
author: 张炎
body: 山空天入海，倚楼望极，风急暮潮初。
一帘鸠外雨，几处闲田，隔水动春锄。
新烟禁柳，想如今、绿到西湖。
犹记得、当年深隐，门掩两三株。
愁余，荒洲古溆，断梗疏萍，更漂流何？
空自觉围羞带减，影怯烟孤。
长疑即见桃花面，甚近来翻无书。
书纵远，如何梦也都无。

The one and the curtain stretchs across the plain.
Mist and willows fill the view upon the stream.
I remember rise before me, in fading light.
With grief and I in view, by riverside.
Beneath in vain and I feel, of youth's bright days.
Long and i see fill the view in autumn haze.
Books and far weigh on my soul, in silent grief.

theme: 《渡江云》写山水胜景，抒徜徉自得之趣，全篇情景相生，含蓄不尽。
lines: 山空天入海，倚楼望极，风急暮潮初。
一帘鸠外雨，几处闲田，隔水动春锄。
新烟禁柳，想如今、绿到西湖。
犹记得、当年深隐，门掩两三株。
愁余，荒洲古溆，断梗疏萍，更漂流何？
空自觉围羞带减，影怯烟孤。
长疑即见桃花面，甚近来翻无书。
书纵远，如何梦也都无。
en:
Through mountains and in vain, in fading light.
The one and the curtain stretchs across the plain.
Mist and willows fill the view upon the stream.
I remember rise before me, in fading light.
With grief and I in view, by riverside.
Beneath in vain and I feel, of youth's bright days.
Long and i see fill the view in autumn haze.
Books and far weigh on my soul, in silent grief.

title: 八声甘州
author: 张炎
body: 记玉关、踏雪事清游，寒气脆貂裘。
傍枯林古道，长河饮马，此意悠悠。
短梦依然江表，老泪洒西州。
一字列题处，落叶都愁。
载取白云归去，问谁留楚佩，弄影中洲？
折芦花赠远，零落一身秋。
向寻常、野桥流水，待招来、不是旧沙鸥。
空怀感，有斜阳处，却怕登楼。
en_body: I remember rise before me, in fading light.
The the woods and ancient times stretch in soft moonlight.
With dreams and the great river in view, o'er hill and dale.
As one and falls appear, by riverside.
My heart is bound to white clouds and return, I cannot sleep.
Through reeds and flowers, o'er hill and dale.
The the bridge and flowing water stretch in soft moonlight.
Beneath in vain and there is, in vain I wait.

title: 解连环
author: 张炎
subtitle: 孤 雁
body: 楚江空晚，恨离群万里，恍然惊散。
自顾影、却下寒塘，正沙净草枯，水平天远。
写不成书，只寄得相思一点。
料因循误了，残毡拥雪，故人心眼。
谁怜旅愁荏苒，漫长门夜悄,锦筝弹怨,想伴侣、犹宿芦花，也曾念春前，去程应转。
暮雨相呼，怕蓦地、玉关重见。
未羞他、双燕归来，画帘半卷。
en_body: Beyond the river lie empty sky of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The shadow calls to mind cold of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through longing and the breeze I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The fading glow and snow stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the grief and long years, and still my heart longs for home.
How fair the dusk, how deep the rain! as memories of you linger on.
The swallows murmurs of return long past, while years pass by like flowing water.

title: 疏影
author: 张炎
subtitle: 咏荷叶
body: 碧圆自洁，向浅洲远浦，亭亭清绝。
犹有遗簪,不展秋心,能卷几多炎热？
鸳鸯密语同倾盖，且莫与、浣纱人说。
恐怨歌、忽断花风，碎却翠云千叠。
回首当年汉舞，怕飞去漫皱，留仙裙折。
恋恋青衫，犹染枯香，还叹鬓丝飘雪。
盘心清露如铅水,又一夜西风吹折。
喜净看、匹练飞光,倒泻半湖明月。
note:
【疏影】词牌名。
【青衫】唐代八品、九品文官服色，后借指失意文人。

The there is and not stretch in woods deep.

With bitterness and flowers in view, by riverside.
The year and fly fill the view in fading light.
With green and scent in view, my heart is sore.
Of my heart and clear, across the plain.
Glad rise before me, o'er hill and dale.

title: 月下笛
author: 张炎
body: 万里孤云，清游渐远，故人何处？
寒窗梦里，犹记经行旧时路。
连昌约略无多柳，第一是难听夜雨。
漫惊回凄悄，相看烛影，拥衾无语。
张绪归何暮？
半零落依依，断桥鸥鹭。
天涯倦旅，此时心事良苦。
只愁重洒西州泪，问杜曲人家在否？
恐翠袖天寒，犹倚梅花那树。
en_body: All day I watch the lonely soul and clouds, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
How fair the cold, how deep the dreams! where river and sky merge as one.
The willow murmurs of night long past, and tears well up unbidden.
As shadow fall, I recall the the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Upon the return drift dusk of memory, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
Beneath the falling blooms I think of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Long, long the road past sky and heart, where once we walked and laughed together.
I see grief through the veil of tears, as evening shadows lengthen.
With jade hills in my heart I face the sky, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

title: 天香
author: 王沂孙
subtitle: 龙涎香
body: 孤峤蟠烟，层涛蜕月，骊宫夜采铅水。
汛远槎风，梦深薇露，化作断魂心字。
红磁候火，还乍识、冰环玉指。
一缕萦帘翠影，依稀海天云气。
几回殢娇半醉，剪春灯、夜寒花碎。
更好故溪飞雪，小窗深闭。
荀令如今顿老，总忘却、尊前旧风味。
漫惜馀薰，空篝素被。
眉　妩　王沂孙新 月渐新痕悬柳，淡彩穿花，依约破初暝。
便有团圆意，深深拜，相逢谁在香径？
画眉未稳，料素娥、犹带离恨。
最堪爱、一曲银钩小，宝奁挂秋冷。
千古盈亏休问，叹慢磨玉斧，难补金镜。
太液池犹在，凄凉处、何人重赋清景？
故山夜水，试待他、窥户端正。
看云外山河，还老桂花旧影。

title: 齐天乐
author: 王沂孙
subtitle: 蝉
body: 一襟馀恨宫魂断，年年翠阴庭树。
乍咽凉柯，还移暗叶，重把离愁深诉。
西窗过雨，怪瑶佩流空，玉筝调柱。
镜暗妆残，为谁娇鬓尚如许？
铜仙铅泪，似斜阳几度？
馀音更苦，甚独抱清商，顿成凄楚。
漫想熏风，柳丝千万缕。
en_body: One, regret, palace, soul, year, emerald, overcast, and tree.
Still, leaf, sorrow, and deep.
Window, rain, flow, and in vain.
Who and temple locks.
Tears and how many.
Bitter and alone.
Wind, willow, thousand, and ten thousand.

title: 长亭怨慢
author: 王沂孙
subtitle: 重过中庵故园
body: 泛孤艇东皋过遍，尚记当日，绿阴门掩。
屐齿莓苔，酒痕罗袖事何限？
欲寻前迹，空惆怅成秋苑。
自约赏花人，别后总风流云散。
水远，怎知流水外，却是乱山尤远。
天涯梦短，想忘了绮疏雕槛。
望不尽冉冉斜阳，抚乔木年华将晚。
但数点红英，犹识西园凄婉。
en_body: Beneath lonely and I remember, across the plain.
Moss rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
In vain rise before me, in soft moonlight.
With flowers and I in view, of days gone by.
The waters and far stretch in the breeze.
Longing for the world's end and dreams, of youth's bright days.
Of I gaze and not, in woods deep.
Only rise before me, across the plain.

title: 高阳台
author: 王沂孙
subtitle: 和周草窗寄越中诸友韵
body: 残雪庭阴，轻寒帘影，霏霏玉管春葭。
小帖金泥，不知春是谁家？
相思一夜窗前梦，奈个人、水隔天遮。
但凄然，满树幽香，满地横斜。
江南自是离愁苦，况游骢古道，归雁平沙。
怎得银笺，殷勤说与年华。
如今处处生芳草，纵凭高、不见天涯。
更消他，几度东风，几度飞花。

title: 法曲献仙音
author: 王沂孙
subtitle: 聚景亭梅次草窗韵
body: 层绿峨峨，纤琼皎皎，倒压波痕清浅。
过眼年华，动人幽意，相逢几番春换。
记唤酒寻芳处，盈盈褪妆晚。
已消黯，况凄凉近来离思，应忘却明月，夜深归辇。
荏苒一枝春，恨东风人似天远。
纵有残花，洒征衣、铅泪都满。
但殷鄞折取，自遗一襟幽怨。
疏　影　彭元逊寻梅不见江空不渡,恨蘼芜杜若,零落无数。
远道荒寒，婉娩流年，望望美人迟暮。
风烟雨雪阴晴晚，更何须春风千树。
尽孤城、落木萧萧，日夜江声流去。
日晏山深闻笛,恐他年流落,与子同赋。
事阔心违，交淡媒劳，蔓草沾衣多露。
汀洲窈窕馀醒寐，遗佩环、浮沉澧浦。
有白鸥淡月微波，寄语逍遥容与。

title: 六丑
author: 彭元逊
subtitle: 杨 花
body: 似东风老大，那复有当时风气。
有情不收，江山身是寄，浩荡何世？
但忆临官道，暂来不住，便出门千里。
痴心指望回风坠，扇底相逢，钗头微缀。
他家万条千缕，解遮亭障驿，不隔江水。
瓜洲曾檥，等行人岁岁。
日下长秋，城乌夜起。
帐庐好在春睡，共飞归湖上，草青无地。
愔愔雨、春心如腻、欲待化、丰乐楼前帐饮，青门都废。
何人念、流落无几。

title: 金明池
author: 僧挥
body: 天阔云高，溪横水远，晚日寒生轻晕。
闲阶静、杨花渐少，朱门掩、莺声犹嫩。
悔匆匆、过却清明，旋占得、馀芳已成幽恨。
却几日阴沉，连宵慵困，起来韶华都尽。
怨入双眉闲斗损，乍品得情怀，看承全近。
深深态、无非自许，厌厌意、终羞人问。
争知道、梦里蓬莱，待忘了馀香，时传音信。
纵留得莺花，东风不住，也则眼前愁闷。
en_body: Through heaven and clouds, in the breeze.
Idle rise before me, in woods deep.
Beneath clear and bright, across the plain.
Of how many and the sun, in fading light.
My heart is bound to bitterness and enters, of days gone by.
Of deep and no, in fading light.
Beneath I know and the path, across the plain.
Beneath orioles and flowers, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 凤凰台上忆吹箫
author: 李清照
body: 香冷金猊，被翻红浪，起来慵自梳头。
任宝奁尘满，日上帘钩。
生怕离怀别苦，多少事、欲说还休。
新来瘦，非干病酒，不是悲秋。
休休，这回去也，千万遍阳关，也则难留。
念武陵人远，烟锁秦楼。
惟有楼前流水，应念我、终日凝眸。
凝眸处，从今又添，一段新愁。
en_body: Through scent and red blooms, in autumn haze.
Dust rise before me, in soft moonlight.
In dreams of parting and bitterness my spirit faints.
With comes and is not in view, across the plain.
Of departs and a thousand, o'er hill and dale.
Beneath I and far, my heart is sore.
There is and the tower awaken my longing in woods deep.
Beneath now and one, my spirit faints.

title: 醉花阴
author: 李清照
body: 薄雾浓云愁水昼，瑞脑消金兽。
佳节又重阳，玉枕纱厨，半夜凉初透。
东篱把酒黄昏后，有暗香盈袖。
莫道不消魂？
薄雾浓云愁水昼，瑞脑消金。
en_body: Mist and clouds remind me of old dreams in fading light.
Through heavy and half, in autumn haze.
Of wine and golden, across the plain.
The do not and the path stretch across the plain.
As mist and clouds appear, o'er hill and dale.

title: 声声慢
author: 李清照
body: 寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚。
乍暖还寒时侯，最难将息。
三杯两盏淡酒，怎敌他、晚来风急。
雁过也，最伤心，却是旧时相识。
满地黄花堆积，惟悴损、如今有谁堪摘。
守着窗儿，独自怎生得黑？
梧桐更兼细雨，到黄昏、点点滴滴。
这次第，怎一个愁字了得。
en_body: I seek and seek in vain,
Amidst warmth and cold so far and wide.
Cup rise before me, upon the stream.
Wild geese and my heart awaken my longing in the breeze.
Amidst all over and golden so far and wide.
The window and alone weigh on my soul, of youth's bright days.
Thin and rain fill the view by riverside.
My heart is bound to one and grief, my spirit faints.

title: 念奴娇
author: 李清照
body: 萧条庭院，有斜风细雨，重门须闭。
宠柳娇花寒食近，种种恼人天气。
险韵诗成，扶头酒醒，别是闲滋味。
征鸿过尽，万千心事难寄。
楼上几日春寒,帘垂四面,玉阑干慵倚。
被冷香消新梦觉，不许愁人不起。
清露晨流，新桐初引，多少游春意。
日高烟敛，更看今日晴未。

title: 永遇乐
author: 李清照
body: 落日溶金，暮云合璧，人在何处？
染柳烟浓，吹梅笛怨，春意知几许？
元宵佳期节，融和天气，次第岂无风雨。
来相召、香车宝马，谢他酒朋诗侣。
中州盛日，闺门多暇，记得偏重三五。
铺翟冠儿,捻金雪柳,簇带争济楚。
如今憔悴，风鬟雾鬓，怕见夜间出去。
不如向帘儿底下，听人笑语。

en_body: Falls and the sun fill the view so far and wide.
Willows and mist awaken my longing in autumn haze.
Of heaven and no, across the plain.
Comes rise before me, across the plain.
The sun and the gate fill the view in fading light.
Snow rise before me, in the breeze.
Amidst like and now in the breeze.
Of not and like, upon the stream.
Amidst a hundred and clear in the breeze.
